attributes.description: Reference to the customer segment definition to which the shopper is being assigned. Links to the segment master in the Customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Segment Object; Internal CRM Standard

attributes.name: program_config_id

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grocery shopper (customer) who is being assigned to the segment. Links to the customer master profile in the Customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Customer Object; Internal CRM Standard

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: Cluster-specific segment execution: retail-grocery personalization and targeted promotion systems apply segment assignments at the store cluster level to match cluster assortment. Drives cluster-scope

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary store associated with this segment assignment. Captures the shopper's home store or the store context in which the assignment was triggered. Supports store-level segmentation reporting and localized promotion targeting.
attributes.references: Internal Store Operations Standard; NCR POS – Store Configuration

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. attributes.name: ab_test_group
attributes.description: Designates the experimental group to which this shopper-segment assignment belongs when the assignment is part of an A/B or multivariate segmentation test. 'control' is the baseline group; 'treatment_a' and 'treatment_b' are variant groups; 'holdout' is excluded from all treatments for measurement purposes. Null if the assignment is not part of an active test.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Analytics and Personalization Standard

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shopper was formally assigned to the segment. Used for time-series segment membership tracking and cohort analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which the shopper was assigned to this segment. 'rule_based' indicates a deterministic business rule engine; 'ml_model' indicates a machine learning model prediction; 'manual_override' indicates a CRM analyst or marketer directly assigned the shopper; 'batch_import' indicates a bulk load from an external system; 'api_push' indicates a real-time API-driven assignment from an integrated platform such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Analytics and Personalization Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Segmentation API

attributes.name: assignment_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this segment assignment. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across integrated platforms. Values correspond to known operational systems: Salesforce Commerce Cloud CRM, NCR POS loyalty integration, Blue Yonder demand planning, internal ML platform, manual CRM tooling, or batch ETL processes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Policy; Internal Systems of Record Catalogue

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this shopper-to-segment assignment. 'active' means the shopper currently belongs to the segment; 'expired' means the assignment passed its expiry date; 'revoked' means it was manually removed; 'pending' means awaiting activation; 'superseded' means replaced by a newer assignment for the same segment.

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the assignment event was recorded in the system. Supports real-time segmentation pipelines and audit trails. Distinct from assignment_date which captures the business date.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 – Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: batch_run_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the batch processing run (e.g., Blue Yonder or internal ML platform job execution) that generated this segment assignment. Enables traceability of bulk assignment events back to a specific pipeline execution for debugging, reprocessing, and data lineage auditing. Null for real-time API-driven or manual assignments.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Policy; Blue Yonder Demand Planning – Batch Job Management

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: Defines the omnichannel shopping context in which this segment assignment is applicable. 'all_channels' applies across all touchpoints; 'in_store' applies only to physical store interactions; 'digital' applies to eCommerce and app; 'pickup' applies to Click-and-Collect (curbside or in-store order collection); 'delivery' applies to last-mile delivery orders; 'pharmacy' applies to pharmacy-specific interactions. Supports Grocery's omnichannel personalization strategy.
attributes.references: Internal Omnichannel Strategy Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Channel Configuration

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: The Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) tier associated with this segment assignment at the time of assignment. Captures the shopper's estimated long-term revenue value tier as determined by the segmentation model or rule engine. Used to prioritize high-value shopper targeting in promotions and personalization. Values: platinum (highest), gold, silver, bronze, unclassified.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) Framework; Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Einstein Analytics

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: A numeric probability score between 0.0000 and 1.0000 representing the model's or rule engine's confidence that the shopper belongs to this segment. Populated for ml_model and rule_based assignment methods. Used to filter high-confidence assignments for precision targeting and to support A/B testing of segmentation strategies.
attributes.references: Internal ML Model Governance Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Einstein Segmentation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment assignment record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the audit trail creation marker. Distinct from assignment_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 – Audit Trail Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has provided consent for their data to be used in segmentation and targeted marketing activities at the time of this assignment. True means consent is on record. Supports CCPA and GDPR-aligned data privacy compliance for customer data usage in the Customer domain.
attributes.references: CCPA – California Consumer Privacy Act; GDPR Article 6 – Lawfulness of Processing; FTC – Privacy and Data Security

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the shopper's membership in this segment is considered active and eligible for targeted promotions, personalization, and loyalty offers. May differ from assignment_date if the assignment is scheduled for a future activation.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Segmentation Governance Policy; FTC – Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shopper's membership in this segment expires and is no longer valid for targeting. Null indicates an open-ended assignment with no scheduled expiry. Supports time-bounded segmentation strategies such as seasonal or promotional cohorts.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Segmentation Governance Policy; FTC – Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: is_primary_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment assignment represents the shopper's primary or dominant segment when a shopper belongs to multiple segments simultaneously. True means this is the primary segment used for default personalization and offer targeting. Supports single-segment fallback logic in downstream marketing and POS systems.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Segmentation Governance Policy; Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Personalization Rules

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the ML model or rule engine that produced this segment assignment. Enables reproducibility, model performance tracking, and rollback analysis. Format follows semantic versioning (e.g., 'v2.3.1') or a named model run identifier. Null for manual_override and batch_import methods.
attributes.references: Internal ML Model Governance Standard; Internal Data Lineage Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context or commentary about this segment assignment. Used by CRM analysts and data scientists to document special circumstances, exceptions, or observations not captured by structured fields. Not used for automated processing.

attributes.name: nps_score_at_assignment
attributes.description: The shopper's most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) at the time of segment assignment, on a scale of 0 to 10. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to contextualize the segmentation decision. Supports analysis of whether segment membership correlates with shopper satisfaction and advocacy.
attributes.references: Internal NPS Measurement Standard; Internal Customer Experience Governance

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has opted out of marketing communications associated with this segment. True means the shopper should not receive outbound marketing for this segment even if the assignment is active. Distinct from data_consent_flag which governs data processing consent.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA – Opt-Out Rights; FTC – Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the CRM analyst or marketing manager when assignment_method is 'manual_override'. Documents the business justification for bypassing the automated segmentation engine. Required for audit compliance when overriding ML or rule-based assignments.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 – Internal Controls; Internal Customer Segmentation Governance Policy

attributes.name: personalization_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper's segment assignment qualifies them for personalized digital experiences including eCommerce storefront personalization, app recommendations, and targeted email campaigns via Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Distinct from promotion_eligibility_flag which governs price-based offers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Personalization Rules; Internal Digital Commerce Standard

attributes.name: promotion_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper is eligible to receive targeted promotions, TPR (Temporary Price Reduction) offers, or ad circular inclusions based on this segment assignment. True means the shopper qualifies for segment-specific promotional targeting. Supports the Promotions Management domain and FTC advertising compliance.
attributes.references: FTC – Advertising and Pricing Practices; Internal Promotions Management Standard

attributes.name: rule_set_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific business rule set definition that triggered this assignment when assignment_method is 'rule_based'. Enables traceability of which rule configuration produced the membership. Null for ml_model, manual_override, and batch_import methods.

attributes.name: segment_category
attributes.description: The high-level category of the segment to which the shopper is assigned. 'behavioral' segments are based on shopping behavior patterns; 'demographic' on age, income, or household composition; 'psychographic' on lifestyle and values; 'transactional' on purchase history and spend patterns; 'lifecycle' on shopper journey stage (new, active, lapsed, churned); 'program_based' on enrollment in specific programs such as SNAP, WIC, or pharmacy.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Segmentation Taxonomy; Salesforce Commerce Cloud – Segment Classification

attributes.name: segment_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank (1 = highest priority) indicating the relative priority of this segment assignment among all active segments for the shopper. Used to resolve conflicts when multiple segments offer competing promotions or personalization rules. Lower values indicate higher priority.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Segmentation Governance Policy; NCR POS – Loyalty Integration Rules

attributes.name: snap_wic_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment assignment is specifically associated with a SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) or WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program participant segment. True flags the shopper as a government assistance program participant for targeted compliance reporting and eligible product promotions. Supports USDA and FTC regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: USDA – SNAP and WIC Program Regulations; FTC – Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: transition_trigger
attributes.description: The business event or condition that triggered the shopper's transition into this segment. 'purchase_event' indicates a qualifying transaction; 'loyalty_milestone' indicates reaching a loyalty tier threshold; 'model_refresh' indicates a scheduled ML model re-scoring run; 'manual_review' indicates a CRM analyst-initiated change; 'program_enrollment' indicates enrollment in SNAP, WIC, or pharmacy program; 'inactivity' indicates a lapse-based re-segmentation.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Segmentation Governance Policy; NCR POS – Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment assignment record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Tracks updates such as status changes, expiry date extensions, or confidence score refreshes. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 – Audit Trail Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: preference
products.description: Comprehensive single source of truth for all shopper preferences and dietary profiles — both declared and inferred — across all dimensions. No other product in this domain stores dietary, lifestyle, or shopping preference data. Covers dietary restrictions (nut allergy, lactose intolerance, celiac/gluten-free), lifestyle diet types (vegan, vegetarian, keto, paleo, Mediterranean), nutritional goals (low sodium, low sugar, high protein), certification preferences (organic, non-GMO, USDA certified), shopping preferences (preferred store, preferred pickup vs. delivery, preferred shopping day/time), communication preferences (email frequency, push notification topics), and product category affinities. Captures preference source (self-declared via app, inferred from purchase history), confidence level, and last updated timestamp. Feeds the personalization engine in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and supports digital commerce product filtering for health-conscious shopping features.

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shopper preference record in the Grocery customer preference data product. Serves as the primary key for all preference-related joins and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Category-level shopper preference drives personalization engines, targeted promotions, and assortment decisions in retail-grocery (e.g., organic Produce preference, Dairy avoidance). product_category_

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: PROMOTION: Department‑level preference allows personalized promotions and shelf‑stock decisions per department.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.household. Business justification: Household-level preferences are a distinct and important concept in grocery retail — dietary restrictions for the whole household, preferred fulfillment channel for household deliveries, private label

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_item. Business justification: Personalized marketing uses shopper product preferences; linking preferences to product items enables recommendation engines and targeted promotions.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program enrollment record associated with this preference, when the preference was inferred from or is linked to loyalty program behavior. Enables correlation between loyalty tier, points activity, and preference evolution for CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) analytics.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration; Internal Loyalty Program Management

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper or household account that owns this preference record. Links to the customer master in the Customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Customer Profile Object

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper's preferred physical store location for in-store shopping, pickup, or click-and-collect fulfillment. Used by the personalization engine to surface store-specific promotions, ad circulars, and inventory availability. Links to the Store domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Store Locator; NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: certification_preference
attributes.description: Specifies a product certification standard that the shopper prefers when purchasing. Used to filter product catalog results in digital commerce and to drive assortment recommendations. Aligns with USDA organic certification and GS1 product attribute standards. Null for non-certification preference categories.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GS1 Global Product Classification

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: A numeric score between 0.0000 and 1.0000 representing the system's confidence in the accuracy of an inferred preference. A score of 1.0000 indicates a self-declared preference with full certainty. Lower scores indicate inferred preferences with varying degrees of certainty. Used by the personalization engine to weight recommendations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework; Internal AI/ML Model Governance

attributes.name: consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has provided explicit consent for Grocery to collect, store, and use their preference data for personalization and targeted marketing purposes. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance. When FALSE, preference data must not be used for marketing purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100; FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shopper provided or last renewed consent for preference data collection and use. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the privacy policy or consent notice under which the shopper's preference consent was collected (e.g., 'v2.1'). Enables compliance teams to identify shoppers who consented under older policy versions and trigger re-consent workflows when policies are updated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100; FTC Privacy Policy Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this preference record was first created in the system. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and GDPR data subject access request (DSAR) responses.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dietary_restriction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of a dietary restriction preference. 'allergy' indicates a medically significant food allergy. 'intolerance' indicates a food sensitivity. 'medical' indicates a clinically prescribed dietary requirement. 'religious' indicates a faith-based dietary rule (e.g., kosher, halal). 'ethical' indicates a values-based choice (e.g., vegan). 'lifestyle' indicates a personal wellness choice (e.g., keto). Null for non-dietary preference categories.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA); USDA Organic Certification Standards

attributes.name: ebt_eligible_filter
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Eligible Filter Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has enabled the EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) eligible product filter in their digital commerce experience. When TRUE, product search and browse results are filtered to show only EBT-eligible items. Supports SNAP/WIC program compliance in the digital channel.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service — SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Filtering

attributes.name: email_frequency_preference
attributes.description: The shopper's declared preference for how often they wish to receive promotional email communications, including ad circulars and personalized offers. Governs email suppression logic in the CRM platform. Null for non-communication preference categories.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 7 (Consent); Salesforce Commerce Cloud — CRM Integration

attributes.name: inference_model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the machine learning model used to infer this preference from purchase history or behavioral data (e.g., 'v1.3.2'). Null for self-declared preferences. Enables model governance, A/B testing of inference models, and rollback of preferences generated by deprecated model versions.
attributes.references: Internal AI/ML Model Governance; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Engine

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record is currently active and should be applied in personalization, product filtering, and marketing targeting. Set to FALSE when a shopper removes or overrides a preference.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Customer Profile Management

attributes.name: is_allergy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference represents a food allergy or intolerance (e.g., nut allergy, lactose intolerance, celiac/gluten-free). When TRUE, this preference is treated with elevated priority in product filtering and warning displays to protect shopper safety. Aligns with FDA food allergen labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA); FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this preference record was most recently modified, either by the shopper or by the inference engine. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to identify stale inferred preferences that may need re-evaluation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Customer Profile Management; GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation)

attributes.name: lifestyle_diet_type
attributes.description: Identifies the shopper's declared or inferred lifestyle diet pattern. Used to curate personalized product recommendations, recipe suggestions, and category affinities in the digital commerce experience. Null for non-lifestyle preference categories.
attributes.references: USDA Dietary Guidelines for Americans; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context or clarification about this preference record, entered by a customer service associate or captured from a shopper survey. Examples include specific allergen details beyond the standard type codes, or nuanced dietary requirements not covered by enumerated fields.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Service Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Customer Profile Management

attributes.name: nutritional_goal_type
attributes.description: Specifies the primary nutritional goal the shopper is pursuing. Used to filter product catalog results and surface nutritionally aligned products in digital commerce. Aligns with FDA nutrition labeling standards. Null for non-nutritional preference categories.
attributes.references: FDA Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA); FDA Food Labeling Regulations (21 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why a preference was overridden. Populated when preference_status is 'overridden', typically when a self-declared preference supersedes an inferred one, or when a customer service associate corrects a preference on behalf of the shopper. Supports audit and data quality review.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 22 (Automated Decision-Making)

attributes.name: personalization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record is currently eligible to be consumed by the Salesforce Commerce Cloud personalization engine for product recommendations, digital commerce filtering, and targeted marketing. May be FALSE if consent is withdrawn, the preference is expired, or the confidence score is below the minimum threshold.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework; GDPR Article 22 (Automated Decision-Making)

attributes.name: preference_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping that classifies the type of preference being recorded. Drives routing to the correct personalization engine module in Salesforce Commerce Cloud. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dietary|lifestyle|nutritional_goal|certification|shopping|communication|product_affinity — promote to reference product if additional categories are added]

attributes.name: preference_source
attributes.description: Indicates how this preference was captured. 'self_declared' means the shopper explicitly set it via the app or web profile. 'purchase_inferred' means it was derived from POS transaction history. 'loyalty_inferred' means it was derived from loyalty program behavior. 'app_behavior' means it was inferred from digital browsing or filtering actions in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation)

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the preference record. 'active' means the preference is in use by the personalization engine. 'inactive' means the shopper has disabled it. 'pending_review' means the inferred preference awaits confidence threshold validation. 'overridden' means a self-declared preference has superseded an inferred one. 'expired' means the preference has passed its validity window.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Customer Profile Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: preference_type
attributes.description: Specific preference dimension within the category (e.g., 'nut_allergy', 'gluten_free', 'vegan', 'keto', 'low_sodium', 'organic', 'preferred_store', 'email_frequency', 'produce_affinity'). Granular discriminator used by the personalization engine for product filtering and targeted marketing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nut_allergy|lactose_intolerance|gluten_free|vegan|vegetarian|keto|paleo|mediterranean|low_sodium|low_sugar|high_protein|organic|non_gmo|usda_certified|preferred_store|preferred_fulfillment|preferred_day|preferred_time|email_frequency|push_notification|category_affinity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Preference Taxonomy; FDA Food Labeling Regulations

attributes.name: preference_value
attributes.description: The declared or inferred value for this preference dimension. For boolean preferences (e.g., nut allergy) this is 'true' or 'false'; for enumerated preferences (e.g., preferred fulfillment) this is the selected option (e.g., 'pickup', 'delivery'); for affinity scores this is a numeric string. Flexible string to accommodate all preference types.

attributes.name: preferred_fulfillment_method
attributes.description: The shopper's preferred method for receiving their grocery orders. 'pickup' refers to curbside or in-store order collection. 'click_and_collect' refers to online order with in-store pickup. Feeds the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management System (OMS) default fulfillment selection and Last Mile Delivery (LMD) routing. Null for non-shopping preference categories.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management System (OMS); Internal Omnichannel Fulfillment Standards

attributes.name: preferred_shopping_day
attributes.description: The day of the week the shopper most prefers to shop, either declared via app profile or inferred from POS transaction history. Used to time promotional communications (ad circulars, push notifications) and to optimize pickup/delivery slot recommendations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework; NCR POS Systems — Transaction History

attributes.name: preferred_shopping_time
attributes.description: The time-of-day window the shopper most prefers to shop, either declared or inferred from purchase history. Used to schedule push notifications and delivery/pickup slot suggestions. Complements preferred_shopping_day for precise timing of personalized outreach.

attributes.name: private_label_preference
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has a declared or inferred preference for Grocery's private-label (store-owned brand) products over national CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) brands. Used to surface private-label alternatives in product recommendations and to support private-label brand development analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Private Label Brand Management; Internal Private Label Strategy

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has opted in to receive push notifications via the Grocery mobile app. When TRUE, the shopper is eligible to receive personalized push alerts for promotions, order status updates, and loyalty rewards. Governed by mobile consent regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Mobile Push Notification Module

attributes.name: push_notification_topics
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of push notification topic categories the shopper has opted into (e.g., 'promotions,order_updates,loyalty_rewards,weekly_ad'). Allows granular control over notification content beyond the binary opt-in flag. Managed via the Salesforce Commerce Cloud personalization module.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework

attributes.name: snap_wic_participant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) / Women Infants and Children (WIC) Participant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper participates in SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) or WIC (Women Infants and Children) federal benefit programs. When TRUE, the personalization engine surfaces SNAP/WIC-eligible products and EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) payment options. Treated as confidential due to program participation sensitivity.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service — SNAP Program Regulations (7 CFR Part 271); USDA WIC Program Regulations (7 CFR Part 246)

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The digital or physical channel through which this preference was captured or inferred. Distinguishes between mobile app self-declaration, web profile updates, in-store kiosk entry, POS transaction inference, and loyalty portal updates. Used for channel attribution in preference data quality reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile_app|web|in_store_kiosk|associate_entry|pos|loyalty_portal|survey — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Omnichannel Framework; NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date after which this preference record is no longer valid and should be excluded from personalization logic. Null indicates an open-ended preference with no expiry. Supports temporary dietary restrictions, seasonal preferences, and time-limited program participation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which this preference record is considered valid and should be applied in personalization and product filtering. Supports time-bounded preferences such as seasonal dietary goals or temporary dietary restrictions.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Framework

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Tracks shopper enrollment in government assistance and special benefit programs including SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women Infants and Children), and EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer). Captures program type, enrollment status (active, pending, expired, denied), enrollment date, expiry date, issuing agency, benefit card number (tokenized), monthly benefit amount, and verification document reference. Critical for POS tender eligibility and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each benefit program enrollment record. Primary key for the benefit_enrollment data product in the customer domain.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: SNAP/WIC government reimbursement accounting requires each benefit enrollment type to post to a specific GL account. Grocery retailers must reconcile benefit redemptions against GL accounts for USDA/F

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.household. Business justification: SNAP and WIC benefits are fundamentally household-based programs — SNAP eligibility is determined at the household level (snap_household_size is already an attribute on customer_benefit_enrollment). A

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: SNAP/WIC benefit enrollments integrate with loyalty at POS for benefit-eligible points earning and EBT tender rules. A direct FK from benefit enrollment to loyalty membership enables the loyalty engin

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper enrolled in the benefit program. Links this enrollment to the shopper master record in the customer domain.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grocery store location where the shopper primarily redeems their benefit program. Used for store-level benefit redemption analytics, USDA FNS authorized retailer reporting, and targeted in-store program support.
attributes.references: USDA FNS Retailer Authorization Requirements; Internal Store Operations Standard

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.tender_type. Business justification: EBT/SNAP/WIC benefit enrollments map directly to specific POS tender types in grocery retail. The POS system must resolve which tender_type corresponds to a benefit enrollment to authorize transaction

attributes.name: appeal_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which the shopper must file a formal appeal with the issuing agency if the enrollment was denied or suspended. Populated when enrollment_status is denied or suspended. Supports shopper advocacy and regulatory fair hearing compliance.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.15 (SNAP Fair Hearings); State Agency Appeal Regulations

attributes.name: authorized_retailer_number
attributes.description: USDA FNS-assigned retailer authorization number for the grocery store location where the benefit is redeemable. Required for SNAP and WIC regulatory compliance reporting and EBT transaction settlement with the state processor.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 278 (Retailer Authorization); FNS Retailer Management System

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has consented to automatic recertification or renewal processing for this benefit enrollment where permitted by the issuing agency. Supports streamlined recertification workflows and reduces benefit lapse rates.
attributes.references: USDA FNS Simplified Reporting Requirements; State Agency Recertification Rules

attributes.name: balance_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent synchronization of the benefit_balance field with the state EBT processor or WIC management information system. Indicates data freshness for POS eligibility decisions.
attributes.references: USDA FNS EBT Technical Standards; State EBT Processor Interface Requirements

attributes.name: benefit_balance
attributes.description: Current remaining benefit balance available on the shopper's EBT or WIC benefit account as of the last synchronization with the state EBT processor. Used for POS tender limit enforcement and shopper balance inquiry support.
attributes.references: USDA FNS EBT Technical Standards; State EBT Processor Interface Requirements

attributes.name: benefit_card_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the EBT or WIC benefit card number, retained for customer service identification and POS receipt display purposes. Not sufficient to reconstruct the full card number.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; USDA FNS EBT Technical Standards

attributes.name: benefit_card_token
attributes.description: Tokenized representation of the shopper's EBT or WIC benefit card number. The actual card number is never stored; only the secure token is retained for POS tender matching and transaction reconciliation. Tokenization complies with PCI DSS and state EBT security requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; USDA FNS EBT Technical Standards; State EBT Processor Requirements

attributes.name: benefit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the benefit amount (typically USD for US government programs). Supports multi-currency readiness for future program expansions.

attributes.name: categorical_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper qualifies for the benefit program through categorical eligibility (i.e., automatic eligibility based on participation in another qualifying program such as TANF or SSI) rather than through standard income and resource testing. Simplifies eligibility determination and reduces documentation burden.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.2(j) (SNAP Categorical Eligibility)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the data platform. Represents the audit trail creation event for the Silver Layer record, aligned with ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized agency-issued code indicating the reason an enrollment application was denied or an active enrollment was suspended. Populated only when enrollment_status is denied or suspended. Used for regulatory reporting and shopper appeals support. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: income_exceeds_limit|residency_not_verified|identity_not_verified|incomplete_application|duplicate_enrollment|ineligible_category|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.15 (SNAP Fair Hearings); State Agency Denial Codes

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the shopper completed the benefit program enrollment process. Supports omnichannel analytics and process optimization for enrollment workflows.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the shopper was officially enrolled and approved into the benefit program by the issuing agency. Represents the effective start of benefit eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 271; State Agency Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known enrollment reference number assigned by the issuing government agency or program administrator. Used for cross-referencing with agency records and POS tender eligibility lookups.
attributes.references: USDA FNS Program Regulations; State Agency Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit program enrollment. Active indicates the shopper is currently eligible; pending indicates application submitted but not yet approved; expired indicates the benefit period has lapsed; denied indicates the application was rejected by the issuing agency; suspended indicates temporary hold by the agency.
attributes.references: USDA FNS Program Regulations; State Board of Social Services

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the current benefit enrollment period expires and the shopper must re-certify or re-enroll to maintain eligibility. Null for open-ended enrollments. Critical for POS tender eligibility validation.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 271; USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246

attributes.name: income_eligibility_level
attributes.description: Federal Poverty Level (FPL) income bracket certified by the issuing agency at the time of enrollment. Determines benefit amount tiers and program eligibility thresholds. Expressed as a percentage range of the Federal Poverty Level per USDA FNS guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.9 (SNAP Income Standards); USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246.7 (WIC Income Standards)

attributes.name: issuing_agency_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the government agency that issued the benefit enrollment. Aligns with USDA FNS state agency codes and enables automated agency-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USDA FNS State Agency Codes; FNS Handbook 901

attributes.name: issuing_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or authorized body that issued and administers the benefit enrollment (e.g., state Department of Social Services, county health department, USDA FNS regional office). Used for regulatory reporting and agency reconciliation.
attributes.references: USDA FNS; State Department of Social Services

attributes.name: issuing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-2 US state code of the government agency that issued the benefit enrollment. Supports state-level regulatory compliance reporting and cross-state benefit portability tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; USDA FNS State Agency Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this benefit enrollment record in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: monthly_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of government assistance benefits allocated to the shopper per calendar month. Used for POS tender limit enforcement, financial reconciliation with USDA FNS, and regulatory reporting on benefit utilization.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 274 (EBT); USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246 (WIC)

attributes.name: notification_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has consented to receive benefit-related notifications (e.g., expiry reminders, recertification alerts, balance updates) via their preferred communication channel. Supports CRM-driven benefit engagement campaigns.
attributes.references: FTC CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; Internal Customer Communication Policy

attributes.name: pos_tender_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment record currently qualifies the shopper to use the associated benefit card as a valid tender type at the NCR POS system. Derived from enrollment_status and expiry_date but stored as an operational flag for real-time POS eligibility checks.
attributes.references: USDA FNS EBT Retailer Requirements; NCR POS Integration Standards

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the government assistance or special benefit program in which the shopper is enrolled. SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women, Infants, and Children), EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer), TANF (Temporary Assistance for Needy Families), MEDICAID. Drives POS tender eligibility rules at checkout.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 271 (SNAP); USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246 (WIC); FTC Pricing Compliance

attributes.name: recertification_date
attributes.description: Date by which the shopper must complete recertification with the issuing agency to maintain uninterrupted benefit eligibility. Used to trigger proactive outreach and prevent benefit lapses.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273 (SNAP Recertification); USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246 (WIC)

attributes.name: snap_household_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the shopper's household as certified by the issuing agency for SNAP benefit calculation purposes. Directly determines the monthly SNAP allotment amount. Applicable only when program_type is SNAP.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.1 (SNAP Household Definition)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this benefit enrollment record was ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across NCR POS, Salesforce CRM, agency portal feeds, and EBT processor interfaces.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage and Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shopper's eligibility documents were verified and approved by the issuing agency or authorized grocery program administrator. Establishes the audit trail for enrollment approval.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.2; USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246.7

attributes.name: verification_doc_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier pointing to the document management system record containing the eligibility verification documents submitted by the shopper (e.g., income verification, residency proof, identity documents). Supports audit trails for regulatory compliance without storing document content in the data lakehouse.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.2 (SNAP Eligibility Verification); USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246.7 (WIC Verification)

attributes.name: verification_doc_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary eligibility verification document type submitted by the shopper during enrollment. Used for compliance audit reporting and document completeness checks.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 273.2; USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246.7

attributes.name: wic_food_package_code
attributes.description: USDA-assigned food package code designating the specific WIC food package category the shopper qualifies for (e.g., Package A for infants, Package D for women). Determines which product SKUs are WIC-eligible at POS. Applicable only when program_type is WIC.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246.10; WIC Food Package Regulations

attributes.name: wic_participant_category
attributes.description: USDA WIC participant category classifying the shopper's eligibility basis within the WIC program. Determines food package entitlements and benefit amounts. Applicable only when program_type is WIC.
attributes.references: USDA FNS 7 CFR Part 246.7; WIC Eligibility Categories

products.name: pharmacy_patient
products.description: Non-PHI patient profile for shoppers who use Grocery pharmacy services. Captures patient reference to the shopper master, preferred pharmacy store, primary care physician name, allergy flags (non-clinical, self-reported), preferred contact method for Rx notifications, auto-refill opt-in status, medication synchronization (MedSync) enrollment, and patient counseling preference. Intentionally excludes all HIPAA-protected health information (PHI) — clinical data resides in McKesson Pharmacy Systems. Links to the shopper master via shopper_id.

attributes.name: pharmacy_patient_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pharmacy patient profile record in the Grocery lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a long-running enrollment/registration relationship between a shopper and Grocery pharmacy services.

attributes.name: insurance_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.insurance_plan. Business justification: Insurance verification and adjudication: pharmacy_patient stores insurance_bin_number, insurance_group_number, insurance_pcn, insurance_plan_name as denormalized plain attributes. Normalizing to a pro

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: Pharmacy POS rx-points earning requires direct resolution of the loyalty membership account for a patient. The loyalty_rx_points_eligible flag on pharmacy_patient implies membership-level crediting. A

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Grocery store location where the patient prefers to fill prescriptions. Used for routing Rx notifications, staffing, and inventory planning at the pharmacy counter.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Store Master

attributes.name: primary_care_prescriber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prescriber. Business justification: Care coordination and e-prescribing: pharmacy_patient stores primary_care_physician_name and primary_care_physician_phone as denormalized plain attributes. Linking to prescriber via primary_care_presc

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.rx_patient. Business justification: Patient identity reconciliation: the grocery CRM's pharmacy_patient record must link to the pharmacy system's rx_patient to synchronize HIPAA consent, allergy flags, counseling preferences, and MedSyn

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper master record in the customer domain. Links the pharmacy patient profile to the unified shopper identity. Every pharmacy patient must have a corresponding shopper record.

attributes.name: allergy_disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient most recently disclosed or updated their self-reported allergy information with pharmacy staff. Nullable when allergy_flag is False. Used to prompt periodic allergy review during counseling.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164); State Boards of Pharmacy — Allergy Review Standards

attributes.name: allergy_flag
attributes.description: Non-clinical, self-reported indicator that the patient has disclosed one or more drug or food allergies to pharmacy staff. This is a flag only — clinical allergy details reside in McKesson Pharmacy Systems and are excluded from this non-PHI profile per HIPAA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164) — PHI Exclusion; McKesson Pharmacy Systems — Allergy Profile

attributes.name: auto_refill_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient provided or last updated consent for the auto-refill program. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance. Nullable when auto_refill_opt_in is False.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy — Informed Consent Requirements

attributes.name: auto_refill_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has opted into the automatic prescription refill program. When True, eligible maintenance medications are automatically queued for refill before the supply runs out. Drives CAO (Computer-Assisted Ordering) logic for pharmacy inventory.

attributes.name: counseling_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred method for receiving pharmacist counseling when picking up a new or changed prescription. 'waived' indicates the patient has formally declined counseling. Required by OBRA-90 regulations for Medicaid patients; captured for all patients as best practice.
attributes.references: OBRA-90 (Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1990) — Pharmacist Counseling Requirements; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: counseling_waiver_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient most recently waived pharmacist counseling. Nullable when counseling_preference is not 'waived'. Supports compliance audit trail for OBRA-90 and State Board of Pharmacy inspections.
attributes.references: OBRA-90; State Boards of Pharmacy — Counseling Waiver Documentation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pharmacy patient profile record was first created in the Grocery lakehouse Silver layer. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record retention scheduling.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Internal Controls; HIPAA Privacy Rule — Record Retention

attributes.name: delivery_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for prescription home delivery. Captured separately from the shopper's primary address to support patients who require delivery to a different location (e.g., workplace, caregiver address). Used by LMD (Last Mile Delivery) routing.
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management — Address Validation; HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164) — Minimum Necessary Standard

attributes.name: delivery_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for prescription home delivery (apartment, suite, unit number). Nullable. Complements delivery_address_line1 for complete delivery address specification.

attributes.name: delivery_city
attributes.description: City component of the prescription home delivery address. Used for LMD (Last Mile Delivery) zone assignment and carrier routing.

attributes.name: delivery_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the prescription home delivery address. Used for delivery zone mapping, carrier selection, and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: USPS — ZIP Code Standard; JDA Transportation Management

attributes.name: delivery_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the prescription home delivery address. Used for carrier zone assignment and state-level pharmacy licensing compliance verification.
attributes.references: USPS — State Abbreviation Standard; State Boards of Pharmacy — Interstate Delivery Regulations

attributes.name: disenrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy patient profile was deactivated or the patient relationship ended. Nullable for currently active patients. Used for record retention scheduling and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy — Patient Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shopper was first registered as a pharmacy patient at Grocery. Marks the effective start of the pharmacy patient relationship. Used for tenure analysis and loyalty program integration.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy — Patient Registration Requirements

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Patient Guardian or Authorized Representative Name
attributes.description: Full name of the legally authorized representative or guardian for patients who cannot consent on their own behalf (e.g., pediatric patients, patients with power of attorney arrangements). Non-PHI reference field. Nullable for adult patients without a designated representative.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.502(g)) — Personal Representatives; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: guardian_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the authorized representative or guardian to the pharmacy patient. Used to validate authorization for prescription pickup and counseling consent. Nullable when no guardian is on file.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.502(g)); State Boards of Pharmacy — Authorized Representative Policies

attributes.name: hipaa_acknowledgment_channel
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices Acknowledgment Channel
attributes.description: Method by which the patient acknowledged the HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices. Supports audit trail for HIPAA compliance. 'verbal_noted' is used when the patient verbally acknowledged but declined to sign, per HIPAA good-faith effort documentation requirements.

attributes.name: hipaa_acknowledgment_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices Acknowledgment Date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient acknowledged receipt of the HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices. Nullable when hipaa_notice_acknowledged is False. Required for HIPAA compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: hipaa_notice_acknowledged
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices Acknowledgment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has acknowledged receipt of the pharmacy's HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices (NPP). Required by HIPAA Privacy Rule for all new pharmacy patients. Pharmacies must make a good-faith effort to obtain written acknowledgment.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.520) — Notice of Privacy Practices

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred language for pharmacy communications, prescription labels, and counseling materials. Stored as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-TW'). Used to route multilingual pharmacy staff and generate translated prescription materials per FDA labeling guidance.
attributes.references: FDA — Prescription Drug Labeling; Title VI of the Civil Rights Act — Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: last_rx_fill_date
attributes.description: Date of the patient's most recent prescription fill at any Grocery pharmacy location. Non-PHI operational field used for patient activity monitoring, inactive patient identification, and MedSync scheduling. Sourced from McKesson Pharmacy Systems.
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems — Prescription Fill History

attributes.name: loyalty_rx_points_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Loyalty Prescription (Rx) Points Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is eligible to earn loyalty program points for qualifying prescription fills. Integrates pharmacy activity with the Grocery loyalty program managed via NCR POS Systems and CRM. Certain prescription categories (e.g., controlled substances) may be ineligible per program rules.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration; Grocery Loyalty Program Terms

attributes.name: mckesson_patient_code
attributes.description: External patient identifier assigned by McKesson Pharmacy Systems (the operational system of record for prescription management). Used to cross-reference non-PHI profile data in the lakehouse with clinical records in McKesson. Required for operational reconciliation.

attributes.name: medsync_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is enrolled in the Medication Synchronization (MedSync) program, which aligns all of the patient's maintenance prescriptions to a single monthly pickup date. Improves adherence and reduces pharmacy counter traffic variability.
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems — MedSync Program; NCPA Medication Synchronization Guidelines

attributes.name: medsync_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient was enrolled in the MedSync program. Used for program tenure tracking and cohort analysis. Nullable when medsync_enrolled is False.

attributes.name: medsync_sync_date
attributes.description: The designated monthly calendar date on which all synchronized prescriptions for this patient are scheduled for pickup or delivery. Nullable when medsync_enrolled is False. Used for pharmacy workload planning and inventory pre-positioning.

attributes.name: n340b_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is eligible for the 340B Drug Pricing Program, which provides discounted outpatient drugs to qualifying patients of covered entities. Non-PHI eligibility flag used for claims routing and pricing.
attributes.references: HRSA (Health Resources and Services Administration) — 340B Drug Pricing Program; 42 U.S.C. § 256b

attributes.name: patient_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pharmacy patient profile. 'active' indicates the patient is actively using Grocery pharmacy services. 'inactive' indicates no recent activity. 'on_hold' indicates a temporary suspension of services. 'transferred' indicates the patient has moved to another pharmacy. 'deceased' is set upon notification of patient death for record retention compliance.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy — Patient Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: patient_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmacy patient by service type. 'retail' is the standard in-store patient. 'mail_order' indicates the patient primarily uses mail-order fulfillment. 'specialty' indicates enrollment in specialty pharmacy programs for high-cost or complex medications. 'long_term_care' indicates a patient in a care facility. 'pediatric' indicates a minor patient with a guardian on file.
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems — Patient Classification; NCPDP — Patient Type Codes

attributes.name: rx_notification_channel
attributes.description: Patient's preferred communication channel for prescription-related notifications, including ready-for-pickup alerts, refill reminders, and drug interaction notices. Drives outbound messaging routing in McKesson and NCR POS Systems.
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems — Patient Communication Preferences

attributes.name: rx_ready_pickup_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred method for collecting ready prescriptions. Supports omnichannel fulfillment including in-store counter, curbside pickup (Click-and-Collect), drive-through pharmacy window, and home delivery. Drives OMS (Order Management System) routing for pharmacy fulfillment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; McKesson Pharmacy Systems — Fulfillment Preferences

attributes.name: snap_benefit_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Benefit Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has been identified as eligible for SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits, which may affect OTC product eligibility at the pharmacy counter. Non-PHI flag aligned with the shopper master SNAP eligibility field.
attributes.references: USDA — SNAP Program Regulations (7 CFR Part 278)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the pharmacy patient profile record in the Grocery lakehouse Silver layer. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Internal Controls; HIPAA Privacy Rule — Record Retention

attributes.name: wic_benefit_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) Benefit Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has been identified as eligible for WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program benefits, which may affect eligible OTC and formula purchases at the pharmacy counter. Non-PHI flag.
attributes.references: USDA — WIC Program Regulations (7 CFR Part 246)

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Authoritative single source of truth for all shopper consent decisions, privacy preferences, communication suppressions, and opt-out state. No other product in this domain stores consent or suppression data. Captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing with CPG partners, personalization, analytics, direct mail), consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent and withdrawal dates, consent source (app, web, in-store kiosk, call center), consent version (legal text version), and device/IP context. Owns the suppression list for shoppers excluded from specific communication types due to opt-out requests, legal holds, deceased status, or fraud flags — including suppression type (global opt-out, email, SMS, direct mail, third-party sharing), suppression reason codes, effective/expiry dates, and triggering source system. Supports CCPA, CAN-SPAM, and TCPA compliance for all outbound marketing and data sharing activities.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent record. Primary key for the consent_record data product in the customer domain.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.household. Business justification: Household-level consent is a distinct and important concept — a household may have a shared communication opt-in for direct mail, household-level loyalty program consent, or a household-wide suppressi

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: GDPR/CCPA consent records must identify the data-controller legal entity responsible for processing. Multi-banner grocery operators (each banner a separate legal entity) require this for regulatory au

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: Loyalty communication consent (loyalty_program_consent flag on consent_record) must be tracked at membership level for GDPR/CCPA compliance. When a shopper withdraws consent for a specific loyalty pro

attributes.name: previous_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the prior consent record that this record supersedes or replaces. Enables consent history chain reconstruction for audit and regulatory investigation purposes. Null for the initial consent record.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: GDPR/CCPA require campaign-specific consent records for targeted marketing promotions. Grocery retailers must demonstrate that a shopper consented to a specific campaign's personalized targeting. cons

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper whose consent decision this record captures. Links to the customer.shopper master record.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: HIPAA and CCPA compliance audits require knowing the physical store location where consent was obtained (e.g., pharmacy counter, customer service desk, in-store kiosk). Regulatory traceability of cons

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. Business justification: Wholesale accounts require consent management for data sharing, marketing communications, and regulatory compliance (CCPA, GDPR for business contacts). A wholesale account may have multiple consent re

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason explaining why this consent record was created or modified. Supports audit trails and compliance investigations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shopper_request|legal_text_update|regulatory_mandate|system_migration|fraud_investigation|deceased_notification|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the shopper granted consent for the specified consent type. Serves as the authoritative timestamp for consent activation and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this consent record is scheduled to expire and require renewal. Null for indefinite consents. Supports re-consent campaign triggers and ensures consent currency for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: The IETF BCP 47 language code representing the language in which the consent notice was presented to the shopper (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-TW'). Supports multilingual compliance and ensures consent was presented in the shopper's preferred language.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint through which the shopper provided or withdrew consent. Used for compliance auditing and channel attribution. Includes digital (app, web), physical (in-store kiosk, POS), and assisted (call center, paper form) channels.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this consent record. Indicates whether the shopper has actively granted, withdrawn, or is pending confirmation of consent for the specified consent type.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The category of consent being captured. Defines the specific communication channel or data-use purpose for which the shopper has provided or withdrawn consent. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketing_email|sms|push_notification|direct_mail|data_sharing_cpg|personalization|analytics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the legal consent text or privacy notice that the shopper agreed to at the time of consent. Enables tracking of which version of terms was in effect and supports re-consent workflows when legal text changes.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for the Silver Layer record. Distinct from consent_date which captures the real-world business event time.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: crm_contact_code
attributes.description: The external identifier for this shopper in the Salesforce CRM system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the consent_record data product and the CRM platform's consent and suppression management modules.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management and Personalization Module

attributes.name: data_sharing_partner_code
attributes.description: Identifies the specific Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) partner or third-party organization with whom shopper data may be shared under this consent record. Applicable only when consent_type is 'data_sharing_cpg'. Null for all other consent types.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the shopper when providing or withdrawing consent. Captured for regulatory audit context and digital channel analytics. Null for non-digital consent sources. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile_ios|mobile_android|desktop|tablet|kiosk|pos_terminal|unknown — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: double_opt_in_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper completed a double opt-in confirmation step (e.g., clicked a confirmation link in a verification email or SMS) for this consent record. Relevant for email and SMS marketing consent under CAN-SPAM and TCPA best practices.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: double_opt_in_date
attributes.description: The date and time when the shopper completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double_opt_in_confirmed is false or not applicable for the consent type.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: guardian_relationship
attributes.description: Describes the relationship of the consenting adult to the minor shopper when minor_guardian_consent is true. Null for adult shoppers. Required for COPPA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device from which the shopper submitted their consent decision. Captured for regulatory proof-of-consent and fraud detection. Null for non-digital consent sources. May be considered PII under CCPA.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: is_suppressed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shopper is currently on the suppression list for the associated consent type. When true, the shopper must be excluded from all outbound communications of the corresponding type regardless of other consent flags.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction under which this consent record is governed. Determines which privacy regulations apply (e.g., CCPA for California residents, state-level privacy laws for other states). Drives jurisdiction-specific consent logic and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US-CA|US-VA|US-CO|US-CT|US-UT|US-FED|OTHER — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); State Privacy Laws

attributes.name: loyalty_program_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has consented to the use of their loyalty program transaction data (purchase history, points activity) for personalization and targeted marketing purposes. Distinct from general analytics consent.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: minor_guardian_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent was provided by a parent or legal guardian on behalf of a minor shopper. Relevant for COPPA compliance when the shopper is under 13 years of age.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: proof_of_consent_reference
attributes.description: An external reference identifier (e.g., document ID, screenshot hash, call recording ID, or form submission ID) that serves as auditable proof of the consent event. Supports regulatory investigations and legal hold processes.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: re_consent_requested_date
attributes.description: The date on which a re-consent request was sent to the shopper. Null if no re-consent request has been issued. Used to track re-consent campaign outreach and measure response rates.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: re_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record requires re-confirmation from the shopper, typically triggered by a legal text version change, consent expiry, or regulatory update. Drives re-consent campaign targeting in CRM.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The primary regulatory framework governing this consent record. Enables framework-specific compliance reporting and audit queries. A single consent record may be governed by one primary framework even if multiple apply.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this consent record. Supports data lineage tracking and cross-system reconciliation. Aligns with the operational systems of record in the Grocery enterprise architecture. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|ncr_pos|sfcc|mckesson|call_center|manual|loyalty_app|web_portal — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
