attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: suppression_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suppression became active for this shopper and consent type. Used to determine when outbound communications must cease. Null when is_suppressed is false.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: suppression_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suppression is scheduled to expire, if applicable. Null for permanent suppressions (e.g., deceased, fraud flag). Enables automated re-activation of communication eligibility after temporary suppression periods.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: suppression_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the shopper was added to the suppression list. Supports compliance reporting and operational triage. Null when is_suppressed is false.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act; FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: suppression_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that triggered or originated the suppression event. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and cross-system reconciliation for compliance investigations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|ncr_pos|mckesson|sfcc|call_center|manual|legal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: suppression_type
attributes.description: The specific communication channel or data-use category for which the shopper is suppressed. Null when is_suppressed is false. Drives suppression list filtering in outbound marketing execution systems.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the shopper withdrew or revoked consent for the specified consent type. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Required for CCPA opt-out audit trails.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act); CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative catalog of all sellable items including CPG products, private-label brands, fresh produce, pharmacy drug items, and fuel grades. Manages SKU, UPC, GTIN, PLU codes, product hierarchies, categories, attributes, nutritional information, and regulatory compliance flags. Supports planogram design, category management, and FDA labeling requirements.
domains.references: GS1 GTIN Standards, FDA Food Labeling Requirements

products.name: order_header
products.description: Master record for every customer purchase across all channels (in-store POS, online, click-and-collect, curbside pickup, last-mile delivery, and pharmacy Rx fills). Captures order number, channel type, register/lane (for POS), cashier (for POS), transaction type (sale, return, void, no-sale for POS), order date/time, order status lifecycle (placed, confirmed, in-fulfillment, ready, dispatched, delivered, cancelled), customer reference, store reference, total amounts, subtotal, tax, tender summary, change due (for POS), basket item count, loyalty card scanned flag, loyalty points earned, promo codes applied, special instructions, self-checkout flag, EBT/SNAP/WIC tender flag, source system (NCR POS / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / McKesson), payment method summary, and OMS order reference. Single source of truth for ALL customer purchase identity in the retail-grocery enterprise — encompasses both POS transactions and OMS-originated orders in one canonical entity. No separate POS transaction entity exists; channel-specific attributes are captured via channel type discriminator and nullable POS-specific fields.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for every customer purchase record across all channels (POS, online, click-and-collect, curbside pickup, last-mile delivery, pharmacy Rx fills). Primary key of the order_header entity and the single canonical identity for all customer transactions in the enterprise.

attributes.name: ad_circular_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.ad_circular. Business justification: Grocery retailers measure ad circular ROI by attributing transactions to the specific circular that drove the visit. order_header.ad_circular_week is a denormalized reference; a proper FK to ad_circul

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost center assignment enables internal cost allocation and budgeting reports per order, a standard practice in grocery chains.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: For omnichannel orders, the fulfillment node (dark store, DC, or store backroom) may differ from the store_location_id. Attributing orders to their fulfillment node is essential for node-level order v

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue GL account needed for GAAP sales reporting; each order must post revenue to a specific GL account, obvious to finance analysts.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer household entity for household-level purchase analytics, loyalty program household linking, and targeted promotions. Enables household basket analysis and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) calculations at the household level. Null for anonymous transactions.
attributes.references: CRM; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Customer Loyalty Program

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Identifies the corporate legal entity owning the store for consolidation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: REQUIRED: Loyalty reporting needs to tie each order to the shopper's membership to calculate points earned, tier changes, and generate the 'Points Earned per Order' report.

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_method. Business justification: Order‑level reference to the tokenized payment method allows reporting of payment method usage per order and supports refunds to the original method.

attributes.name: primary_order_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Links each order to its fiscal period, enabling period‑based financial statements and variance analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit center linkage supports profitability analysis by store/region; required for P&L statements per profit center.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Required for Marketing ROI report linking each order to its originating campaign; replaces denormalized promo_code.

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.rx_patient. Business justification: Orders containing prescriptions must be associated with the patient to satisfy HIPAA, claim reconciliation, and loyalty program integration.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer/shopper who placed or completed this order. Nullable for anonymous in-store POS transactions where no loyalty card was scanned and no account was identified.

attributes.name: sla_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.sla_policy. Business justification: The SLA policy applicable to an order (based on channel, customer tier, order value) governs the entire fulfillment commitment from placement to delivery. Customer service SLA breach reporting and com

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: Required for cluster‑level sales performance reporting; each order must be attributed to its store cluster for weekly KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store or fulfillment location where the order originated or was fulfilled. Links to the store master for store-level reporting, comp sales, and same-store sales analysis.

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.tender_type. Business justification: Grocery order headers must record the primary tender type for SNAP/EBT eligibility enforcement, fuel reward redemption rules, and regulatory SNAP transaction reporting. The existing plain-text 'paymen

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. Business justification: B2B wholesale orders must be attributed to the wholesale_account for credit limit enforcement, contract pricing application, minimum order validation, and B2B account management reporting. A retail-gr

attributes.name: age_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order contains age-restricted items (alcohol, tobacco, lottery tickets, certain medications) requiring cashier or delivery driver age verification at point of sale or delivery. Triggers age-check workflow in NCR POS or last-mile delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: FDA Tobacco Regulations; State Alcohol Beverage Control Laws; NCR POS Systems

attributes.name: bag_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee charged for single-use plastic or paper bags per applicable state and local bag fee ordinances. Required for regulatory compliance reporting in jurisdictions with mandatory bag fee laws (e.g., California, Illinois). Zero in jurisdictions without bag fee requirements.
attributes.references: State and Local Bag Fee Regulations; EPA Environmental Compliance; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: basket_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items (SKUs) in the order basket. Used for basket size analytics, express lane eligibility (e.g., 15 items or fewer), and customer segmentation. Distinct from total unit quantity which counts individual units across all line items.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Oracle Retail Merchandising

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the order was cancelled. Populated only when order_status = 'cancelled'. Used for cancellation root-cause analysis, OOS (Out of Stock) reporting, and fraud detection. Values: customer_request, out_of_stock, payment_failure, fraud_hold, store_closure, system_error.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; NCR POS Systems; Oracle Retail Replenishment

attributes.name: change_due_amount
attributes.description: Amount of cash change to be returned to the customer when cash tender exceeds the order total. Applicable only for in-store POS and self-checkout cash transactions. Null for non-cash or digital orders. Sourced from NCR POS cash management module.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order_header record was first written to the Silver layer data lakehouse. Distinct from order_timestamp (business event time) — this is the data capture audit timestamp used for data lineage, pipeline monitoring, and late-arriving data detection.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this order. Defaults to USD for domestic US grocery operations. Required for multi-currency support in international or border-region store operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: delivery_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for last-mile delivery service. Applicable for online_delivery channel orders. May be zero for fee-waived orders (e.g., loyalty member benefit, promotional free delivery). Null for in-store POS, click-and-collect, and curbside pickup orders.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; JDA Transportation Management; LMD Operations

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all discounts applied to the order, including promotional discounts (TPR — Temporary Price Reduction), loyalty discounts, coupon redemptions, and BOGO (Buy One Get One) savings. Stored as a positive value representing the reduction from subtotal.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD; Oracle Retail Price Management; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: ebt_snap_wic_used

attributes.name: fulfillment_date

attributes.name: fulfillment_timestamp

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned

attributes.name: oms_order_reference
attributes.description: External order reference number assigned by the OMS (Order Management System — Salesforce Commerce Cloud) for omnichannel orders. attributes.name: order_date

products.name: order_payment
products.description: Payment tender record for each payment instrument applied to a customer order. Captures payment ID, linked order header, tender type (credit, debit, EBT/SNAP, WIC, mobile wallet, gift card, fuel reward, cash, check), card type (Visa/MC/Amex), last four digits, authorization code, authorization timestamp, settlement status, payment amount, change given, EBT balance remaining (for EBT tenders), and payment processor reference. Supports PCI DSS compliance and SNAP/WIC regulatory reporting. References order_header as the single parent — no dual-FK pattern.
products.reference: NCR POS Tender / OMS Payment Record

attributes.name: order_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment tender record. Primary key.

attributes.name: authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.authorization. Business justification: Grocery order payments must link to the authorization record for chargeback response, settlement reconciliation, and dispute resolution. The plain-text 'authorization_code' and 'authorization_timestam

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Tracks which bank account received the payment for reconciliation and cash‑management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Payment transactions must be period-stamped for cash flow reporting, period-end bank reconciliation, and settlement status tracking. Grocery finance requires fiscal-period-level payment data for accur

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.gift_card. Business justification: When a grocery order is paid with a gift card, the order_payment record must link to the specific gift card for balance management, fraud detection, and state escheatment law compliance. Plain-text 'g

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Payment receipts (cash, credit, EBT, gift card) must post to specific GL accounts (cash clearing, AR, gift card liability) for daily cash reconciliation and financial close. Grocery treasury teams req

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_method. Business justification: Needed for fraud analysis: associate each order payment with the stored tokenized payment method used, enabling compliance and recurring‑payment tracking.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent order header. Links this payment tender to the customer order it settles.

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.settlement_batch. Business justification: Grocery treasury operations require linking each order payment directly to its settlement batch for daily settlement reconciliation, GL posting, and variance reporting. The plain-text 'settlement_stat

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Store-level payment reconciliation, tender balancing, and POS cash management reports require direct store attribution on each payment record. Grocery store controllers perform daily tender reconcilia

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.tender_type. Business justification: Order payment records must link directly to tender_type for EBT/SNAP/WIC regulatory reconciliation, settlement batch assignment by tender category, and fee calculation. The plain-text 'tender_type' co

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Required for audit: link each order payment record to its underlying payment transaction for settlement reconciliation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. Business justification: Wholesale account payments (ACH transfers, net-30 invoice settlements, credit account payments) must be tracked against the wholesale_account for B2B accounts receivable management, payment terms enfo

attributes.name: avs_response_code
attributes.description: Response code returned by the Address Verification Service (AVS) indicating the match result between billing address provided and address on file with card issuer. Used for fraud detection and risk management.

attributes.name: bank_account_last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number from the check. Applicable only when tender_type is check. Stored for reference while maintaining compliance with financial data protection standards.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing number from the check. Applicable only when tender_type is check. Used for electronic check verification and processing.
attributes.references: ABA Routing Number Standards; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code associated with the billing address for the payment instrument. Used for Address Verification Service (AVS) fraud checks. Applicable to card-based tenders.

attributes.name: card_last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the payment card number. Used for customer reference and dispute resolution while maintaining Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance by not storing full card number.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Card network brand for credit and debit card tenders. Applicable only when tender_type is credit_card or debit_card.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment card. Used for fraud detection and dispute resolution. Applicable to credit and debit card tenders.

attributes.name: change_given_amount
attributes.description: Amount of change returned to the customer when payment_amount exceeds the order balance. Applicable primarily to cash tenders. Null for non-cash tenders or when exact payment is tendered.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number from the paper check tendered. Applicable only when tender_type is check. Used for reconciliation and fraud detection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount. Supports multi-currency transactions in international operations.

attributes.name: cvv_response_code
attributes.description: Response code indicating whether the Card Verification Value (CVV) provided matched the value on file with the card issuer. Used for fraud detection. Applicable to card-not-present transactions.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Code returned by the payment processor indicating why the payment was declined. Examples include insufficient_funds, invalid_card, expired_card, fraud_suspected. Applicable when settlement_status is declined.

attributes.name: ebt_balance_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining balance on the Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) card after this transaction. Applicable only when tender_type is ebt_snap. Supports customer service inquiries and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: fuel_reward_discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of fuel reward points applied as discount. Applicable only when tender_type is fuel_reward.

attributes.name: fuel_reward_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of fuel reward loyalty points redeemed as payment toward this order. Applicable only when tender_type is fuel_reward. Supports fuel center operations and loyalty program reporting.

attributes.name: mobile_wallet_type
attributes.description: Type of mobile wallet used for payment. Applicable only when tender_type is mobile_wallet.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount applied from this payment tender toward the order total. For split-tender transactions, this represents the portion paid by this specific instrument. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was captured. Point of Sale (POS) for in-store register transactions; ecommerce for web storefront; mobile_app for native app checkout; kiosk for self-service terminals; phone for call center orders; curbside_terminal for pickup payment devices.

attributes.name: payment_gateway
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the payment gateway or processor that handled this transaction. Examples include First Data, Worldpay, Stripe, or internal processor identifiers.

attributes.name: payment_processor_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the external payment processor or gateway. Used for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: payment_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this payment tender within the order. Supports split-tender transactions where multiple payment instruments are applied to a single order.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for refund when settlement_status is refunded. Examples include customer_request, damaged_goods, pricing_error, order_cancellation. Used for refund analytics and fraud detection.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was processed. Applicable only when settlement_status is refunded.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Portion of the order total that qualifies for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) payment. Applicable when tender_type is ebt_snap. Required for SNAP regulatory reporting and compliance audits.
attributes.references: SNAP Retailer Regulations; 7 CFR 274; USDA FNS Guidelines

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Gratuity amount added by the customer for delivery or service. Applicable primarily to delivery and curbside pickup orders. Null when no tip is provided.

attributes.name: tokenized_payment_instrument
attributes.description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliant token representing the payment instrument. Used for recurring payments and stored payment methods without retaining sensitive card data.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3.2; Payment Tokenization Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Portion of the order total that qualifies for Women Infants and Children (WIC) program payment. Applicable when tender_type is wic. Required for WIC program reporting.
attributes.references: WIC Program Guidelines; State WIC Agency Regulations

attributes.name: wic_voucher_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Voucher Number
attributes.description: Unique voucher or authorization number for Women Infants and Children (WIC) program payment. Applicable only when tender_type is wic. Required for WIC program reconciliation and state reporting.
attributes.references: WIC Program Guidelines; State WIC Agency Regulations

products.name: order_refund
products.description: Refund and return transaction record for orders where items are returned or credits are issued. Captures refund ID, linked original order header, refund type (full/partial/line-level), refund reason code (damaged, wrong item, OOS, customer dissatisfaction, spoilage), refund amount, refund method (original tender, store credit, gift card), refund status (requested, approved, processed, denied), approving associate ID, and refund timestamp. Supports shrink tracking and customer satisfaction management. References order_header as the single parent.

attributes.name: order_refund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refund transaction record. Primary key for the order_refund product.

attributes.name: chargeback_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.chargeback. Business justification: In grocery retail, chargebacks frequently trigger refund issuance. Linking order_refund to the originating chargeback record enables chargeback-driven refund tracking, financial impact reporting, and

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Refund costs (shrink, fraud, policy exceptions) must be allocated to departmental cost centers for P&L reporting and shrink accounting. Grocery finance teams require cost-center-level refund tracking

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Refund reversals must be booked to the correct fiscal period for GAAP revenue recognition and period-end close. Grocery retailers require period-stamped refunds to accurately report net sales and avoi

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Refunds tied to fulfillment failures (short picks, substitutions, late delivery) must be attributed to the originating fulfillment node for root-cause analysis and node-level shrink/loss reporting. or

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Refunds are expense entries that require a GL account for proper accounting and audit trails.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the original order header for which this refund was issued. Links the refund back to the parent order transaction.

attributes.name: primary_order_payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: External payment processor transaction identifier from the original order. Used to link refund back to original payment for reconciliation and chargeback prevention.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Refund costs must be attributed to the store/banner profit center for store-level P&L and same-store-sales reporting. Grocery operators track refund rates by profit center to assess store performance

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Financial reconciliation of refunds by campaign for GMROI calculations; promotion_code_reversed is a denormalized code.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: When a promoted item is refunded, grocery retailers must reverse the associated vendor funding claim and loyalty points. Linking order_refund directly to promo_offer enables automated vendor deduction

attributes.name: refund_gift_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.gift_card. Business justification: When grocery refunds are issued as store credit/gift cards, the order_refund must link to the specific gift card issued for balance tracking, fraud prevention, and state escheatment law compliance. Ro

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.refund. Business justification: Grocery refund operations require linking the business-level order_refund (customer reason, policy exception, loyalty reversal) to the payment-level refund record (processor transaction, settlement) f

attributes.name: refund_tender_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.tender_type. Business justification: Grocery refund policy mandates tender-type-specific rules: EBT refunds must return to EBT, gift card refunds to store credit. Linking order_refund to tender_type via role-prefixed 'refund_tender_type_

attributes.name: refunded_product_order_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Refunded Product Order Line Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_order_line. Business justification: A refund/return is typically tied to a specific order line item (the SKU being returned). order_refund already has order_header_id for the header-level link, but lacks a line-level reference. Adding r

attributes.name: rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.rx_claim. Business justification: When a pharmacy order is refunded, the associated rx_claim must be reversed for PBM/insurance adjudication. CMS and PBM contracts require claim reversals to match refund records within the reversal wi

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the customer who requested the refund. May differ from the original order customer in cases of gift returns.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the store location where the refund was processed. Applicable for in-store and curbside refunds.

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. Business justification: Wholesale refunds require credit memo issuance against the wholesale_account for B2B accounts receivable reconciliation and dispute resolution. order_refund already has shopper_id for retail customers

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the refund transaction (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Optional post-refund satisfaction rating provided by customer, typically on a scale of 1-5. Used to measure refund experience quality. Null if not collected.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the refund request was denied. Null if refund was approved. Used for customer communication and policy compliance.

attributes.name: exception_approval_level
attributes.description: Authorization level required to approve this refund if it was a policy exception. Null if no exception was needed.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically 0-100 where higher values indicate greater fraud likelihood. Null if fraud scoring not applied.

attributes.name: inventory_disposition
attributes.description: Action taken with the returned inventory. Restock returns item to sellable inventory, damage_out records shrink, donate sends to charity, dispose discards, vendor_return sends back to supplier.

attributes.name: is_fraudulent
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this refund was flagged as potentially fraudulent by fraud detection systems or manual review. Used for loss prevention analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_reversed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points deducted from customer account due to this refund. Zero if no loyalty points were earned on original purchase or if points not reversed.

attributes.name: policy_exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this refund required an exception to standard return policy (e.g., outside return window, no receipt, final sale item). Requires manager approval.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Original receipt number provided by customer to validate the purchase. Used for no-receipt return policy enforcement and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value being refunded to the customer, including product cost and applicable taxes. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: refund_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was approved by an authorized associate or automated system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_channel
attributes.description: Business channel through which the refund was initiated. POS = Point of Sale for in-store refunds.

attributes.name: refund_denied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund request was denied. Null if refund was approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the associate processing the refund. May include additional context, customer comments, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: refund_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund payment was successfully processed and funds were returned to the customer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for issuing the refund. Used for root cause analysis, shrink tracking, and operational improvement. OOS = Out of Stock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damaged|wrong_item|oos|customer_dissatisfaction|spoilage|quality_issue|pricing_error|duplicate_charge|delivery_failure|expired_product — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer initiated the refund request. Represents the start of the refund lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the refund transaction. Tracks progression from initial request through final settlement or denial.

attributes.name: refund_subtotal
attributes.description: Refund amount before taxes. Represents the product cost portion of the refund.

attributes.name: refund_tax_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount representing sales tax or other applicable taxes being returned to the customer.

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the refund scope. Full refund returns entire order value, partial refund returns a portion of order value, line-level refund returns specific line items only.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to customer for processing the return, if applicable per store policy. Deducted from the refund amount. Zero if no restocking fee applies.

attributes.name: return_shipping_cost
attributes.description: Cost of shipping the returned items back to the retailer for online/delivery orders. May be absorbed by retailer or charged to customer depending on policy.

attributes.name: return_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days between original order date and refund request date. Used to enforce return policy time limits and analyze return patterns.

attributes.name: shrink_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this refund contributes to inventory shrink (loss from theft, spoilage, or damage). True if item cannot be restocked.

products.name: rx_order
products.description: Pharmacy prescription order record representing the purchase-event view of an Rx fill within the order domain. Captures Rx order ID, linked order header (for combined grocery+pharmacy orders), prescription number, patient reference, prescriber NPI, drug NDC code, drug name, quantity dispensed, days supply, fill type (new/refill/transfer), fill status (received, in-verification, filled, ready, dispensed, on-hold, cancelled), controlled substance schedule (DEA Schedule II-V flag), insurance claim reference, copay amount, and McKesson Rx system reference. This entity owns the ORDER-SIDE view of the Rx transaction (purchase event, payment, order status); the pharmacy domain owns the CLINICAL-SIDE (drug utilization review, patient counseling, clinical verification, controlled substance DEA reporting). Integrates with McKesson Pharmacy Systems.

attributes.name: rx_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy prescription order record. Primary key representing the purchase-event view of an Rx fill within the order domain.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Pharmacy operations have dedicated cost centers for drug costs, dispensing labor, and overhead. Grocery pharmacy P&L reporting requires cost-center-level rx_order allocation to track pharmacy departme

attributes.name: drug_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug. Business justification: rx_order requires pharmacy.drug for insurance adjudication (AWP, WAC), formulary tier determination, REMS compliance, and DEA schedule verification at dispensing time. drug_item is the retail catalog

attributes.name: drug_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_item. Business justification: rx_order stores drug_name, drug_ndc_code, drug_form, and drug_strength as denormalized strings. drug_item is the pharmacy drug item master with ndc, dosage_form, strength, and generic_name attributes.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Pharmacy insurance claim accruals and copay revenue must be period-stamped for GAAP revenue recognition. Grocery pharmacy finance requires fiscal-period-level rx_order data to accrue insurance receiva

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Pharmacy fulfillment (dispensing, delivery, curbside pickup) is executed at a specific fulfillment node. rx_order has pharmacy_location_id but not fulfillment_node_id. Node-level pharmacy fulfillment

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Pharmacy revenue (copay, insurance reimbursement, dispensing fees) and drug COGS post to specific GL accounts. Grocery pharmacy finance requires GL-level rx_order posting for insurance AR reconciliati

attributes.name: insurance_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.insurance_plan. Business justification: Every rx_order is adjudicated against a specific insurance plan for copay calculation, formulary tier lookup, quantity limits, and step therapy requirements. insurance_bin_number, insurance_group_numb

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order header for combined grocery and pharmacy orders. Links the Rx order to the overall customer order transaction.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires each Rx order to be linked to the specific pharmacy location that dispensed it for state compliance and inventory tracking.

attributes.name: pharmacy_patient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy patient record. Links the Rx order to the patient receiving the medication.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prescription. Business justification: rx_order is the fulfillment event for a specific prescription; pharmacists need direct access to sig, refills_authorized, controlled_substance_schedule, and prior_auth status. prescription_number, pre

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prior_authorization. Business justification: Controlled substances and specialty drugs require an approved prior authorization before dispensing. rx_order must reference pharmacy.prior_authorization to confirm PA status, approved quantity, and e

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Pharmacy segment P&L reporting requires rx_order attribution to pharmacy profit centers. Grocery operators report pharmacy as a distinct profit center for segment disclosure, banner-level pharmacy per

attributes.name: rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the insurance claim submitted for this prescription fill. Links to third-party payer adjudication.

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.rx_patient. Business justification: rx_order must reference pharmacy.rx_patient for dispensing workflows: HIPAA authorization status, auto-refill enrollment, insurance BIN/PCN, and counseling preferences are all on rx_patient. Pharmacy

attributes.name: controlled_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the medication is a controlled substance requiring DEA reporting and special handling.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Patient copayment amount in USD for this prescription fill after insurance adjudication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this Rx order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days the dispensed medication is intended to last based on prescribed dosing instructions.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA classification schedule for controlled substances (II through V). Non-controlled medications are marked as Non_Controlled.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the prescription was delivered to the patient: in-store pickup, curbside pickup, home delivery, or mail order.

attributes.name: dispensed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the prescription was picked up or delivered to the patient.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee
attributes.description: Professional fee charged by the pharmacy for dispensing services in USD.

attributes.name: fill_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which fill this is for the prescription (1 for initial fill, 2+ for refills).

attributes.name: fill_status
attributes.description: Current status of the prescription fill in the pharmacy workflow: received, in clinical verification, ready for patient pickup, dispensed to patient, on hold, cancelled, or returned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|in_verification|ready_for_pickup|dispensed|on_hold|cancelled|returned — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fill_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the prescription was filled and verified by the pharmacist.

attributes.name: fill_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prescription fill event: new prescription, refill of existing prescription, transfer from another pharmacy, transfer to another pharmacy, or partial fill.

attributes.name: insurance_paid_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid by insurance in USD for this prescription fill after adjudication.

attributes.name: mckesson_rx_system_ref
attributes.description: Source system identifier from McKesson Pharmacy Systems for this prescription order record.

attributes.name: prescription_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the prescription is no longer valid for filling or refilling.

attributes.name: prescription_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the prescription was received by the pharmacy (electronically, by phone, or in person).

attributes.name: prescription_written_date
attributes.description: Date the prescription was originally written by the prescriber.

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Number of units of medication dispensed to the patient (e.g., number of tablets, milliliters of liquid).

attributes.name: refills_remaining
attributes.description: Number of authorized refills remaining on the prescription after this fill.

attributes.name: sig_code
attributes.description: Prescription directions for use (Sig) provided to the patient. Instructions on how to take the medication.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generic substitution was permitted by the prescriber for this prescription.

attributes.name: substitution_occurred_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a generic substitution was actually made when filling this prescription.

attributes.name: total_price
attributes.description: Total price charged for the prescription fill in USD before insurance coverage.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this Rx order record was last modified in the system.

products.name: order_substitution
products.description: Item substitution record capturing instances where an ordered SKU was unavailable (OOS) and replaced with an alternative item during fulfillment. Captures substitution ID, linked order line, original SKU/GTIN, substitute SKU/GTIN, substitution reason (OOS, damaged, recalled), substitution type (auto-substituted by system, picker-selected, customer pre-approved), customer notification method (app/SMS/email), customer acceptance status (accepted, rejected, pending), price difference amount, and substitution timestamp. Supports OOS root cause analysis and customer experience improvement.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id

attributes.name: substitute_product_item_id

attributes.name: wave_id

attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute item is from the same brand as the original item.

attributes.name: category_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute item is from the same product category as the original item, supporting substitution quality analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this substitution record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_status
attributes.description: The customers response to the substitution offer. ACCEPTED=Customer explicitly accepted, REJECTED=Customer declined substitute, PENDING=Awaiting customer response, AUTO_ACCEPTED=Accepted per customer preferences, NOT_REQUIRED=No acceptance needed per business rules.

attributes.name: customer_feedback_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments provided by the customer regarding the substitution experience.

attributes.name: customer_notification_method
attributes.description: The channel used to notify the customer about the substitution. APP=Mobile app notification, SMS=Text message, EMAIL=Email notification, PHONE=Phone call, NONE=No notification sent.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer was notified about the substitution. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: customer_response_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer provided their acceptance or rejection response. Null if no response received or not required.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer-provided rating (1-5 scale) of their satisfaction with the substitution. Null if customer has not provided feedback.

attributes.name: inventory_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when inventory levels were checked for the original item, capturing the point-in-time inventory state that led to the OOS condition.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about the substitution from store associates, customer service, or system processes.

attributes.name: original_gtin
attributes.description: The GTIN (UPC/EAN) of the originally ordered product that was unavailable. Supports 8, 12, 13, or 14 digit formats.

attributes.name: original_item_stock_level
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity of the original item at the fulfillment location at the time of substitution decision.

attributes.name: original_product_name
attributes.description: The display name of the originally ordered product for customer communication and reporting.

attributes.name: original_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the original item that was ordered before substitution.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the originally ordered item that was unavailable and required substitution.

attributes.name: original_unit_price
attributes.description: The unit price of the originally ordered item at the time of order placement.

attributes.name: price_difference_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between the original item and substitute item (substitute price minus original price). Negative values indicate customer savings, positive values indicate upcharge.

attributes.name: price_protection_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether price protection was applied to ensure the customer was not charged more than the original item price, even if the substitute was more expensive.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount refunded to the customer related to this substitution. Null if no refund was issued.

attributes.name: refund_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a refund was issued to the customer due to substitution rejection or price difference.

attributes.name: size_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute item has the same or comparable size/quantity as the original item.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated this substitution record (e.g., OMS, WMS, POS).

attributes.name: substitute_item_stock_level
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity of the substitute item at the fulfillment location at the time of substitution.

attributes.name: substitute_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the substitute item provided to fulfill the order.

attributes.name: substitute_unit_price
attributes.description: The unit price of the substitute item at the time of substitution.

attributes.name: substitution_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer approval was required before proceeding with the substitution based on business rules and customer preferences.

attributes.name: substitution_number
attributes.description: Business-facing identifier for the substitution event, used for customer service and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: substitution_quality_score
attributes.description: A system-calculated score (0.00 to 5.00) representing the quality of the substitution match based on product attributes, category similarity, and customer preferences.

attributes.name: substitution_reason_code
attributes.description: The primary reason the original item required substitution. OOS=Out of Stock, DAMAGED=Product damaged, RECALLED=Product recalled, EXPIRED=Product expired or near expiration, QUALITY=Quality issue identified, DISCONTINUED=Product discontinued.

attributes.name: substitution_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of why the substitution was necessary, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: substitution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the substitution decision was made and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: The method by which the substitution was determined. AUTO_SYSTEM=Automatically selected by system algorithm, PICKER_SELECTED=Chosen by store associate or picker during fulfillment, CUSTOMER_PREAPPROVED=Customer pre-authorized substitutions in preferences, CUSTOMER_REQUESTED=Customer specifically requested this substitute.

products.name: fulfillment_slot
products.description: Scheduled time windows available for click-and-collect, curbside pickup, or last-mile delivery fulfillment at a given store or MFC. Captures slot date, start/end time, fulfillment type, location, total capacity (max orders), booked count, available capacity, cutoff time for new bookings, and slot status (open, full, closed, cancelled). Also manages individual slot reservations linking a checkout session or order to a specific slot, including reservation timestamp, reservation status (held, confirmed, released, expired), hold expiry timestamp, and release reason. Drives the slot selection UI in checkout and manages capacity contention during high-demand periods such as holidays and promotional events. This is the commerce-layer view of slot availability and reservation for the digital shopping experience; physical fulfillment execution is owned by the fulfillment domain.
products.reference: Pickup Slot / Delivery Window / Click-and-Collect Slot

products.name: product_item
products.description: Core master record and single source of truth for every sellable item in the Grocery catalog — CPG products, private-label brands, fresh produce, pharmacy drug items, and fuel grades. Stores the authoritative item description, brand reference, pack size, unit of measure, item status (active/discontinued/seasonal), item type (grocery/produce/pharmacy/fuel), temperature class (ambient/refrigerated/frozen), HACCP classification, FDA labeling flag, organic certification flag, USDA grade, private-label indicator, and source system reference. Sourced from Oracle Retail Item Management and SAP MM Material Master.

products.name: sku
products.description: Retailer-assigned Stock Keeping Unit representing a unique item-pack-location combination for inventory and sales tracking. Stores SKU code, parent item reference, retailer item number, vendor item number, case pack quantity, inner pack quantity, selling unit of measure, catch-weight flag, variable-weight flag, shelf life days, and SKU status (active/inactive/discontinued). Serves as the authoritative single source of truth for all item identification codes including UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, GTIN-14, GS1 DataBar barcodes (with barcode type, barcode value, GS1 company prefix, check digit, primary barcode flag, effective date range) and PLU codes (IFPS standard PLU, commodity type, variety, organic flag per 9-prefix convention, size/grade). Bridges the item master to store-level assortment, inventory positions, and POS transactions. Supports POS scanning, receiving, EDI transactions, manual PLU entry for produce and bulk items, and multi-barcode lookup for items with multiple packaging configurations. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System and IFPS.
