attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node became active and available for use in assortment planning, reporting, and SKU assignment. Supports temporal hierarchy analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: endcap_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are suitable for endcap (end-of-aisle display) placement. Used in planogram design and promotional space allocation.

attributes.name: fda_regulated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are subject to FDA (Food and Drug Administration) regulation for food safety, labeling, or nutritional information disclosure.

attributes.name: gmroi_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) percentage for this hierarchy node. Used in merchandise planning and performance evaluation. Calculated as (Gross Margin / Average Inventory Cost) * 100.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the hierarchy tree. Typically: 1=Department, 2=Category, 3=Subcategory, 4=Segment, 5=Subsegment. Supports drill-down navigation and roll-up aggregation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: hierarchy_level_name
attributes.description: Business name for the hierarchy level. Standard retail taxonomy labels used in category management and merchandise planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: leaf_node_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node is a leaf (has no children). True for lowest-level nodes that directly contain SKUs (Stock Keeping Units). Used to optimize query performance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: minimum_facings
attributes.description: Minimum number of product facings (product fronts visible on shelf) required for items in this hierarchy node. Used in planogram compliance and shelf stocking guidelines.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this hierarchy node. Used for audit trail and accountability in category management changes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the hierarchy node. Used in planograms, assortment planning, and financial reporting. Examples: DEPT01, CAT-DAIRY, SUBCAT-MILK.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_depth
attributes.description: Distance from root node (0 for root). Used for hierarchy traversal algorithms and display indentation in user interfaces.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hierarchy node including scope, product types included, and merchandising guidelines.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node. Examples: Fresh Produce, Dairy Products, Organic Milk, Private Label Snacks.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_path
attributes.description: Full path from root to current node using node codes separated by forward slashes. Example: DEPT01/CAT-DAIRY/SUBCAT-MILK. Supports fast ancestor queries and breadcrumb navigation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchy node. Active nodes are used in assortment planning and reporting. Inactive nodes are retained for historical analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node require USDA organic certification. Drives supplier qualification, labeling requirements, and premium pricing strategies.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are perishable (fresh produce, dairy, meat, bakery). Drives cold chain requirements, FIFO (First In First Out) handling, and shrink management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node contains primarily private-label (store-owned brand) products. Used for brand mix analysis and margin optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: promotional_category_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is frequently featured in ad circulars, BOGO (Buy One Get One) promotions, and TPR (Temporary Price Reduction) campaigns. Used in promotional planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard replenishment cycle in days for items in this hierarchy node. Used in CAO (Computer-Assisted Ordering) and DC (Distribution Center) planning.

attributes.name: seasonality_pattern
attributes.description: Primary seasonality pattern for demand in this hierarchy node. Used in seasonal assortment planning, inventory forecasting, and promotional calendar development.

attributes.name: shrink_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Expected shrink (inventory loss from theft, spoilage, or damage) rate percentage for this hierarchy node. Used in inventory valuation, loss prevention planning, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Inventory Control

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are eligible for purchase using SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) or EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) benefits. Required for POS (Point of Sale) transaction processing.

attributes.name: space_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of total store shelf space allocated to this hierarchy node. Used in planogram design and space productivity analysis. Sum of all categories should equal 100% at store level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: target_gross_margin_percentage
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for this hierarchy node. Used in pricing decisions, vendor negotiations, and financial planning. Calculated as ((Retail Price - Cost) / Retail Price) * 100.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature zone for storing and displaying items in this hierarchy node. Drives cold chain logistics, WMS (Warehouse Management System) slotting, and HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - Temperature Control Requirements

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: WIC (Women Infants and Children) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are eligible for purchase using WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program benefits. Required for POS transaction processing and state reporting.

products.name: upc_barcode
products.description: Universal Product Code and barcode registry for all items. Stores UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, GTIN-14, and GS1 DataBar codes associated with each SKU, including barcode type, barcode value, GS1 company prefix, check digit, primary barcode flag, and effective date range. Supports POS scanning, receiving, and EDI transactions. Enables multi-barcode lookup for items with multiple packaging configurations.

attributes.name: upc_barcode_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the UPC barcode record. Primary key for the barcode registry.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU that this barcode represents. Links barcode to the master product catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier who provided this barcode. Used for DSD receiving and vendor barcode compliance tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: GS1 barcode validation against the vendor's item catalog is a standard EDI/receiving process. Receiving teams resolve barcode discrepancies by comparing scanned UPCs against vendor_item records. A dir

attributes.name: barcode_image_url
attributes.description: URL to the stored barcode image file used for label printing and visual verification. Supports planogram and shelf label generation.

attributes.name: barcode_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the barcode. Active barcodes are scannable at POS and receiving. Recalled barcodes trigger alerts.

attributes.name: barcode_type
attributes.description: The barcode symbology standard used for this code. Determines the encoding format and scanning requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UPC-A|UPC-E|EAN-13|EAN-8|GTIN-14|GS1-128|GS1 DataBar — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: barcode_value
attributes.description: The numeric barcode value as encoded in the barcode symbol. Supports UPC-A (12 digits), UPC-E (8 digits), EAN-13 (13 digits), and GTIN-14 (14 digits).

attributes.name: check_digit
attributes.description: The calculated check digit at the end of the barcode used to validate barcode accuracy during scanning. Computed using GS1 modulo-10 algorithm.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this barcode record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date this barcode is discontinued and should no longer be accepted. Null for active barcodes with no planned discontinuation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date this barcode becomes active and scannable in POS and warehouse systems. Supports phased product launches and barcode transitions.

attributes.name: gs1_company_prefix
attributes.description: The GS1-assigned company prefix portion of the barcode that identifies the brand owner or manufacturer. Used for vendor identification and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The standardized Global Trade Item Number assigned by GS1. May be GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14 depending on product packaging level.

attributes.name: is_age_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires age verification at POS (alcohol, tobacco, pharmacy items). Triggers ID check prompt.
attributes.references: FDA and State Alcohol Control Regulations

attributes.name: is_coupon_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode is eligible for manufacturer or store coupon redemption. Used for POS coupon validation.

attributes.name: is_pharmacy_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode is for a pharmacy prescription or over-the-counter drug item requiring special handling and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DEA and State Board of Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: is_primary_barcode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary barcode for the SKU. Used when a product has multiple barcodes for different packaging configurations.

attributes.name: is_snap_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is eligible for purchase using SNAP EBT benefits. Required for government program compliance.

attributes.name: is_store_brand
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode is for a private-label or store-owned brand product. Used for private label reporting and margin analysis.

attributes.name: is_variable_weight
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode includes embedded weight or price information for random-weight items like fresh produce and deli products.

attributes.name: is_wic_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Must match state WIC approved product lists.

attributes.name: item_reference
attributes.description: The item reference portion of the GTIN assigned by the brand owner to uniquely identify the product within their company prefix.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this barcode record was last updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: last_scanned_date
attributes.description: The most recent date this barcode was scanned at POS or in warehouse operations. Used to identify inactive or obsolete barcodes.

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The FDA National Drug Code for pharmacy items. Used for prescription processing and drug inventory management. Null for non-pharmacy items.

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: The packaging hierarchy level this barcode represents. Each represents consumer unit, Case represents distribution unit, Pallet represents logistics unit.

attributes.name: packaging_quantity
attributes.description: The number of consumer units contained in this packaging level. For Each level this is 1, for Case it represents units per case.

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: The 4 or 5 digit PLU code used for fresh produce and bulk items that are not pre-packaged. Used at POS for manual entry when barcode is not available.

attributes.name: scan_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this barcode has been scanned across all POS and warehouse systems. Used for barcode usage analytics.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record that provided this barcode data. Used for data lineage and reconciliation with vendor-provided barcode information.
attributes.value_regex: Oracle Retail|SAP MM|EDI|Vendor Portal|Manual Entry|GS1 Registry

products.name: plu_code
products.description: Price Look-Up code registry for fresh produce, bulk items, and variable-weight products not identified by UPC. Stores PLU code (IFPS standard), item description, commodity type, variety, organic flag (9-prefix convention), size/grade, and effective date. Used at POS for manual entry of produce and deli items. Sourced from IFPS (International Federation for Produce Standards) and store operations.

attributes.name: plu_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the PLU code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary vendor or supplier for this item. Links to vendor master data for procurement and supply chain management.

attributes.name: allergen_info
attributes.description: Free-text field listing any allergens present in or associated with the item (e.g., 'Contains tree nuts', 'May contain traces of peanuts'). Required for FDA allergen labeling compliance and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: average_weight
attributes.description: The average weight per unit for items sold by each (e.g., average weight of one apple). Used for inventory estimation and yield calculations. Null for items sold strictly by weight.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: The product category code within the department (e.g., 'FRUIT', 'VEGETABLE', 'HERB', 'NUT'). Used for merchandising hierarchy and analytics.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The broad commodity category for the item (e.g., 'Apples', 'Bananas', 'Tomatoes', 'Nuts', 'Cheese'). Used for category management and reporting.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The current cost per unit of measure paid to the supplier. Used for margin calculation and GMROI analysis. Business-confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was grown or produced (e.g., 'USA', 'MEX', 'CHL'). Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this PLU code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the price (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'MXN'). Required for multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The store department code where this item is merchandised (e.g., 'PRODUCE', 'DELI', 'BAKERY', 'BULK'). Used for sales reporting and category management.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this PLU code and its associated pricing became effective. Used for price change tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this PLU code or pricing is scheduled to expire or be replaced. Null if no expiration is planned. Used for seasonal item management and price change scheduling.

attributes.name: fair_trade_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item carries Fair Trade certification. True if certified, False otherwise. Used for marketing, customer transparency, and ethical sourcing reporting.

attributes.name: gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is a genetically modified organism or contains GMO ingredients. True if GMO, False if non-GMO or GMO-free. Used for labeling compliance and customer transparency.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard

attributes.name: gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: The gross margin percentage for this item, calculated as (price - cost) / price * 100. Used for profitability analysis and category management. Business-confidential financial metric.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the product image used for digital signage, eCommerce, and mobile app display. Supports omnichannel customer experience.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the produce or bulk item (e.g., 'Fuji Apples', 'Organic Bananas', 'Bulk Almonds').

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this PLU code record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: locally_sourced_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is sourced from local farms or suppliers within a defined geographic radius. True if locally sourced, False otherwise. Used for marketing and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: nutritional_info
attributes.description: Free-text or structured field containing key nutritional facts (calories, fat, carbohydrates, protein, vitamins per serving). Used for customer information and FDA nutrition labeling compliance.

attributes.name: organic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified organic. True if organic (typically PLU codes starting with 9), False otherwise. Used for pricing, labeling, and compliance with USDA organic certification requirements.

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: The 4-digit or 5-digit PLU code assigned to the item. 5-digit codes starting with 9 indicate organic products per IFPS convention. This is the externally-known unique identifier used at POS for manual entry.

attributes.name: plu_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PLU code. Active codes are available for sale; inactive codes are temporarily unavailable; discontinued codes are permanently removed; seasonal codes are available only during specific periods.

attributes.name: pos_display_name
attributes.description: The abbreviated or formatted name displayed on POS terminals and customer receipts. May differ from the full item description for space constraints.

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: The current selling price per unit of measure (e.g., price per pound, price per each). Used by POS systems to calculate transaction totals for variable-weight items.

attributes.name: seasonal_availability
attributes.description: Free-text description of the seasonal availability window for this item (e.g., 'Summer only', 'Year-round', 'Fall harvest'). Used for assortment planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The typical shelf life of the item in days from receipt to expected spoilage or quality degradation. Used for inventory rotation, FIFO management, and shrink reduction. Critical for perishable produce management.

attributes.name: size_grade
attributes.description: The size or grade classification of the item (e.g., 'Small', 'Medium', 'Large', 'Extra Large', 'Grade A'). Used for pricing differentiation and customer selection.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Grading Standards

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (formerly food stamps). True if eligible, False otherwise. Required for EBT transaction processing compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service SNAP Regulations

attributes.name: storage_temperature_requirement
attributes.description: The required storage temperature zone for this item (ambient for room temperature, refrigerated for cold chain, frozen for sub-zero). Critical for cold chain compliance and food safety.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Cold Chain Requirements

attributes.name: subcategory_code
attributes.description: The product subcategory code for finer classification (e.g., 'APPLE', 'CITRUS', 'LEAFY_GREEN'). Supports detailed category management and assortment planning.

attributes.name: taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales tax applies to this item. True if taxable, False if tax-exempt. Tax treatment varies by jurisdiction and product type (e.g., fresh produce may be tax-exempt in some states).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the item is sold and priced (e.g., 'each' for individual items, 'pound' for weight-based pricing). Critical for POS transaction processing and pricing calculation.

attributes.name: variety
attributes.description: The specific variety or cultivar of the commodity (e.g., 'Fuji', 'Gala', 'Honeycrisp' for apples; 'Roma', 'Beefsteak' for tomatoes). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) Program Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. True if eligible, False otherwise. Required for WIC transaction processing and compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service WIC Regulations

products.name: item_attribute
products.description: Extensible attribute store and single source of truth for item-level business, regulatory, and compliance attributes that vary by item type and cannot be anticipated at schema design time. Captures attribute name, attribute value, attribute data type, attribute group (regulatory, certification, physical, marketing, sustainability), unit of measure, certifying body, certification number, source system, effective date, and expiration date. Stores all regulatory compliance flags including SNAP/WIC/EBT eligibility, FDA bioengineered food disclosure, organic certification, non-GMO verification, gluten-free certification, kosher/halal certifications, fair-trade status, USDA grade designations, country of origin, and compliance status. Enables flexible attribute extension without schema changes. Note: structured nutritional facts and allergen declarations are owned by nutritional_info; this product handles all other regulatory flags and certifications. Sourced from vendor GS1 Sync data, certifying bodies, and regulatory agencies.
products.reference: FDA Nutrition Labeling / GS1 Product Attributes

attributes.name: item_attribute_id
attributes.description: Primary key for item_attribute

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent item (SKU, UPC, PLU, or drug item) to which this attribute applies. Links to the item master catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Product certifications (kosher, halal, organic, non-GMO) tracked in item_attribute are issued to specific suppliers/manufacturers. Regulatory compliance and quality teams need supplier-level certifica

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute record is currently active and should be used for business operations. Supports soft delete and historical tracking.

attributes.name: age_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item has age restrictions for purchase (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, certain medications). Triggers POS age verification prompts.
attributes.references: State and Federal Age Restriction Laws

attributes.name: attribute_data_type
attributes.description: The data type of the attribute value to enable proper parsing and validation. Supports string, numeric, boolean, date, and timestamp types.

attributes.name: attribute_group
attributes.description: Categorical grouping of the attribute for organizational and filtering purposes. Includes regulatory compliance, certifications, physical characteristics, marketing claims, sustainability, nutritional facts, allergen information, and safety warnings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regulatory|certification|physical|marketing|sustainability|nutritional|allergen|safety — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: attribute_name
attributes.description: The name or key of the attribute being stored (e.g., organic_certified, gluten_free_certified, country_of_origin, bioengineered_disclosure). Enables flexible schema extension without DDL changes.

attributes.name: attribute_source_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier or document number from the source system or certifying body that provided this attribute value. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: attribute_value
attributes.description: The value of the attribute stored as a string. May represent text, numeric, boolean, or date values depending on attribute_data_type. Supports regulatory flags, certifications, and compliance indicators.

attributes.name: bioengineered_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains bioengineered (genetically modified) ingredients and requires disclosure under the National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard. Mandatory for FDA compliance.
attributes.references: FDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The unique certification or registration number issued by the certifying body. Used for audit trail and regulatory verification. Null for non-certified attributes.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide; USDA Organic Regulations

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: The name of the organization or regulatory agency that issued the certification or compliance designation (e.g., USDA, FDA, Non-GMO Project, Fair Trade USA, Orthodox Union for Kosher). Null for non-certified attributes.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide; USDA Organic Regulations

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the attribute with respect to regulatory or certification requirements. Tracks whether the item meets the declared standard.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA Regulations

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification (Schedule I through V) for pharmacy items. Null for non-controlled substances. Required for pharmacy compliance and inventory controls.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The country where the item was produced, manufactured, or grown. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance for certain food categories.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this attribute record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dsd_item_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is delivered directly to stores by the vendor rather than through the distribution center. Affects replenishment planning and receiving processes.

attributes.name: ebt_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is eligible for purchase using EBT cards. Supports SNAP and other government assistance programs.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service EBT Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this attribute value becomes valid and applicable. Supports time-variant attribute tracking for regulatory compliance and product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this attribute value expires or is no longer valid. Null for attributes with indefinite validity. Critical for certification renewals and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide; USDA Organic Regulations

attributes.name: fair_trade_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified fair trade by Fair Trade USA or equivalent certifying body. Supports sustainability and ethical sourcing claims.

attributes.name: gluten_free_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified gluten-free by a recognized certifying body (e.g., GFCO, NSF). Required for gluten-free labeling claims under FDA regulations.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified halal by a recognized Islamic certifying body. Supports dietary preference filtering and marketing.

attributes.name: hazard_classification

attributes.description: The HACCP hazard classification for the item (e.g., biological, chemical, physical). Used for food safety risk assessment and supply chain controls.
attributes.references: FDA HACCP Principles and Application Guidelines

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified kosher by a recognized rabbinical authority (e.g., OU, OK, Star-K). Supports dietary preference filtering and marketing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this attribute record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The date when this attribute value was last verified or validated against the source system or certifying body. Used for data quality monitoring and compliance audits.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_age
attributes.description: The minimum age required to purchase the item, if age restricted. Null for non-age-restricted items. Used for POS validation.
attributes.references: State and Federal Age Restriction Laws

attributes.name: non_gmo_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item has been verified as non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project or equivalent certifying body. Supports marketing claims and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified organic by the USDA or an accredited certifying agent. Required for organic labeling and marketing claims.

attributes.name: planogram_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item must be merchandised according to a specific planogram layout. Used for space allocation and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: prescription_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item requires a valid prescription for purchase. Applicable to pharmacy drug items and certain medical devices.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; State Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is a store-owned private label brand product. Used for category management, margin analysis, and promotional planning.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days the item remains safe and suitable for consumption or use under proper storage conditions. Used for inventory rotation (FIFO) and markdown planning.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code; Internal Inventory Management Standards

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (formerly food stamps). Required for POS system configuration and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service SNAP Regulations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or external data source from which this attribute was ingested (e.g., GS1 Data Sync, vendor EDI feed, certifying body API, Oracle Retail Item Management). Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The required temperature control zone for storage and transportation of the item. Critical for cold chain compliance and perishable inventory management.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for numeric attribute values (e.g., grams, ounces, milliliters, percent, degrees). Null for non-numeric attributes.

attributes.name: usda_grade

attributes.description: The name of any sustainability or environmental certification held by the brand, such as Rainforest Alliance, Marine Stewardship Council, Forest Stewardship Council, or B Corporation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rainforest_alliance|marine_stewardship_council|forest_stewardship_council|b_corporation|carbon_neutral|regenerative_organic|utz_certified — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_category
attributes.description: The primary product category or department where this brand is positioned. Used for category management, assortment planning, and category captain assignments. Examples include Dairy, Bakery, Frozen Foods, Health and Beauty, Pharmacy.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The official website URL for the brand where consumers can find product information, recipes, and brand story. Used for digital commerce integration and customer engagement.

products.name: item_cost
products.description: Landed cost record for each SKU-vendor combination capturing all cost components used in margin and COGS analysis. Stores base cost (unit cost from vendor), off-invoice allowances, billback allowances, scan-based trading allowances, freight cost, handling cost, slotting fee amortization, effective date range, cost type (standard/actual/contract/promotional), cost basis (case/each/weight), currency code, and cost source (EDI 832 price catalog, vendor contract, manual override). Supports gross margin calculation, GMROI analysis, promotional lift measurement, and dead net cost reporting. Sourced from SAP MM Purchasing and Oracle Retail Price Management.
products.reference: Oracle Retail Cost Management / SAP MM Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: item_cost_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item cost record. Primary key for the item cost entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for cost accounting reports that allocate each SKU's cost to a specific cost center for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: cost_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.cost_schedule. Business justification: Buyers must validate that the retailer's item cost reflects the correct bracket tier and allowances from the active cost schedule. A direct FK from item_cost to cost_schedule enables the 'cost schedul

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Item cost records must be period-stamped for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and period-end cost accounting. Grocery retailers use fiscal-period-level cost data for LIFO/FIFO inventory accounti

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Maps each item cost to the appropriate GL expense account for automatic posting in the general ledger.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Multi-banner grocery operators maintain entity-specific item costs for intercompany transfer pricing and legal-entity-level COGS reporting. Each legal entity (banner/subsidiary) may have distinct nego

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional event or campaign during which this promotional cost applies. Used to measure promotional lift and incremental margin impact.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this cost record applies. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier providing this item at the specified cost. Each SKU-vendor combination may have distinct cost structures.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Item costs in grocery retail are negotiated under specific trade agreements. AP and procurement teams must trace which trade agreement governs each item cost for contract compliance audits, cost varia

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: AP and buying teams run cost variance reconciliation reports comparing the retailer's item_cost record against the vendor's catalog cost in vendor_item. A direct FK enables this reconciliation without

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was approved. Part of the audit trail for cost change management and financial controls.

attributes.name: base_unit_cost
attributes.description: The fundamental unit cost from the vendor before any allowances, discounts, or additional charges. This is the invoice line item cost per unit as stated by the supplier.

attributes.name: billback_allowance
attributes.description: Post-invoice allowance claimed back from the vendor after the sale or promotion period. Requires submission of proof-of-performance documentation. Expressed in the same currency and unit basis as base cost.

attributes.name: cost_approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for this cost record. Indicates whether the cost has been reviewed and approved by procurement or finance before being applied to transactions.

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure on which the base unit cost is calculated. Indicates whether cost is per individual item (each), per case, per pallet, per unit weight, or per unit volume.

attributes.name: cost_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, explanations, or special conditions related to this cost record. May include reasons for manual overrides, contract clauses, or vendor negotiation details.

attributes.name: cost_source
attributes.description: Indicates the origin or method by which this cost was captured. EDI 832 is electronic price catalog from vendor; vendor contract is negotiated agreement; manual override is user-entered adjustment; system calculated is derived by ERP; purchase order is actual PO line cost.

attributes.name: cost_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost record. Active indicates the cost is in use; pending indicates awaiting approval or effective date; expired indicates past effective end date; superseded indicates replaced by newer cost; suspended indicates temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost record indicating the costing methodology applied. Standard cost is the baseline expected cost; actual cost reflects real invoice amounts; contract cost is negotiated rate; promotional cost applies during vendor promotions; landed cost includes all acquisition expenses; average cost is weighted average over time.

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between standard cost and actual cost for this SKU-vendor combination. Positive variance indicates actual cost exceeded standard; negative indicates savings. Used for procurement performance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the cost is denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: dead_net_cost
attributes.description: The final, fully-loaded cost per unit after applying all allowances, discounts, freight, handling, and amortized fees. This is the true cost used for gross margin and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) calculations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost record expires or is superseded by a new cost record. Null indicates the cost is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Effective Dating

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost record becomes active and applicable for costing transactions. Supports time-based cost history and contract period tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Effective Dating

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost allocated to this SKU for moving goods from vendor to distribution center or store. May be actual freight invoice or allocated based on weight/volume. Expressed per unit basis.

attributes.name: handling_cost
attributes.description: Warehouse or distribution center handling cost allocated to this SKU, including receiving, putaway, storage, and picking activities. Expressed per unit basis.

attributes.name: is_primary_vendor
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this vendor is the primary or preferred source for this SKU. True if primary; false if secondary or backup vendor.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this SKU was purchased from this vendor at this cost. Supports cost aging analysis and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between placing a purchase order and receiving the goods from this vendor for this SKU. Used for replenishment planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from the vendor to qualify for this cost. Expressed in the same unit of measure as cost basis.

attributes.name: off_invoice_allowance
attributes.description: Immediate discount or allowance deducted directly from the invoice at the time of purchase. Reduces the base unit cost before payment. Expressed in the same currency and unit basis as base cost.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the specific purchase order from which this actual cost was derived. Applicable when cost type is actual and sourced from a PO receipt.

attributes.name: scan_based_trading_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance applied under scan-based trading arrangements where the retailer pays the vendor only when the item is sold (scanned at POS). Reflects the discount or rebate negotiated under SBT terms.

attributes.name: slotting_fee_amortization
attributes.description: Amortized portion of the one-time slotting fee paid to secure shelf space for this SKU, allocated per unit over the expected sales volume or contract period. Contributes to total landed cost.

products.name: drug_item
products.description: Pharmacy drug item master extending the core item record with pharmacy-specific attributes. Stores NDC (National Drug Code), drug name (brand and generic), active ingredient, strength, dosage form, route of administration, DEA schedule (I–V or non-scheduled), controlled substance flag, OTC vs Rx flag, therapeutic class, drug interaction group, storage temperature requirement, expiration tracking method, and McKesson drug database reference. Supports McKesson Pharmacy Systems drug inventory and prescription dispensing workflows.
products.reference: NDC / DEA Schedule / McKesson Drug Database

attributes.name: drug_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy drug item record. Primary key for the drug item master.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Pharmacy drug items are allocated to pharmacy cost centers for drug cost tracking and formulary management. Grocery pharmacy operators require drug-item-level cost center assignment to track drug spen

attributes.name: drug_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug. Business justification: drug_item is the retail product catalog entry; pharmacy.drug is the authoritative clinical dispensing record with NDC, formulary status, REMS indicator, DEA schedule, and AWP. Linking them enables for

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Pharmacy drug items map to specific GL accounts for drug COGS, controlled substance inventory, and hazardous drug expense. Grocery pharmacy finance requires drug-item-level GL assignment for DEA-compl

attributes.name: pharmaceutical_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Pharmacy operations require direct linkage between drug items and their pharmaceutical distributor/manufacturer (McKesson, Cardinal Health) for DEA controlled substance reporting, FDA drug supply chai

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_item. Business justification: Drug items extend core product items; FK creates proper inheritance.

attributes.name: active_ingredient
attributes.description: Primary active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) responsible for the therapeutic effect. May include multiple ingredients separated by semicolons for combination drugs.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Proprietary brand name of the drug product as marketed by the manufacturer (e.g., Lipitor, Advil).

attributes.name: controlled_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a controlled substance requiring special handling, documentation, and security per DEA regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the drug item record was first created in the pharmacy system.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance classification (I through V) indicating abuse potential and regulatory restrictions. Non-scheduled indicates the drug is not a controlled substance.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date the drug was discontinued by the manufacturer or removed from the pharmacy formulary. Null for active drugs.

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form in which the drug is manufactured and dispensed (e.g., tablet, capsule, liquid, injection). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|liquid|injection|cream|ointment|gel|patch|inhaler|suppository|powder|suspension|solution|spray|drops|lozenge — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: drug_interaction_group
attributes.description: Classification code or group identifier used by pharmacy systems to screen for potential drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and adverse reactions.

attributes.name: drug_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the drug item in the pharmacy inventory system. Active items are available for dispensing, discontinued items are no longer stocked, recalled items have FDA safety alerts, back-ordered items are temporarily unavailable, restricted items require special authorization.

attributes.name: expiration_tracking_method
attributes.description: Method used to track and manage drug expiration dates in inventory. Lot-based tracks by manufacturing lot, unit-based tracks individual units, FIFO (First In First Out) dispenses oldest stock first, FEFO (First Expired First Out) dispenses nearest expiration first.

attributes.name: fda_approval_date
attributes.description: Date the drug received FDA approval for marketing and distribution in the United States.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: Insurance formulary classification indicating coverage tier and restrictions (preferred, non-preferred, excluded, or requiring prior authorization).

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: Non-proprietary generic name of the drug using the United States Adopted Name (USAN) or International Nonproprietary Name (INN) convention (e.g., atorvastatin, ibuprofen).

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the drug product for supply chain and inventory management. 14-digit format.

attributes.name: hazardous_drug_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as hazardous per NIOSH guidelines, requiring special handling, personal protective equipment, and disposal procedures.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the drug item record was last modified in the pharmacy system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization with McKesson Pharmacy Systems.

attributes.name: manufacturer_labeler_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned 5-digit labeler code identifying the manufacturer or distributor. First segment of the NDC.

attributes.name: mckesson_drug_code
attributes.description: McKesson proprietary drug identifier used for ordering, inventory management, and integration with McKesson Pharmacy Systems drug database.

attributes.name: multi_source_code
attributes.description: FDA Orange Book code indicating generic availability. Y = generic available, N = no generic available, O = original brand with generic equivalents.

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: Quantity and unit of measure for the drug package (e.g., 30 tablets, 100 mL, 1 vial). Represents the dispensing unit size.

attributes.name: prescription_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug requires a valid prescription (Rx) or is available over-the-counter (OTC). True for prescription drugs, False for OTC drugs.

attributes.name: refrigeration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug must be stored under refrigerated conditions (2-8°C) to maintain stability and efficacy.

attributes.name: repackaged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug has been repackaged from bulk containers into smaller dispensing units by a repackager rather than the original manufacturer.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: Method by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, topical, intravenous, intramuscular). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|topical|intravenous|intramuscular|subcutaneous|inhalation|rectal|ophthalmic|otic|nasal|transdermal|sublingual|buccal — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: storage_temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required storage temperature condition to maintain drug stability and efficacy. Room temperature (15-25°C), refrigerated (2-8°C), frozen (<0°C), or controlled room temperature (20-25°C).

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Concentration or potency of the active ingredient, including unit of measure (e.g., 10 mg, 500 mg/5 mL, 0.5%).

attributes.name: therapeutic_class
attributes.description: Pharmacological or therapeutic category indicating the drug's primary clinical use (e.g., antihypertensive, antibiotic, analgesic, antidiabetic).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for inventory tracking and dispensing (e.g., each, tablet, capsule, mL, gram). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|tablet|capsule|ml|gram|vial|bottle|box|tube|patch|inhaler — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier used for point-of-sale scanning and inventory tracking of OTC pharmacy items.

products.name: item_vendor
products.description: Association between items and their approved vendors/suppliers, capturing the sourcing relationship. Stores vendor reference, item reference, vendor item number, vendor UPC, primary vendor flag, vendor lead time days, minimum order quantity, order multiple, EDI transaction set supported, DSD indicator, and effective date range. Supports purchase order creation, replenishment planning, and vendor performance management. Sourced from SAP MM Purchasing Info Record and Oracle Retail.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchasing Info Record / Oracle Retail Vendor Item

attributes.name: item_vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item-vendor association record.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Vendor item costs and allowances post to GL accounts for AP accruals and COGS recording. Grocery retailers require GL-level item_vendor posting to support vendor invoice matching, billback allowance a

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the item (SKU) in this vendor relationship.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier providing this item.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier_site. Business justification: A supplier may have multiple sites (East/West DC, farm, co-manufacturer). The specific sourcing site determines lead time, cold chain capability, and freight cost for each item-vendor relationship. Gr

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Item-vendor sourcing terms (MOQ, lead time, cost) are governed by a specific trade agreement. Procurement and legal teams need to link item-vendor records to their governing contracts for renewal trac

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the vendor cost (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where this item is manufactured or grown by this vendor. Required for customs, labeling, and country-of-origin marketing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, FDA Food Labeling

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item-vendor relationship record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dsd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor delivers directly to stores, bypassing the distribution center. Common for bread, dairy, snacks, and beverages.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set_supported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Transaction Set Supported
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EDI transaction sets supported by this vendor for this item (e.g., 850 Purchase Order, 856 Advance Ship Notice, 810 Invoice). Blank if vendor does not support EDI.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this item-vendor relationship expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended relationship.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this item-vendor relationship becomes active and can be used for purchase order creation.

attributes.name: item_vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this item-vendor sourcing relationship. Blocked status prevents new purchase orders; discontinued indicates vendor no longer supplies this item.

attributes.name: last_cost_update_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor cost was last updated in the system. Used for cost change tracking and margin analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item-vendor relationship record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order placed with this vendor for this item. Used for vendor activity analysis and relationship management.

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt from this vendor for this item at any distribution center or store. Used for vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The smallest quantity that can be ordered from this vendor for this item, expressed in the vendor's unit of measure.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The quantity increment in which this item must be ordered (e.g., case pack size, pallet quantity). Orders must be in multiples of this value.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the primary or preferred source for this item. Used in automated replenishment and purchase order generation.

attributes.name: promotional_allowance_percent
attributes.description: Standard promotional discount percentage offered by this vendor for this item during promotional periods. Used in temporary price reduction (TPR) planning.

attributes.name: return_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a return merchandise authorization (RMA) is required from this vendor before returning defective or unsold items.

attributes.name: slotting_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time or recurring fee paid by the vendor for shelf space allocation for this item. Common in new item introductions and category resets.

attributes.name: vendor_cost
attributes.description: The current negotiated cost per vendor unit of measure. Used for purchase order pricing and gross margin calculations. Subject to contract terms and promotional allowances.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The vendor's internal catalog or part number for this item, used in purchase orders and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: vendor_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order submission to expected delivery at the distribution center or store. Critical for replenishment planning and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: vendor_pack_size
attributes.description: Number of consumer units (eaches) contained in the vendor's shipping unit (case or pallet). Used for unit conversion between vendor ordering and store selling units.

attributes.name: vendor_quality_certification
attributes.description: Quality certifications held by the vendor for this item (e.g., USDA Organic, Non-GMO Project, Fair Trade, HACCP, SQF). Pipe-separated list if multiple certifications apply.

attributes.name: vendor_reliability_rating
attributes.description: Performance rating for this vendor on this item, based on fill rate, on-time delivery, and quality metrics. Used in vendor selection and category captain decisions.

attributes.name: vendor_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure used by the vendor for ordering and invoicing this item. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|pound|kilogram|liter|gallon|dozen|box — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_upc
attributes.description: The UPC or GTIN assigned by the vendor for this item, may differ from retailer's UPC in case of private label or vendor-specific packaging.

domains.name: store
domains.description: Physical retail locations including supermarkets, pharmacies, fuel centers, and micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs). Manages store profiles, layouts, departments, gondolas, endcaps, backrooms, operating hours, formats, service capabilities, and regional hierarchy. Supports store clustering, comp sales performance tracking, and site selection.
domains.references: GS1 GLN (Global Location Number), OSHA Workplace Standards

products.name: store_location
products.description: Master record for every physical retail location operated by Grocery, including supermarkets, pharmacies, fuel centers, and micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs). Captures store number, banner name, format type (superstore, neighborhood market, express), ownership type (owned/leased), gross and selling square footage, opening date, remodel date, closure date, operational status, primary phone number, email, and emergency contact information. This is the SSOT for store identity across the enterprise and the anchor entity for all store-domain relationships. Every cross-domain reference to a physical store resolves to this product.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical retail location. Primary key for the store_location entity. This is the single source of truth (SSOT) for store identity across the enterprise and the anchor entity for all store-domain relationships.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Cash handling and bank reconciliation require each store to reference its dedicated bank account.

attributes.name: banner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.banner. Business justification: Store locations have a textual banner_name; adding store_location.banner_id FK creates a proper reference to the banner master table, enables consistent reporting, and removes the redundant banner_nam

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Store‑level expense reporting requires linking each store to its primary cost center for P&L and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.dc_facility. Business justification: REQUIRED: Store replenishment planning needs the primary DC assignment to calculate inbound logistics; experts expect a dc_facility_id on each store for routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.district. Business justification: Each store belongs to a district; adding district_id creates the hierarchical link without redundancy.

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Store format is a master reference; replace string format_type with FK to store_format for consistency and normalization.

attributes.name: gateway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_gateway. Business justification: Required for POS settlement reporting: each store is assigned a payment gateway that processes its transactions, needed for daily settlement batch generation and compliance audits.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Daily sales posting uses a default GL account per store; linking enables automated journal entry generation.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Tax and regulatory filings require each store to be linked to its legal entity for jurisdictional compliance.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Pricing zone assignment per store drives zone‑specific price strategies; required for Price Zone Performance Report and zone‑based price optimization.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability dashboards aggregate sales by profit center; each store must be assigned to a profit center for store‑wide profit reporting.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.program_config. Business justification: Required for store‑level loyalty program settings used in earn‑rate calculations, store‑specific promotions, and compliance reporting; a store manager configures the program per store.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Allows direct regional performance reporting and inventory allocation per store without traversing district hierarchy.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: REQUIRED: Assortment planning assigns each store to a store cluster for category mix, planogram templates, and performance reporting; linking store_location to store_cluster enables cluster‑based asso

attributes.name: accepts_snap_ebt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store is authorized to accept SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits via EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer). Impacts payment processing, regulatory compliance, and customer accessibility.

attributes.name: accepts_wic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store is authorized to accept WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program benefits. Impacts product assortment, POS configuration, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the store location. Used for customer navigation, delivery routing, and regulatory reporting. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite number, building identifier, or cross-street. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: backroom_square_footage
attributes.description: Square footage of storage and receiving areas behind the sales floor. Used for inventory capacity planning, replenishment strategy, and operational efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the store is located. Used for geographic analysis, market segmentation, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date this store location permanently ceased operations. Null for active stores. Used for historical analysis, lease obligation tracking, and asset disposition planning.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Used for international operations, currency handling, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store location record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for store-level communication. Used for customer inquiries, vendor coordination, and internal communications. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 emergency contact number for the store location. Used for after-hours incidents, security alerts, and facility emergencies. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: gross_square_footage
attributes.description: Total building square footage including sales floor, backroom, offices, restrooms, and mechanical spaces. Used for facility management, lease agreements, and property tax calculations.

attributes.name: has_bakery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes an in-store bakery. Impacts food safety compliance, production scheduling, and fresh product assortment.

attributes.name: has_deli
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a deli department with prepared foods. Impacts food safety compliance (HACCP), staffing, and merchandising strategy.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, HACCP

attributes.name: has_floral
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a floral department. Impacts perishable inventory management, vendor relationships, and seasonal merchandising.

attributes.name: has_fuel_center
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location includes a fuel center. Impacts environmental compliance (EPA), pricing strategy, and loyalty program integration.

attributes.name: has_meat_department
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a full-service meat department with butchers. Impacts USDA compliance, cold chain management, and staffing.

attributes.name: has_organic_section
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a dedicated organic and natural foods section. Impacts merchandising strategy, vendor relationships, and customer segmentation.

attributes.name: has_pharmacy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location includes a licensed pharmacy department. Impacts regulatory compliance (DEA, State Boards of Pharmacy, HIPAA), staffing requirements, and service offerings.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy, DEA, HIPAA

attributes.name: has_seafood
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a fresh seafood department. Impacts cold chain management, HACCP compliance, and specialized staffing requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, HACCP

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.description: The name of the holiday when schedule_type is holiday. Examples include Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years Day, Independence Day. Used for customer communication and workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: is_24_hour_store
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store operates 24 hours per day. True if store never closes, False if store has defined open and close times.

attributes.name: is_closed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store is completely closed on this date or day of week. True if closed all day, False if open for any period.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this operating hours record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about these operating hours. May include reasons for changes, special instructions, or customer communication details.

attributes.name: online_ordering_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether online ordering for pickup or delivery is available during these operating hours. True if omnichannel order fulfillment is active, False if disabled.

attributes.name: operating_hours_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this operating hours record. Active indicates currently in effect, inactive for historical records, pending for future scheduled changes, superseded when replaced by a newer record.

attributes.name: pharmacy_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store pharmacy closes for prescription services. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates pharmacy is closed or not available at this location.

attributes.name: pharmacy_lunch_break_end
attributes.description: The end time of the pharmacy lunch break closure period. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Required by some State Boards of Pharmacy for single-pharmacist locations.

attributes.name: pharmacy_lunch_break_start
attributes.description: The start time of the pharmacy lunch break closure period. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Required by some State Boards of Pharmacy for single-pharmacist locations.

attributes.name: pharmacy_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store pharmacy opens for prescription services. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates pharmacy is closed or not available at this location.

attributes.name: pickup_window_end_time
attributes.description: The latest time when curbside or in-store pickup orders can be collected by customers. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Supports omnichannel click-and-collect fulfillment slot availability.

attributes.name: pickup_window_start_time
attributes.description: The earliest time when curbside or in-store pickup orders can be collected by customers. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Supports omnichannel click-and-collect fulfillment slot availability.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for resolving conflicts when multiple operating hours records apply to the same store and date. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Date-specific overrides typically have priority 1, standard weekly schedules have priority 10.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when these operating hours were published to customer-facing channels. Used for audit trail and customer communication tracking.

attributes.name: published_to_website
attributes.description: Indicates whether these operating hours have been published to the customer-facing store locator and website. True if visible to customers, False if internal only.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operating hours schedule. Standard represents normal weekly hours, holiday represents holiday overrides, special_event for promotional events, temporary for short-term changes, seasonal for recurring seasonal adjustments, emergency for unplanned closures or modifications.

attributes.name: senior_hours_end_time
attributes.description: The end time for dedicated senior citizen and vulnerable population shopping hours. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if no senior hours are offered.

attributes.name: senior_hours_start_time
attributes.description: The start time for dedicated senior citizen and vulnerable population shopping hours. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if no senior hours are offered.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this operating hours data. Examples include Oracle Retail, SAP Retail, or proprietary store management systems.

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: The name of the special event when schedule_type is special_event. Examples include Grand Opening, Anniversary Sale, Community Day. Used for promotional planning and extended hours justification.

attributes.name: store_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the main store closes to customer shopping. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates store is closed for the day.

attributes.name: store_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the main store opens for customer shopping. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates store is closed for the day.

Each record defines the capability type, activation status, capacity limits (e.g., max concurrent pickup orders), staffing requirements, equipment dependencies, and effective date range. Enables omnichannel order routing, customer-facing store locator feature display, labor planning, and site selection analysis.

attributes.name: average_fulfillment_time_minutes

attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the service capability to support filtering and reporting.

attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of service capability (e.g., CURBSIDE_PICKUP, HOME_DELIVERY, PHARMACY_DRIVE_THRU, COINSTAR, WESTERN_UNION, STARBUCKS_KIOSK, SUSHI_BAR, FLORAL_CUSTOM, EBT_SNAP_WIC, LOTTERY, MONEY_ORDER, BOTTLE_RETURN).

attributes.description: Detailed description of the service capability, including what it offers and any special conditions or limitations.

attributes.name: capability_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the service capability for customer-facing display and internal reference.

attributes.name: capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum concurrent capacity for this service capability (e.g., maximum number of pickup orders that can be processed simultaneously, number of drive-thru lanes, kiosk stations). Null if no specific limit applies.

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the capacity limit (e.g., orders per hour, concurrent customers, transaction slots).

attributes.name: compliance_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether staff must complete specific compliance training or certification to operate this service capability (e.g., HIPAA training for pharmacy, food safety certification for food service).
