attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service capability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability should be displayed to customers in store locator tools, mobile apps, and marketing materials.

attributes.name: daily_capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of service transactions or orders that can be fulfilled in a single day. Used for omnichannel order routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: display_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority for ordering service capabilities in customer-facing displays. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this service capability was or will be discontinued at the store location. Null indicates the service is ongoing with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: equipment_description
attributes.description: Description of the specialized equipment or infrastructure required to support this service capability, including make, model, or configuration details.

attributes.name: equipment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialized equipment or infrastructure is required to deliver this service capability (e.g., refrigerated pickup lockers, drive-thru window, kiosk hardware).

attributes.name: installation_date

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent maintenance or inspection was performed on the equipment or infrastructure supporting this service capability.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service capability record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date

attributes.name: license_number

attributes.name: license_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory license or permit is required to offer this service capability (e.g., pharmacy license, lottery license, money transmitter license).
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy, State Lottery Commissions, State Banking Regulators

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next scheduled maintenance or inspection is due for the equipment or infrastructure supporting this service capability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about this service capability, including special instructions, known issues, or temporary conditions.

attributes.name: omnichannel_routing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability is integrated with the Order Management System (OMS) for automated omnichannel order routing and fulfillment assignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: oms_capability_code
attributes.description: Code used by the Order Management System to identify and route orders to this service capability. Must match OMS configuration.

attributes.name: operating_hours_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the operating hours for this service capability if different from store hours (e.g., Pharmacy: Mon-Fri 9am-9pm, Sat 9am-6pm, Sun 10am-6pm).

attributes.name: operating_hours_same_as_store_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Hours Same as Store Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability operates during the same hours as the store itself, or has different operating hours.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of revenue from this service capability that is shared with a vendor partner. Confidential business information used for financial reporting and vendor management.

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal service capability typically ends each year. Null if not seasonal.

attributes.name: seasonal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability is offered seasonally rather than year-round (e.g., holiday gift wrapping, seasonal outdoor plant sales).

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal service capability typically begins each year. Null if not seasonal.

attributes.name: staffing_requirement_fte
attributes.description: Number of full-time equivalent employees required to operate this service capability during standard operating hours. Used for labor planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: ambient_zone_enabled

attributes.name: average_inventory_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Rolling average percentage of inventory records that match physical counts during cycle counts. Key metric for operational excellence.

attributes.name: average_order_accuracy_percent

attributes.name: average_pick_time_seconds

attributes.name: chilled_zone_enabled

attributes.name: cold_chain_monitoring_enabled

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: daily_order_capacity

attributes.name: deactivation_date

attributes.name: food_safety_inspection_score

attributes.name: frozen_zone_enabled

attributes.name: haccp_certified

attributes.name: last_food_safety_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent food safety inspection by regulatory authorities (FDA, USDA, or state health department). Used for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MFC profile record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: mfc_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the MFC, used in operational systems and reporting. Format: MFC followed by 6 digits.

attributes.name: mfc_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the MFC, typically including geographic or store reference for easy identification by operations teams.

attributes.name: mfc_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MFC based on its operational model: automated (fully robotic picking and packing), semi-automated (hybrid human and robotic), or manual (human-only fulfillment).

attributes.name: number_of_packing_stations
attributes.description: Count of workstations where picked orders are packed into bags or boxes for customer delivery or pickup. Used for labor planning.

attributes.name: number_of_picking_stations
attributes.description: Count of workstations where associates or robots pick items into customer orders. Key metric for throughput capacity planning.

attributes.name: number_of_robots
attributes.description: Total count of robotic units (picking robots, transport robots, sorting robots) deployed in the MFC. Zero for manual facilities.

attributes.name: oms_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC is integrated with the enterprise Order Management System for real-time order routing and fulfillment orchestration.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time for MFC operations in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used for order routing and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time for MFC operations in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used for order routing and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MFC indicating whether it is actively fulfilling orders, temporarily offline, being built, or permanently closed.

attributes.name: peak_hourly_order_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders the MFC can process in a single hour during peak demand periods. Critical for real-time order routing decisions.

attributes.name: picking_square_footage
attributes.description: Floor area dedicated to order picking operations in square feet. Used for productivity analysis and space utilization metrics.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC uses RFID technology for inventory tracking and order accuracy verification.

attributes.name: robotics_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the robotics or automation technology provider for automated or semi-automated MFCs (e.g., AutoStore, Dematic, Ocado). Null for manual MFCs.

attributes.name: sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique SKUs stocked in the MFC at any given time. Indicates assortment breadth and inventory complexity.

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total floor area of the MFC facility in square feet, including all operational zones, staging areas, and support spaces.

attributes.name: total_tote_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of totes (storage containers) that the MFC can hold at any given time. Key metric for inventory capacity planning.

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_operation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC operates continuously 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. True for round-the-clock facilities.

attributes.name: wms_instance_code

attributes.name: wms_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the WMS platform integrated with this MFC (e.g., Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM). Used for system integration and support.

products.name: health_inspection
products.description: Record of food safety and health department inspections conducted at a store location. Captures inspection ID, inspection date, inspecting agency (local health department, FDA, USDA), inspection type (routine, follow-up, complaint-driven), overall score, critical violation count, non-critical violation count, HACCP compliance status, corrective action plan, and re-inspection date. Supports FDA/USDA regulatory compliance and HACCP program management.
products.reference: Food Safety Inspection Record — FDA/USDA/HACCP Compliance

attributes.name: health_inspection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health inspection record. Primary key for the health inspection entity.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the health inspection was conducted.

attributes.name: closure_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the store or department was permitted to reopen after corrective actions were verified and approved by the inspecting agency.

attributes.name: closure_ordered
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the inspecting agency ordered immediate closure of the store or specific departments due to critical food safety violations posing imminent health hazard. True indicates closure ordered, False indicates no closure.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Emergency Powers

attributes.name: closure_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the store or department closure became effective due to health violations.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which all corrective actions must be completed to address violations identified during the inspection.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions required to address violations, including specific steps, responsible parties, and timelines for remediation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective actions are required to address violations identified during the inspection. True indicates corrective actions needed, False indicates no actions required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the health inspection record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of critical violations identified during the inspection. Critical violations are food safety issues that pose immediate risk to public health (e.g., improper food temperatures, cross-contamination, inadequate handwashing).
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 5, HACCP Principles

attributes.name: cross_contamination_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for preventing cross-contamination between raw and ready-to-eat foods, proper separation of food preparation areas, and equipment sanitation.

attributes.name: departments_inspected
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of store departments included in the inspection scope (e.g., Deli, Bakery, Meat, Seafood, Produce, Pharmacy, Prepared Foods, Grocery).

attributes.name: facility_maintenance_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for physical facility maintenance including floors, walls, ceilings, lighting, ventilation, and equipment condition.

attributes.name: food_temperature_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for proper food storage and holding temperatures. Critical for preventing bacterial growth and foodborne illness.

attributes.name: haccp_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Status of compliance with HACCP food safety management system principles. HACCP is a systematic preventive approach to food safety addressing biological, chemical, and physical hazards. Compliant indicates full adherence, non-compliant indicates violations, not-applicable indicates HACCP not required for this location, partial indicates some HACCP elements in place.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-2, HACCP Principles

attributes.name: handwashing_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for proper handwashing facilities, employee hand hygiene practices, and personal cleanliness standards.

attributes.name: inspecting_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency or health department that conducted the inspection (e.g., County Health Department, FDA, USDA).
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, USDA FSIS Regulations

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the health inspection was conducted at the store location.

attributes.name: inspection_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the inspection in minutes, from start to completion.

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique inspection number assigned by the inspecting agency or internal tracking system.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: inspection_report_url
attributes.description: URL link to the full inspection report document stored in the document management system or public health department website.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the health inspection. Scheduled indicates future inspection, in-progress indicates active inspection, completed indicates inspection finished, passed indicates no critical violations, failed indicates critical violations found, pending-review indicates awaiting final determination, cancelled indicates inspection did not occur. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in-progress|completed|passed|failed|pending-review|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of health inspection conducted. Routine inspections are scheduled periodic reviews, follow-up inspections verify corrective actions, complaint-driven inspections respond to customer or employee reports, pre-opening inspections occur before new store launch, special inspections address specific concerns, and reinspections verify compliance after violations.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: inspector_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or badge number of the health inspector assigned by the inspecting agency.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the health inspector who conducted the inspection.

attributes.name: letter_grade
attributes.description: Letter grade assigned to the inspection based on overall score, if applicable in the jurisdiction (A=excellent, B=good, C=satisfactory, D=marginal, F=failing).

attributes.name: non_critical_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of non-critical violations identified during the inspection. Non-critical violations are food safety issues that do not pose immediate risk but require correction (e.g., minor equipment maintenance, documentation gaps).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or comments from the inspector or store management regarding the inspection, violations, or corrective actions.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Numerical score assigned to the inspection representing overall food safety compliance. Scoring scale varies by jurisdiction (e.g., 0-100 scale where higher is better, or deduction-based scoring).
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Scoring Standards

attributes.name: pest_control_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for pest prevention and control measures, including evidence of rodents, insects, or other pests.

attributes.name: posted_at_store
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the inspection results or grade card has been posted at the store location as required by local regulations. True indicates posted, False indicates not posted.

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the inspection results are subject to public disclosure or posting requirements per local health department regulations. True indicates public disclosure required, False indicates confidential.
attributes.references: State Health Department Public Records Laws

attributes.name: reinspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up reinspection to verify that corrective actions have been completed and violations have been resolved.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: reinspection_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a follow-up reinspection is required to verify corrective actions have been completed. True indicates reinspection needed, False indicates no reinspection required.

attributes.name: score_scale
attributes.description: Description of the scoring scale used for the overall score (e.g., 0-100 scale, A-F letter grade, pass/fail, deduction-based).

attributes.name: total_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of violations (critical and non-critical combined) identified during the inspection.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the health inspection record was last modified in the system.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Real-time and historical stock positions across all stores, distribution centers, and MFCs. Manages on-hand quantities, reserved stock, FIFO/LIFO rotation tracking, shrink records (theft, spoilage, damage), OOS monitoring, cycle counts, cold chain temperature compliance, and CAO replenishment signals. Integrates with WMS, SAP MM, and ERP systems.

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Real-time and near-real-time on-hand stock position for every SKU at every location (store, DC, MFC). Captures on-hand quantity, reserved quantity, available-to-sell quantity, in-transit quantity, on-order quantity, and comprehensive OOS tracking: OOS status flag, OOS start timestamp, OOS end timestamp (when restocked), OOS duration in hours, root cause category (supplier OOS, DC OOS, store receiving delay, shrink, demand spike), estimated lost sales value, and OOS detection method (POS scan failure, CAO signal, manual audit). This is the authoritative SSOT for current inventory levels and out-of-stock events across the enterprise, fed by SAP MM goods movements and Manhattan WMS inventory control. Supports OOS monitoring and alerting, CAO replenishment signal generation, omnichannel availability checks, and store operations performance measurement.

products.name: goods_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement event — receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments (including cycle-count corrections, damage write-offs, donation dispositions, and recall removals), returns, and write-offs — across all locations. Sourced from SAP MM material documents and Manhattan WMS transactions. Provides the full audit trail for stock position changes, supports FIFO/LIFO rotation tracking, and serves as the controlled, auditable record for all inventory quantity changes including authorized corrections. This is the single source of truth for all inventory quantity change events.

attributes.name: receipt_notes

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the goods receipt transaction was initiated or completed.

attributes.name: receipt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receipt transaction: PO (purchase order receipt), DSD (direct store delivery), RETURN (vendor return), TRANSFER (inter-location transfer), CROSS_DOCK (cross-dock operation), SAMPLE (vendor sample).

attributes.name: rfid_scanned_flag

attributes.name: seal_intact_flag

attributes.name: seal_number

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt

attributes.name: temperature_compliant_flag

attributes.name: total_accepted_quantity

attributes.name: total_received_quantity
attributes.description: The aggregate quantity of all items physically received in this goods receipt transaction, summed across all line items.

attributes.name: total_rejected_quantity
attributes.description: The aggregate quantity of all items rejected due to damage, quality issues, or discrepancies, summed across all line items.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: The trailer or container identification number used for the inbound shipment.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for order fulfillment and transportation routing. Critical priority is used for emergency stockout situations, high priority for fast-moving SKUs, normal for standard replenishment, low for slow-moving items.

attributes.name: replenishment_trigger
attributes.description: The business rule or algorithm that initiated the replenishment order. CAO forecast uses demand planning algorithms, min-max threshold triggers when inventory falls below reorder point, safety stock maintains buffer inventory, manual override is buyer-initiated, promotional event supports ad circulars, seasonal demand addresses seasonal patterns.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the destination location requires the replenishment inventory to arrive. Used for transportation planning and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the order is tracked using RFID technology for real-time visibility and automated receiving. True if RFID tags are applied at case or pallet level.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the order to be shipped from the source DC. Calculated based on requested delivery date and transit time.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special handling requirements such as fragile items, hazardous materials, or delivery time windows. Communicated to warehouse and transportation teams.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature control classification for the order. Ambient for shelf-stable products, refrigerated for fresh produce and dairy, frozen for frozen foods, multi-temp for mixed orders requiring multiple temperature zones.

attributes.name: total_cube_volume
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the order in cubic feet or cubic meters. Used for trailer utilization optimization and cross-dock planning.

attributes.name: total_line_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct SKU line items included in the replenishment order. Used for picking complexity assessment and labor planning.

attributes.name: total_ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all line items in the replenishment order, measured in eaches or cases depending on line-level unit of measure. Used for capacity planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: total_pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets required to ship the order. Used for transportation capacity planning and dock scheduling.

attributes.name: total_received_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all line items received at the destination location. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage, loss, or receiving discrepancies.

attributes.name: total_shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all line items actually shipped from the source DC. May differ from ordered quantity due to inventory availability or allocation adjustments.

attributes.name: total_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the order in pounds or kilograms. Used for transportation cost calculation and carrier selection.

products.name: dc_transfer
products.description: Records inter-DC and DC-to-store stock transfer movements including cross-dock flow-through and store-to-store rebalancing operations. Captures transfer type (cross-dock, pick-and-ship, store-to-store, DC-to-DC), origin location, destination location, transfer date, carrier, trailer number, total pallets, total cases, transfer reason (allocation, rebalancing, emergency, recall, seasonal), priority level, and transfer status (planned, picking, loaded, in-transit, delivered, confirmed). Managed in Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP WM. Enables inventory movement visibility and network optimization.
products.reference: SAP WM Transfer Order / Manhattan WMS Transfer

attributes.name: carrier_id

attributes.name: total_cube_cf
attributes.description: Total volume of the transfer shipment in cubic feet. Used for trailer utilization optimization and space planning.

attributes.name: total_pallets

attributes.name: total_units

attributes.name: temperature_reading
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading (in Fahrenheit) recorded at the time of DSD delivery receipt. Used for cold chain compliance verification and quality control.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), HACCP

attributes.name: total_case_count
attributes.description: Total number of cases delivered in the DSD transaction. Used for receiving dock capacity planning and inventory volume tracking.

attributes.name: total_sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct SKUs included in the DSD delivery. Used for receiving complexity assessment and labor planning.

attributes.name: total_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (eaches) delivered across all SKUs in the DSD delivery. Used for detailed inventory tracking and shrink analysis.

attributes.name: vendor_delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Vendor-provided delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the DSD delivery. Used for cross-reference and dispute resolution.

products.name: transport_route
products.description: Master record for DC-to-store and inter-DC transportation routes and their execution, encompassing route definition (origin DC, stop sequence, mileage, carrier, trailer type, capacity, frequency), individual stop details (stop location, arrival window, pallet/case count, special handling), and load plan execution (trailer assignment, departure time, load sequence, temperature zones, dispatch status). Managed in JDA TMS. Enables route optimization, freight cost allocation, and carrier performance tracking.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transportation route. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier or logistics provider responsible for executing this route. Links to vendor or carrier master data.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Transport routes have fixed and variable costs (route_cost_fixed, route_cost_per_mile) that must be allocated to cost centers for freight cost management and carrier performance reporting. Retail-groc

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or facility where the route originates. Links to the facility or warehouse master data.

attributes.name: destination_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Route-to-node assignment: transport routes connect origin DCs to destination fulfillment nodes (stores, e-commerce DCs). Grocery supply chain planners use this link for route optimization, node capaci

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: DEA requires tracking of transport routes used for controlled substance delivery to pharmacy locations. Cold chain drug delivery routes must be designated per pharmacy for compliance audits. Grocery p

attributes.name: backhaul_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route includes backhaul operations, where the trailer picks up goods from vendors or stores on the return trip to the DC. True if backhaul is planned; false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the JDA TMS system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_dock_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route supports cross-dock operations, where goods are transferred directly from inbound to outbound trailers without intermediate storage. True if cross-dock is allowed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this route configuration was or will be retired or replaced. Null for currently active routes. Used for route lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this route configuration became or will become active. Used for route lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Expected total time to complete the route including driving time, stop time, and rest breaks, measured in hours. Used for scheduling and on-time delivery tracking.

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of trailer capacity utilization for this route, used for load optimization and efficiency tracking. Represents the percentage of orders fulfilled completely on each route execution.
attributes.references: Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model - Perfect Order Fulfillment

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_rate
attributes.description: Fuel surcharge rate applied to this route, typically expressed as a percentage or per-mile amount. Adjusted periodically based on diesel fuel price indices.
attributes.references: DOE Energy Information Administration (EIA) diesel fuel price index

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether GPS tracking is enabled for real-time location monitoring of the trailer or truck on this route. True if GPS devices are installed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is certified and equipped to transport hazardous materials. True if carrier and equipment meet DOT HAZMAT requirements; false otherwise.
attributes.references: DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (HMR); EPA hazardous waste transport rules

attributes.name: last_executed_date
attributes.description: Date when this route was most recently executed. Used for route utilization analysis and performance tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was last updated in the JDA TMS system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, instructions, or comments about the route. May include driver instructions, seasonal considerations, or operational alerts.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage for on-time delivery performance for this route, used for carrier performance evaluation and SLA compliance. Typically 95-98% for grocery retail.

attributes.name: operating_days
attributes.description: Days of the week on which this route operates, typically stored as comma-separated day codes (e.g., MON,WED,FRI) or day-of-week flags.

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID technology is used to track shipments on this route. True if RFID tags are applied to pallets or cases for real-time visibility; false otherwise.

attributes.name: route_cost_fixed
attributes.description: Fixed cost component for executing this route, independent of distance or load. Includes dispatch fees, administrative overhead, and minimum carrier charges.

attributes.name: route_cost_per_mile
attributes.description: Standard cost per mile for this route, used for freight cost allocation and budgeting. Includes fuel, driver wages, maintenance, and carrier fees.

attributes.name: route_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this route is executed. Daily routes run every day; weekly routes run on specific days; bi-weekly routes run every two weeks; monthly routes run once per month; on-demand routes are triggered by need; seasonal routes operate during specific periods.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the route, typically indicating origin and destination or geographic coverage.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the route, used in operational communications and dispatch systems. Managed in JDA TMS.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) for route identification

attributes.name: route_optimization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is subject to dynamic optimization algorithms in JDA TMS. True if stop sequence and timing can be adjusted by the system; false if route is fixed.

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the route. Active routes are in regular operation; inactive routes are temporarily not in use; suspended routes are on hold pending review; planned routes are designed but not yet operational; archived routes are historical records.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route based on its operational purpose. DC-to-store routes deliver from distribution center to retail locations; inter-DC routes transfer between distribution centers; DSD (Direct Store Delivery) routes bypass DC; cross-dock routes involve immediate transfer without storage; backhaul routes return empty trailers or pick up vendor goods; milk-run routes serve multiple stops in sequence.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_time
attributes.description: Standard time of day when the route is scheduled to depart from the origin DC, stored as HH:MM format (e.g., 06:00 for 6 AM departure). Used for dispatch planning and driver scheduling.

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special handling, loading, or delivery requirements for this route (e.g., liftgate required, inside delivery, appointment required, security escort).

attributes.name: stop_count
attributes.description: Total number of delivery or pickup stops on this route, excluding the origin DC. Used for route complexity assessment and driver workload planning.

attributes.name: temperature_max_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled routes. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP Critical Control Points

attributes.name: temperature_min_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled routes. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP Critical Control Points

attributes.name: temperature_zone_required
attributes.description: Temperature control requirement for this route. Ambient for room temperature; refrigerated for 32-40°F; frozen for below 0°F; multi-temp for trailers with multiple zones; controlled for specific temperature ranges. Critical for cold chain compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) cold chain requirements; HACCP temperature control standards

attributes.name: total_route_distance_miles
attributes.description: Total distance of the route from origin to final destination, including all intermediate stops, measured in miles. Used for freight cost calculation and driver scheduling.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_cases
attributes.description: Maximum number of cases that can be loaded on the trailer for this route, used when shipments are measured in case count rather than pallets.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_cubic_feet
attributes.description: Volumetric capacity of the trailer in cubic feet, used for cube optimization and load planning.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_pallets
attributes.description: Maximum number of standard pallets that can be loaded on the trailer for this route. Typically 26-28 pallets for a 53-foot trailer.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the trailer in pounds, constrained by DOT regulations and vehicle specifications. Typically 40,000-45,000 lbs for a loaded trailer.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) weight limits

attributes.name: trailer_type
attributes.description: Type of trailer equipment required for this route. Dry van for ambient goods; refrigerated for cold chain; flatbed for oversized items; tanker for liquids; intermodal for rail/truck combination; multi-temp for mixed temperature zones.

products.name: vendor_lead_time
products.description: Operational lead time parameters by vendor-item-location combination used by Blue Yonder demand planning to calculate reorder points and safety stock. Captures vendor ID, item/SKU, destination DC or store, order-to-ship days, ship-to-receipt days, total lead time days, minimum order quantity, order multiple, case pack size, effective/expiration dates, lead time tier (standard, expedited, emergency), and seasonal adjustment factors. Drives automated replenishment calculations and PO timing. Distinct from vendor master (vendor domain) — this is supply-chain operational planning data.
products.reference: Blue Yonder Supplier Lead Time / Oracle Retail Replenishment Attributes

attributes.name: vendor_lead_time_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor lead time record. Primary key for this operational planning parameter.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary carrier used for this vendor-item-destination lane. Links to carrier master for routing and performance tracking.

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Landed cost modeling: vendor lead time tiers (lead_time_tier, total_lead_time_days) directly affect freight and landed cost calculations stored in cost_price. Procurement analysts use this link in 'la

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.dc_facility. Business justification: Vendor lead times are by vendor-item-location combination where the destination location can be a DC facility. The existing store_location_id covers store destinations, but DC-destined lead times need

attributes.name: drug_id

attributes.name: sku_id

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination DC, store, or MFC receiving the shipment. Determines where the lead time applies.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Location Master

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_supplier_contract. Business justification: Vendor lead time parameters are defined within supplier contracts (supply_supplier_contract has lead_time_days column confirming this). Linking vendor_lead_time to supply_supplier_contract establishes

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor supplying the item. Links to the vendor master in the vendor domain.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Vendor Master

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier_site. Business justification: Lead times in grocery supply chain are site-specific — a supplier's eastern DC has different lead times than its western facility. Linking vendor_lead_time to supplier_site enables site-level lead tim

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Lead time commitments are codified in trade agreements as SLA terms. Linking vendor_lead_time to trade_agreement enables compliance tracking against contractual lead time obligations and supports vend

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: Lead times are item-specific at the vendor level — case pack size, order multiples, and shelf life on vendor_item directly affect replenishment lead time calculations. Linking vendor_lead_time to vend

attributes.name: case_pack_size
attributes.description: Number of units per case pack from the vendor. Defines the vendor shipping unit for this item.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Pack Hierarchy

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether temperature-controlled logistics are required for this vendor-item combination. True for perishable items requiring refrigeration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead time record was first created in the system. Establishes the origin point for this parameter configuration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Audit Trail

attributes.name: cross_dock_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor-item can bypass DC storage and be cross-docked directly to stores. True enables flow-through distribution.

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Type of destination location for the shipment. DC = Distribution Center, MFC = Micro-Fulfillment Center.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this lead time parameter becomes active. Start of the validity period for this lead time configuration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Temporal Parameter Management

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this lead time parameter expires. End of the validity period. Null indicates no expiration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Temporal Parameter Management

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining responsibility for shipping costs and risk transfer. Examples: FOB, CIF, DDP.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead time record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Audit Trail

attributes.name: lead_time_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this lead time parameter. Active = in use for replenishment calculations, Inactive = not currently used, Suspended = temporarily disabled, Under Review = being evaluated for changes.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Parameter Lifecycle

attributes.name: lead_time_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier for the lead time. Standard = normal replenishment, Expedited = faster service, Emergency = urgent fulfillment, DSD = Direct Store Delivery bypass DC.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Service Level Definitions

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: Standard deviation of lead time in days. Measures consistency of vendor delivery performance. Used to calculate safety stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Calculation

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be ordered from the vendor for this item. Vendor-imposed constraint on order size.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Vendor Item Attributes

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments or special instructions related to this vendor lead time configuration. Used for context that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: Order quantity must be a multiple of this value. Ensures orders align with vendor case pack or pallet configurations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Vendor Item Attributes

attributes.name: order_to_ship_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order placement to vendor shipment departure. Vendor processing time component of total lead time.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Lead Time Parameters

attributes.name: reorder_point_units
attributes.description: Inventory level in units that triggers automatic replenishment. Calculated from lead time, demand forecast, and safety stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Policy

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID tags are used to track shipments from this vendor for this item. Enables real-time supply chain visibility.

attributes.name: safety_stock_days
attributes.description: Number of days of safety stock coverage calculated based on lead time and variability. Buffer inventory to protect against stockouts.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Policy

attributes.name: seasonal_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base lead time during seasonal periods. Values >1.0 extend lead time, <1.0 reduce it. Used for holiday or peak season adjustments.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: seasonal_period_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the seasonal period for which the adjustment factor applies. Examples: HOLIDAY, SUMMER, BACKTOSCHOOL.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Seasonal Calendar

attributes.name: ship_to_receipt_days
attributes.description: Number of days from vendor shipment departure to receipt at destination location. Transit time component of total lead time.
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management - Transit Time Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system that provided this lead time data. Examples: BYDP (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), MANUAL.

attributes.name: total_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total end-to-end lead time from PO placement to receipt at destination. Sum of order-to-ship and ship-to-receipt days. Used to calculate reorder points.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Calculation

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for shipments from this vendor to the destination. Impacts transit time and cost.

attributes.name: vendor_fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of orders fulfilled completely by the vendor for this item. Historical performance metric used to adjust lead time parameters.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Vendor Performance Metrics

products.name: demand_forecast
products.description: Demand and supply forecasts generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning at the item-location-week level. Captures forecast period, item/SKU, location (store or DC), baseline forecast units, promotional lift units, total forecast units, forecast confidence score, forecast method (statistical, ML, manual override), last updated timestamp, and planner ID. Used to drive replenishment orders and DC allocation. Operational planning data — not an analytics aggregate.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Primary key for demand_forecast

attributes.name: ad_circular_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug. Business justification: Pharmacy drug demand forecasting by NDC is a distinct operational process for formulary management, 340B program compliance, and drug shortage planning. Existing product_item_id covers general merchan

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Demand forecasts must align with fiscal periods for financial planning, open-to-buy budget management, and forecast vs. actual variance reporting. Retail-grocery merchandise finance teams use period-a

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Omnichannel demand forecasting: grocery retailers generate demand forecasts for e-commerce fulfillment nodes (dark stores, micro-fulfillment centers) distinct from physical store_location. This link e

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being forecasted. Links to the item master data.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.retail_price. Business justification: Price-elastic demand forecasting: demand forecasts are generated at a specific price point; the retail_price in effect during the forecast period is an input to price elasticity modeling. Grocery dema

attributes.name: reward_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.reward_offer. Business justification: Loyalty-offer demand lift forecasting: demand_forecast.promotional_lift_units must be attributed to the specific loyalty reward_offer driving incremental volume. Distinct from TPR events, loyalty offe

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: Cluster-level demand forecasting: grocery retailers generate forecasts segmented by store cluster to drive model selection, seasonal indices, and promotional lift estimates. A demand_forecast scoped t

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store or DC (Distribution Center) for which the forecast is generated. Supports both store-level and DC-level forecasting.

attributes.name: baseline_forecast_units
attributes.description: The baseline demand forecast in units, excluding promotional lift. Represents normal demand patterns based on historical trends and seasonality.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Baseline Forecast

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A score between 0 and 1 indicating the quality of input data used for forecast generation. Factors include completeness of historical sales, POS (Point of Sale) data accuracy, and inventory data reliability.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Data Quality Assessment

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: The coefficient of variation for historical demand, measuring demand volatility. Higher values indicate more variable demand patterns requiring higher safety stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Variability Analysis

attributes.name: forecast_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the forecast was approved by the demand planner and released for use in replenishment planning.

attributes.name: forecast_bias_percentage
attributes.description: The historical forecast bias as a percentage, indicating systematic over-forecasting (positive) or under-forecasting (negative). Used for forecast accuracy monitoring.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Accuracy Metrics

attributes.name: forecast_confidence_score
attributes.description: A confidence score between 0 and 1 indicating the reliability of the forecast. Higher scores indicate greater confidence based on historical accuracy and data quality.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Accuracy Metrics

attributes.name: forecast_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the forecast was initially generated by the Blue Yonder Demand Planning system.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: The number of weeks into the future this forecast covers from the period start date. Typical horizons range from 4 to 52 weeks.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon

attributes.name: forecast_lower_bound_units
attributes.description: The lower bound of the forecast confidence interval in units, representing the pessimistic scenario for demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Confidence Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_method
attributes.description: The method used to generate the forecast. Statistical methods include time series models, machine learning uses advanced algorithms, manual override indicates planner adjustments, hybrid combines multiple methods, and consensus represents collaborative planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecasting Methods

attributes.name: forecast_model_name
attributes.description: The specific forecasting model or algorithm used to generate the forecast (e.g., ARIMA, exponential smoothing, neural network, ensemble model).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Model Configuration

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the forecast period. Typically represents the end of a week for weekly forecasts.

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the forecast period. Typically represents the beginning of a week for weekly forecasts.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the forecast. Draft forecasts are under review, approved forecasts are validated by planners, published forecasts are released to replenishment systems, superseded forecasts are replaced by newer versions, and rejected forecasts are not used.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Workflow

attributes.name: forecast_upper_bound_units
attributes.description: The upper bound of the forecast confidence interval in units, representing the optimistic scenario for demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Confidence Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the forecast for the same item-location-period combination. Increments with each revision to support forecast history and audit trails.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Version Control

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the forecast was last modified, either by system recalculation or manual planner override.

attributes.name: mean_absolute_percentage_error
attributes.description: The Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) for this item-location combination, measuring historical forecast accuracy. Lower values indicate better accuracy.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Accuracy Metrics

attributes.name: new_product_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this forecast is for a new product introduction with limited or no historical sales data. True indicates a new product.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - New Item Forecasting

attributes.name: override_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the planner explaining the rationale for manual forecast overrides or adjustments.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Override Management

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code when a planner manually overrides the system-generated forecast. Captures business context for forecast adjustments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promotion|stockout|weather|seasonality|new_product|discontinuation|market_trend|competitive_action|supply_constraint|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Override Management

attributes.name: promotional_lift_units
attributes.description: The incremental demand units expected from promotional activities such as BOGO (Buy One Get One), TPR (Temporary Price Reduction), or ad circular features.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Promotional Lift

attributes.name: safety_stock_units
attributes.description: The recommended safety stock level in units to buffer against forecast variability and supply chain uncertainty. Used in replenishment calculations.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Calculation

attributes.name: seasonal_index
attributes.description: The seasonal index applied to the forecast for this period, representing the expected demand variation due to seasonality. A value of 1.0 represents average demand, above 1.0 indicates peak season, below 1.0 indicates off-season.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Seasonality Modeling

attributes.name: total_forecast_units
attributes.description: The total demand forecast in units, combining baseline forecast and promotional lift. This is the primary forecast value used for replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Total Forecast

attributes.name: trend_factor
attributes.description: The trend factor applied to the forecast, representing the expected growth or decline in demand over time. Positive values indicate growth, negative values indicate decline.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Trend Analysis

products.name: inbound_shipment_line
products.description: This association product represents the ASN Line Item — the operational record linking one inbound shipment to one purchase order line. It captures the line-level fulfillment detail for each SKU within an ASN, including quantities shipped, quantities received, variance, and per-line compliance status. Each record is created during ASN processing in Manhattan Associates WMS and reconciled against SAP MM goods receipts during receiving. This entity is the atomic unit for three-way matching (PO line → ASN line → invoice line) and cannot be derived from either the shipment header or the PO line alone.. Existence Justification: In grocery supply chain operations, a single PO line can be fulfilled across multiple inbound shipments (partial shipments, split deliveries across ASNs), and a single inbound shipment (ASN) routinely covers multiple PO lines from one or more purchase orders. This is a genuine operational M:N: the business actively creates, tracks, and reconciles ASN-to-PO-line linkages in Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP MM as part of the receiving and invoice-matching process. The relationship itself carries operational data (shipped quantity per line, received quantity per line, variance, line-level shipment status) that belongs to neither the shipment header nor the PO line alone.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking this line item to its parent inbound shipment (ASN). Identifies which physical shipment/trailer this line-level record belongs to.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking this line item to the specific purchase order line being fulfilled. Enables receiving reconciliation and three-way invoice matching at the line level.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity

attributes.name: temperature_compliance_flag

Relevant for perishable, refrigerated, and frozen SKUs. Captured at the line level because a single shipment may carry items with different temperature requirements.
