attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Offer funding and rebate terms are governed by trade agreements; linking enables agreement compliance reporting.

attributes.name: activation_requirement
attributes.description: Action required by the customer to activate the offer. Auto-apply (no action), clip-required (digital coupon clipping), loyalty-required (loyalty program membership), or code-entry (manual coupon code input).

attributes.name: clip_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer must explicitly clip or activate this digital coupon before redemption. True if clipping required, False if auto-applied.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional offer record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel used to deliver this offer to targeted customers.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_barcode
attributes.description: Barcode or QR code value for digital coupon redemption at Point of Sale (POS). Null for non-digital-coupon offers.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_format
attributes.description: Barcode format standard used for digital coupon encoding. Null for non-digital-coupon offers.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Method by which the discount value is calculated and applied.

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the discount. Interpretation depends on discount_type (percentage points for percentage, dollar amount for fixed_amount).

attributes.name: eligible_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel where this offer can be redeemed. Supports omnichannel promotion strategy.

attributes.name: exclusion_rules
attributes.description: Business rules defining products, categories, or conditions that are explicitly excluded from this offer.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Entity responsible for funding the promotional discount. Vendor-funded (trade promotion), grocer-funded (markdown), or co-funded (shared investment).

attributes.name: gmroi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target
attributes.description: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment ratio for this promotional offer. Used for post-promotion performance measurement and optimization.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points awarded to the customer upon redemption of this offer. Null if no points are earned.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_required
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points required to redeem this offer. Null if not a points-based loyalty reward.

attributes.name: manufacturer_coupon_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a manufacturer-issued coupon funded by the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) vendor. True for manufacturer coupons, False for retailer coupons.

attributes.name: maximum_discount_amount
attributes.description: Cap on the total dollar discount that can be applied per transaction. Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount of qualifying items required to activate the offer. Null if no minimum threshold applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of qualifying items required to activate the offer. Null if no quantity threshold applies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional offer record was last modified.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code for the promotional offer. Used for tracking, redemption, and customer communication.

attributes.name: offer_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the promotional offer including terms, conditions, and value proposition.

attributes.name: offer_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotional offer displayed to customers.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional offer.

attributes.name: offer_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification indicating the delivery and targeting mechanism of the offer.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional offer mechanics. BOGO (Buy One Get One), TPR (Temporary Price Reduction), percent-off, dollar-off, mix-and-match, or bundle.

attributes.name: personalization_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the machine learning model or rule set used to generate this personalized offer. Null for mass offers.

attributes.name: personalization_type
attributes.description: Method used to target and personalize this offer. ML model (machine learning recommendation), rule-based (business rule segmentation), mass (broadcast to all), or segment-targeted (predefined customer segment).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority used to resolve conflicts when multiple offers apply to the same item. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer or household can redeem this offer during its validity period. Null for unlimited redemptions.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_transaction
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this offer can be applied within a single transaction. Null for unlimited applications per transaction.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer can be combined with other offers in the same transaction. True if stackable, False if mutually exclusive.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal terms and conditions governing the use and redemption of this promotional offer.
attributes.references: FTC Section 5 Unfair or Deceptive Acts or Practices

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date when the offer becomes active and eligible for redemption.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date when the offer expires and is no longer eligible for redemption.

products.name: promo_calendar
products.description: Promotional planning calendar that organizes all campaigns and offers across time. Tracks weekly ad circular cycles, promotional periods, blackout dates, holiday event windows, and overlap constraints. Supports merchandise planning and assortment management by providing a structured view of promotional cadence across store zones, categories, and channels. Enables conflict detection between simultaneous promotions and coordination with vendor slotting commitments.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional calendar entry. Primary key for the promotional calendar planning entity.

attributes.name: banner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.banner. Business justification: Promotional calendars in grocery retail are fundamentally banner-specific — each banner (Kroger, Ralphs, Fred Meyer) maintains its own weekly ad schedule and promotional event calendar. Merchandising

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary product category that this promotional calendar entry focuses on (e.g., Fresh Produce, Dairy, Meat, Bakery). Nullable if promotion spans multiple categories.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Promotional calendars are explicitly organized around fiscal quarters and periods; the fiscal period drives the promotional planning cycle. Retail-grocery merchandising teams build promo calendars ali

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_plan. Business justification: Promotional calendars are built in lockstep with assortment planning cycles (fiscal_quarter/fiscal_year alignment exists on both). Category managers use this link to synchronize ad circular slots with

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster or zone that this promotional calendar entry applies to. Store clusters group stores by geography, demographics, or performance characteristics for targeted promotional planning. Nullable if promotion applies to all stores.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Calendar budgeting and supplier‑funded promotions need supplier attribution for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: ad_circular_print_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry will be featured in the printed weekly ad circular flyer. True means print ad placement is planned; False means digital-only or in-store signage only.

attributes.name: ad_circular_week
attributes.description: The week number within the fiscal year that this promotional calendar entry corresponds to, used for weekly ad circular planning and coordination. Aligns with retail fiscal calendar conventions.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional calendar entry received executive or merchandising leadership approval to proceed. Nullable if still in draft or planning status.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or manager who approved this promotional calendar entry. Used for governance and audit trail purposes. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this calendar entry represents a blackout period during which no new promotions should be scheduled. True means this is a blackout period (e.g., inventory count week, system maintenance); False means normal promotional activity is allowed.

attributes.name: calendar_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to reference the promotional calendar in operational systems and reports (e.g., 'Q4-2024-HOL', 'SP-FRESH-01').

attributes.name: calendar_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for the promotional calendar period (e.g., 'Q4 Holiday Campaign 2024', 'Spring Fresh Produce Event').

attributes.name: calendar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotional calendar entry. Draft indicates initial planning; planned means dates are set but not approved; approved indicates executive sign-off; active means promotion is currently running; completed means promotion has ended; cancelled indicates promotion was terminated before completion.

attributes.name: calendar_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional calendar entry by its business purpose and funding model. Weekly ad circular represents recurring weekly promotional cycles; seasonal event covers spring, summer, fall, winter campaigns; holiday promotion targets specific holidays; category event focuses on specific product categories; vendor funded indicates supplier-sponsored promotions; markdown clearance represents end-of-season or overstock price reductions.

attributes.name: conflict_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any promotional conflicts detected with other calendar entries (overlapping dates, same category, same store cluster) and how they were resolved. Used for planning coordination and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this promotional calendar entry was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and planning timeline analysis.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry includes digital coupon offers that customers can clip via mobile app or website. True means digital coupons are part of the promotion; False means no digital coupon component.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period ends. This is the last day that promotional pricing and offers are valid. Nullable for open-ended promotions.

attributes.name: estimated_budget_amount
attributes.description: The estimated total budget allocated for this promotional calendar entry, including markdown costs, advertising spend, and vendor co-op funding. Expressed in the retailer's reporting currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: event_theme
attributes.description: The marketing theme or creative concept for the promotional period (e.g., 'Back to School', 'Summer BBQ', 'Holiday Feast', 'Fresh Start January'). Used for merchandising and marketing alignment.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) to which this promotional calendar entry belongs, used for quarterly promotional planning and performance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this promotional calendar entry belongs, following the retailer's fiscal calendar (e.g., 2024, 2025).

attributes.name: loyalty_exclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry is exclusive to loyalty program members. True means only loyalty cardholders can access the promotional pricing; False means promotion is available to all customers.

attributes.name: merchandising_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from merchandising team regarding assortment planning, display requirements, inventory positioning, or special handling instructions for this promotional calendar entry.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this promotional calendar entry. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this promotional calendar entry was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: overlap_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry can overlap with other promotions in the same category or store cluster. True allows concurrent promotions; False enforces exclusivity to prevent promotional conflicts and margin erosion.

attributes.name: slotting_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry is tied to a contractual slotting fee commitment with a vendor. True means vendor has paid for guaranteed promotional placement during this period; False means no slotting commitment exists.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period begins. This is the first day that promotional pricing, offers, or ad circular content becomes effective in stores and digital channels.

attributes.name: target_channel
attributes.description: The primary sales channel where this promotional calendar entry will be executed. In-store represents physical retail locations; online represents eCommerce website; mobile app represents mobile application; omnichannel indicates promotion spans all channels.

attributes.name: target_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: The target Gross Margin Return on Investment ratio for this promotional calendar entry. GMROI measures the profitability of inventory investment and is a key performance metric for promotional effectiveness in retail. Calculated as gross margin dollars divided by average inventory cost.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry includes vendor-funded promotional support (slotting fees, co-op advertising, markdown allowances). True means vendor is contributing funding; False means retailer-funded only.

products.name: ad_circular
products.description: Weekly or periodic printed and digital advertising circular that communicates promotional offers to shoppers. Captures circular edition number, effective date range, distribution zone, page count, item placements with page/position coordinates, endcap and gondola feature assignments, digital vs. print format flags, circulation reach, production deadline, and proof approval status. Links to specific offers featured in each circular. Core artifact for weekly promotional execution in retail-grocery — the primary vehicle for communicating TPRs and BOGO offers to price-sensitive shoppers.

attributes.name: ad_circular_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ad circular. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Ad circular production, print, and distribution costs are allocated to cost centers for departmental marketing expense tracking. Retail-grocery finance requires cost center attribution on circulars fo

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Ad circular production and distribution costs are budgeted and reported by fiscal period. Retail-grocery finance teams track circular spend by fiscal period for period-close accruals and marketing exp

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_calendar. Business justification: Associate each ad circular with its planning calendar; child (ad_circular) gets FK to parent (promo_calendar). Removes redundant week number column.

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: target_customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Enables linking each ad circular to the targeted customer segment for segment performance reporting and media spend allocation.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Ad circular features are funded under trade agreements (co-op advertising, feature fees, slotting). Grocery merchandising teams link circular placements to the governing trade agreement to track co-op

attributes.name: circular_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the circular (e.g., 'Spring Savings Event', 'Weekly Deals March 15-21').

attributes.name: circular_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the circular edition, typically a sequential number or code used for tracking and reference (e.g., 'WK2401', 'C-2024-15').

attributes.name: circular_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the circular from planning through execution to expiration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_production|published|active|expired|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: circular_type
attributes.description: Classification of the circular based on frequency and purpose (weekly standard circular, seasonal promotion, holiday special, etc.).

attributes.name: cover_page_headline
attributes.description: Primary headline or promotional message displayed on the cover page of the circular.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad circular record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this circular includes digital coupon offers that customers can clip and redeem online or via mobile app.

attributes.name: digital_platform
attributes.description: Digital platform or technology used to publish and distribute the online version of the circular (e.g., 'Salesforce Commerce Cloud', 'Mobile App', 'Email Campaign').

attributes.name: digital_reach_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of unique digital viewers or impressions for the online version of the circular.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the circular expires and promotional offers are no longer valid.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the circular becomes active and promotional offers are valid for customer redemption.

attributes.name: endcap_feature_count
attributes.description: Number of endcap (end-of-aisle display) features promoted in this circular.

attributes.name: estimated_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated marketing and production budget allocated for this circular in USD, including print costs, digital advertising, and promotional funding.

attributes.name: estimated_gmroi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target
attributes.description: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) ratio for this circular, representing expected gross margin dollars returned per dollar of inventory investment.

attributes.name: featured_category
attributes.description: Primary product category or department featured prominently in this circular (e.g., 'Fresh Produce', 'Meat & Seafood', 'Private Label').

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Distribution format of the circular indicating whether it is available in print, digital, or both channels.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Primary language of the circular content using 3-letter ISO 639-2 language codes (ENG=English, SPA=Spanish, FRA=French, CHI=Chinese).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad circular record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: loyalty_exclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this circular contains offers exclusive to loyalty program members.

attributes.name: merchandiser_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchandising manager or team responsible for selecting offers and planning the circular content.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this circular edition.

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the printed or digital circular.

attributes.name: print_circulation_quantity
attributes.description: Number of physical copies printed and distributed for this circular edition.

attributes.name: print_vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external printing vendor or service provider used for physical circular production.

attributes.name: production_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final deadline for completing circular production and sending to print or digital publishing.

attributes.name: proof_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the final proof of the circular was approved by merchandising and marketing teams.

attributes.name: proof_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the circular proof during the review and approval workflow.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date when the circular was published and made available to customers (print distribution or digital release).

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Marketing theme or campaign message for the circular (e.g., 'Back to School', 'Summer BBQ', 'Holiday Feast').

attributes.name: total_offers_count
attributes.description: Total number of promotional offers and SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) featured in this circular.

attributes.name: tpr_offers_count
attributes.description: Number of Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) offers included in this circular.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether promotional offers in this circular are partially or fully funded by vendor slotting fees or trade allowances.

products.name: offer_item
products.description: Association entity linking promotional offers to specific sellable items (SKUs, UPCs, GTINs, PLU codes) eligible for the promotion. Captures included and excluded items, required purchase quantities, qualifying item roles (buy item vs. get item in BOGO, trigger item vs. reward item in mix-and-match), item-level discount overrides, and planogram placement context. Enables precise eligibility determination at POS, self-checkout, and digital checkout. Supports complex multi-item promotions where different items play different mechanical roles.

attributes.name: offer_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the offer item association record.

attributes.name: ad_circular_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.ad_circular. Business justification: offer_item has ad_circular_featured_flag (BOOLEAN) indicating whether this offer item is featured in an ad circular. Adding ad_circular_id normalizes this reference to identify WHICH circular features

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_item. Business justification: Offer items must reference the authoritative assortment record to validate that promoted SKUs are actively ranged in the target store cluster. Grocery merchandising systems enforce this as a pre-activ

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.planogram. Business justification: REQUIRED: Offer Placement Planning process links each offer_item to a specific planogram for shelf‑space allocation.

attributes.name: primary_offer_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sellable item (product, SKU) that is eligible for this promotional offer.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent promotional offer that this item is associated with.

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.retail_price. Business justification: Promotional offer planning requires validating that the promotional price does not violate the price floor or MAP. Grocery merchandisers reference the baseline retail_price when setting discount_overr

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster or group where this promotional item is active. Enables localized promotions tailored to regional preferences and competitive dynamics.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier, manufacturer) funding or co-funding this promotional item. Used for vendor-funded promotion tracking and chargeback processing.

attributes.name: ad_circular_featured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is featured in the weekly promotional flyer (ad circular). True if the item appears in print or digital advertising materials.

attributes.name: age_restriction_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether age verification is required at POS for this promotional item (alcohol, tobacco, restricted medications). Ensures compliance with state and federal age-restricted product regulations.
attributes.references: FDA Tobacco Regulations 21 CFR 1140; State Alcohol Control Laws

attributes.name: channel_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies which sales channels this promotional item is valid for. Supports omnichannel promotion strategy with channel-specific offers for POS, eCommerce, mobile app, curbside pickup, and delivery.

attributes.name: cost_override_amount
attributes.description: Special cost basis for this item during the promotion period, typically negotiated with vendors for promotional pricing. Used for accurate GMROI and margin analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offer item association record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and promotion planning analysis.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for digital coupon stacking on top of the base promotional offer. Enables omnichannel personalized deal combinations.

attributes.name: discount_override_amount
attributes.description: Item-specific discount amount that overrides the offer-level discount for this particular SKU. Enables variable discounts within a single promotional campaign.

attributes.name: discount_override_percentage
attributes.description: Item-specific discount percentage that overrides the offer-level discount rate for this SKU. Allows differentiated markdown rates within the same promotion.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this item is no longer eligible for the promotional offer. Used for promotion calendar management and automatic expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this item becomes eligible for the promotional offer. Supports phased rollout and time-limited flash promotions.

attributes.name: facing_count
attributes.description: Number of product fronts on shelf required for this promotional item. Ensures adequate visibility and stock availability during the promotion period.

attributes.name: inclusion_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether this item is included in the promotion, explicitly excluded, required for eligibility, or optional within a multi-item offer.

attributes.name: item_identifier_type
attributes.description: Type of item identifier used for promotion eligibility determination. SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for internal codes, UPC (Universal Product Code) for standard barcodes, GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) for GS1 standards, PLU (Price Look-Up Code) for produce, EAN for European Article Numbers, ISBN for books.

attributes.name: item_identifier_value
attributes.description: The actual identifier value (SKU code, UPC barcode, GTIN number, PLU code) used to match this item to the promotion at POS and digital checkout.

attributes.name: item_role
attributes.description: Mechanical role this item plays in the promotion structure. Buy item vs get item in BOGO (Buy One Get One) offers, trigger item vs reward item in mix-and-match promotions, qualifying item for threshold-based offers, or bundle component in multi-item packages.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to loyalty reward points earned on this item during the promotion. For example, 2.0 means double points, 3.0 means triple points.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of this item eligible for the promotional discount within a single transaction. Used to cap BOGO offers and prevent abuse.

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this promotional item. Typically 18 for tobacco, 21 for alcohol in most US states.
attributes.references: FDA Tobacco Regulations 21 CFR 1140; State Alcohol Control Laws

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offer item association record was last modified. Tracks changes to promotion eligibility, discount overrides, and item roles.

attributes.name: offer_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this offer item association. Active means the item is currently eligible for the promotion, pending means scheduled for future activation, expired means the effective period has ended, suspended means temporarily disabled, cancelled means permanently removed from the offer.

attributes.name: planogram_placement_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the visual merchandise display plan location where this promotional item should be placed (endcap, gondola, front-of-store, checkout lane). Supports execution of promotional planograms.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Ranking used to determine which promotion applies when an item qualifies for multiple overlapping offers. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for required and maximum quantities. Each for discrete items, weight units for produce and bulk goods, volume units for liquids, case or pack for wholesale quantities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|case|pack — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum purchase quantity of this item required to qualify for the promotional offer. Supports fractional quantities for weight-based items (e.g., 2.5 lbs of produce).

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional item is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (EBT - Electronic Benefits Transfer). Required for compliance with USDA SNAP regulations.

products.name: circular_offer_placement
products.description: This association product represents the Placement event between a promo_offer and an ad_circular. It captures the operational decision by merchandisers to feature a specific promotional offer at a specific position within a specific circular edition, including the negotiated slotting fee, page location, feature type, and feature size. Each record links one promo_offer to one ad_circular and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific placement — they belong neither to the offer alone nor to the circular alone.. Existence Justification: In grocery retail, merchandisers actively manage which promotional offers are placed in which ad circulars — a single offer (e.g., a BOGO on cereal) can appear in multiple circulars (weekly standard, loyalty-exclusive, digital-only), and a single circular contains dozens to hundreds of distinct offers. The placement itself is a managed business artifact: merchandisers negotiate page position, feature size, and slotting fees for each offer-circular combination, making the relationship a first-class operational entity called 'circular offer placement' that carries its own attributes independent of either the offer or the circular.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking this placement record to the specific promotional offer being featured in the circular.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy One Get One (BOGO) Offers Count
attributes.description: Number of Buy One Get One (BOGO) promotional offers included in this circular. [Moved from ad_circular: This is a derived aggregate count of BOGO offer placements within the circular. It is derivable by querying circular_offer_placement records joined to promo_offer where discount_type = 'BOGO'. Storing it on ad_circular creates a denormalized redundancy that will drift out of sync as placements are added or removed. It should be removed from ad_circular and computed on demand.]

domains.name: vendor

products.name: supplier

Captures legal entity name, DUNS number, tax ID, headquarters address, business type, ownership structure, minority/diversity certification status, EDI capability flag, GTIN prefix, GS1 GLN, payment terms, currency, lead time, vendor tier classification, and active status. Supports produce-specific attributes (growing region, GAP certification, organic acreage, seasonal availability) for agricultural suppliers.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: discontinuation_reason

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: gtin

attributes.name: hazmat_flag

attributes.name: inner_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of consumer units contained in one inner pack within a case. Used for shelf-ready packaging and merchandising.

attributes.name: last_cost_update_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor cost was last updated. Used for cost change tracking and margin analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor item record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality audits.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor item was last ordered via purchase order. Used for vendor performance analysis and item rationalization.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order submission to expected delivery at DC or store. Used for replenishment planning and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered from the vendor, expressed in the unit of measure. Used in replenishment planning.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: order_multiple_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity increment required for orders above the minimum (e.g., must order in multiples of 10 cases). Used in CAO systems.

attributes.name: organic_certification_number
attributes.description: USDA organic certification number or equivalent certifying body identifier. Required for organic product verification.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified organic by USDA or equivalent certifying body. Used for merchandising and labeling compliance.

attributes.name: pallet_hi
attributes.description: Number of layers stacked on a pallet (HI dimension). Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: pallet_ti
attributes.description: Number of cases per layer on a pallet (TI dimension). Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the primary source for this SKU. Used in automated replenishment and PO generation.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is a Grocery private-label brand product manufactured by a co-manufacturer.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days from manufacture or receipt date until the product expires or is no longer saleable. Used for FIFO inventory management and markdown planning.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage and transportation temperature zone for this item. Critical for cold chain management and HACCP compliance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit UPC barcode identifier for the item. Used at point of sale and for inventory tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Current cost per unit of measure charged by the vendor. Used for cost management, margin analysis, and PO pricing.

attributes.name: vendor_item_description
attributes.description: Vendor's description of the item as it appears on their catalog or invoice. Used for receiving verification and reconciliation.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: Supplier's unique part number or item code for this product. Used in purchase orders and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: vendor_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor item relationship. Controls whether the item can be ordered from this supplier.

products.name: cost_schedule
products.description: Vendor cost and pricing schedule defining the wholesale cost (COGS) for each vendor item over a defined effective period. Captures vendor item, cost type (base cost, promotional cost, bracket pricing tier), effective start and end dates, unit cost, case cost, allowance type, bill-back vs. off-invoice designation, and currency. Supports COGS calculation, GMROI analysis, and margin management across the merchandise planning process.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor cost schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_price_id

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Vendor cost schedules (bracket pricing, allowances) are activated and accrued per fiscal period. Finance teams reconcile vendor cost changes against fiscal periods during period-close. Grocery retail

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Cost schedules drive COGS and inventory cost postings in grocery retail. The GL account for cost-of-goods must be known at the cost schedule level to enable automated journal entry generation during g

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor providing the item at this cost.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Cost schedules (wholesale COGS pricing) are negotiated and established under trade agreements. The existing contract_reference_number (STRING) on cost_schedule is a denormalized reference to the gover

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: Cost schedule rows belong to a specific vendor item; linking via vendor_item_id eliminates redundant item identifiers.

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the vendor allowance or discount per unit or case, depending on allowance type.

attributes.name: allowance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the base cost, if the allowance is expressed as a percentage rather than a fixed amount.

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: The mechanism by which vendor allowances or discounts are applied: off-invoice (deducted at purchase), bill-back (claimed after sale), scan-based (paid on scan), accrual (accumulated over time), lump-sum (one-time payment), or none.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this cost schedule: approved (ready for use), pending approval, rejected, or under review by category management or finance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the category manager, buyer, or finance approver who authorized this cost schedule.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost schedule was approved for use in COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation.

attributes.name: bracket_max_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum quantity threshold for this bracket pricing tier. Null indicates no upper limit for the tier.

attributes.name: bracket_min_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold for this bracket pricing tier. Quantities at or above this level qualify for the tier cost.

attributes.name: bracket_tier
attributes.description: The volume tier or bracket level for bracket pricing schedules (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3). Used when cost varies by purchase volume.

attributes.name: case_cost
attributes.description: The wholesale cost per case or pack. Typically used for DSD (Direct Store Delivery) and DC (Distribution Center) ordering.

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure on which the cost is based: per unit (each), per case, per pallet, per weight (lb/kg), or per volume (gallon/liter).

attributes.name: cost_change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for the most recent cost change (e.g., vendor price increase, commodity cost fluctuation, contract renegotiation, promotional pricing).

attributes.name: cost_source
attributes.description: The origin or method by which this cost schedule was captured: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) invoice, manual entry, contract upload, vendor portal, or price file import.

attributes.name: cost_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the cost schedule: active (in use), pending (future effective), expired (past end date), superseded (replaced by newer schedule), or cancelled.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost schedule entry: base cost (standard wholesale), promotional cost (temporary reduction), bracket pricing (volume tier), contract cost (negotiated rate), spot cost (one-time purchase), or rebate-adjusted cost.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost amounts (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is delivered via DSD (Direct Store Delivery) rather than through the DC (Distribution Center). True if DSD, False if warehouse-supplied.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost schedule expires. Null indicates an open-ended schedule.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost schedule becomes active and applicable for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation.

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The allocated freight or transportation cost per unit, if freight is included in the landed cost calculation.

attributes.name: last_cost_change_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent change to the cost values in this schedule. Used for cost variance tracking and audit.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Change History

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost schedule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity (in units or cases) that must be ordered to qualify for this cost schedule.

attributes.name: net_cost
attributes.description: The final net cost per unit after all allowances, discounts, and adjustments are applied. This is the true COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) for margin calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this cost schedule, including special terms, conditions, or exceptions negotiated with the vendor.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms negotiated with the vendor for this cost schedule (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, COD). Impacts cash flow and working capital.
attributes.references: SAP FI Vendor Master Payment Terms

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost schedule applies to a private-label (store-owned brand) item. True if private label, False if national brand or CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods).

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The wholesale cost per single unit (each) of the item. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) calculation.

attributes.name: units_per_case
attributes.description: The number of individual units (eaches) contained in one case or pack. Used to reconcile unit cost and case cost.

products.name: trade_allowance
products.description: Vendor trade promotion allowances, rebates, and bill-back programs negotiated with CPG suppliers. Captures allowance type (off-invoice, bill-back, scan allowance, performance rebate), promotion period, qualifying SKUs or categories, allowance rate or amount, accrual method, payment trigger (scan, purchase, performance), and settlement status. Supports accounts payable deduction management and promotional funding reconciliation.
products.reference: CPG Trade Promotion / SAP Retail SD Rebate Agreement

attributes.name: trade_allowance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trade allowance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Trade allowances (slotting fees, promotional funds) must be accrued and settled within specific fiscal periods per GAAP. Finance teams track allowance accruals by fiscal period for period-close report

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Allowance transactions must post to a designated GL account to track promotional spend.

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: Defines when the allowance is accrued: at time of purchase from supplier, at time of sale to customer, based on POS scan data, or based on performance metrics achievement.

attributes.name: accrued_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of allowance accrued to date under this agreement, based on qualifying purchases or sales.

attributes.name: allowance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allowance amount (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: allowance_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the trade allowance agreement, typically provided by the supplier or generated internally for tracking.

attributes.name: allowance_rate_type
attributes.description: Defines how the allowance value is calculated: percentage of purchase price, fixed dollar amount per unit sold, fixed amount per case, or lump sum payment.

attributes.name: allowance_rate_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the allowance rate. Interpretation depends on allowance_rate_type (e.g., 5.00 for 5% or $5.00 per unit).

attributes.name: allowance_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of products covered by the allowance: specific SKUs, entire category, brand family, or all products from the supplier.

attributes.name: allowance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade allowance agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|pending_approval|approved|in_settlement|settled|expired|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade allowance mechanism: off-invoice (deducted at purchase), bill-back (claimed after purchase), scan-based (triggered by POS scan data), performance rebate (based on sales targets), volume rebate (based on purchase volume), or slotting allowance (for shelf space).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: category_captain_flag

attributes.name: claim_submission_deadline_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of allowance claims that are currently in dispute with the supplier.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of qualifying products that must be purchased to trigger the allowance. Nullable if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes capturing additional details, special terms, or exceptions related to this trade allowance agreement.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount actually paid or credited by the supplier for this allowance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the supplier pays or credits the allowance: deduction from invoice, check payment, electronic funds transfer, credit memo, or offset against payables.

attributes.name: payment_trigger
attributes.description: Event that triggers payment or settlement of the allowance: automatic deduction from invoice, retailer claim submission, supplier verification of performance, or end of promotion period.

attributes.name: performance_actual_value
attributes.description: Actual achieved value for the performance metric, used to calculate earned allowance amount.

attributes.name: performance_metric_type
attributes.description: Type of performance metric used to determine eligibility for performance-based rebates. Applicable when allowance_type is performance_rebate.

attributes.name: performance_target_value
attributes.description: Target value for the performance metric that must be achieved to earn the full allowance. Applicable for performance-based allowances.

attributes.name: promotion_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the trade allowance promotion period ends. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: promotion_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the trade allowance promotion period begins and qualifying purchases or sales become eligible.

attributes.name: promotional_event_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the promotional event or campaign associated with this trade allowance (e.g., Back to School, Holiday Promotion).

attributes.name: qualifying_brand_name
attributes.description: Brand name that qualifies for this allowance. Populated when allowance_scope is brand.

attributes.name: qualifying_category_code
attributes.description: Product category code that qualifies for this allowance. Populated when allowance_scope is category.

attributes.name: qualifying_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU identifiers or UPC codes that qualify for this trade allowance. Populated when allowance_scope is sku_specific.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the allowance settlement process with the supplier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|accruing|claim_submitted|under_review|approved|paid|disputed|rejected — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

Drives vendor tier classification and contract renegotiation decisions.

attributes.name: performance_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Primary key for performance_scorecard

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Vendor performance scorecards are evaluated per fiscal period to trigger rebate accruals, contract renegotiations, and shrink recovery postings. Finance teams align scorecard periods to fiscal periods

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Supplier performance scorecards in grocery retail are scoped to product categories (e.g., dairy OTIF, produce fill rate). Category managers need category-level supplier scorecards for quarterly busine

attributes.name: node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Grocery DC-level OTIF and fill-rate reporting requires scorecards tied to the receiving fulfillment node. Buyers and DC managers run node-level supplier performance reports (on_time_delivery_rate, oti

attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor being evaluated in this scorecard period.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Performance scorecards measure supplier KPIs (fill rate, OTIF, invoice accuracy) against thresholds that are typically defined in a trade agreement. The scorecard's contract_compliance_flag and contra

attributes.name: action_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is required to submit a corrective action plan based on this scorecard performance. True if action plan required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: asn_accuracy_rate_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) Accuracy Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ASN transmissions that accurately matched the physical delivery contents during the measurement period.

attributes.name: case_fill_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered cases that were successfully delivered by the vendor during the measurement period. Measures fulfillment at case level rather than unit level.

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Overall weighted performance score combining all KPI metrics into a single vendor performance rating for the measurement period. Drives vendor tier classification and contract decisions.

attributes.name: contract_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor met all contractual performance obligations during the measurement period. True if compliant, False if any contract terms were violated.

attributes.name: contract_renegotiation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scorecard performance triggers contract renegotiation or review. True if renegotiation recommended, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: edi_compliance_rate_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Compliance Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transactions successfully transmitted via EDI without errors or manual intervention during the measurement period. Measures vendor technical integration quality.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered units that were successfully delivered by the vendor during the measurement period. Key supply chain KPI measuring vendor ability to fulfill complete orders.

attributes.name: finalized_date
attributes.description: Date when this scorecard was finalized and approved for official use in vendor management decisions.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices submitted without pricing errors, quantity discrepancies, or other billing issues during the measurement period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_adherence_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of orders delivered within the agreed lead time window during the measurement period.

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: The frequency or type of measurement period for this scorecard (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual).

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of deliveries that arrived on or before the scheduled delivery date during the measurement period.

attributes.name: oos_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of out-of-stock incidents at store or DC level attributed to this vendor during the measurement period. Tracks vendor-caused stockouts.

attributes.name: order_accuracy_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of orders delivered with correct SKUs, quantities, and specifications without errors during the measurement period.

attributes.name: otif_score_percentage
attributes.description: Composite percentage measuring orders delivered both on-time AND in-full during the measurement period. Industry-standard vendor performance metric combining timeliness and completeness.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor composite score improved compared to the previous measurement period. True if improved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: quality_defect_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of delivered units or cases that failed quality inspection or were rejected during the measurement period.

attributes.name: recall_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of product recall incidents initiated by or involving this vendor during the measurement period. Critical quality and compliance metric.

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the category manager or procurement analyst reviewing this scorecard. Captures qualitative context and action items.

attributes.description: The last date of the measurement period for this performance scorecard.

attributes.name: scorecard_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the measurement period for this performance scorecard.

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this performance scorecard record. Tracks approval and dispute resolution lifecycle.

attributes.name: shrink_contribution_amount

attributes.name: total_cases_delivered

attributes.name: total_cases_ordered

attributes.name: total_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders placed with this vendor during the measurement period. Provides context for rate-based metrics.

attributes.name: total_order_value_amount

attributes.name: total_units_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of units successfully delivered by this vendor during the measurement period. Numerator for fill rate calculations.

attributes.name: total_units_ordered

attributes.name: vendor_tier_classification

products.name: compliance_requirement

Supports version-controlled regulatory change management — when FDA or USDA updates requirements, a new version is created with the prior version marked superseded, enabling audit trail of which requirement version each vendor was certified against.

products.name: trade_allowance_item
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a trade_allowance program and a specific vendor_item that qualifies under that program. It captures the item-level terms of a trade allowance agreement — including item-specific rates, qualifying quantities, accrual amounts, and effective dates — that exist only in the context of a specific allowance-item pairing. Each record links one trade_allowance to one vendor_item and is the authoritative source for deduction management, EDI 844/849 line-item processing, and trade promotion ROI analysis at the SKU level.. Existence Justification: In grocery retail trade promotion management, a single trade allowance program (e.g., a scan allowance or bill-back) routinely covers dozens or hundreds of specific vendor items (SKUs), and a single vendor item can simultaneously participate in multiple active trade allowance programs (e.g., an off-invoice allowance AND a performance rebate from the same supplier). The business actively manages this coverage list — adding or removing qualifying items, setting item-level rates, and tracking accruals per item — making this a genuine operational M:N relationship, not an analytical correlation. The detection phase correctly identified the 'qualifying_sku_list STRING' anti-pattern on trade_allowance as direct evidence that this M:N is currently unresolved.

attributes.description: Total dollar amount of allowance accrued to date for this specific vendor item under the parent trade allowance program. Enables item-level accrual tracking and trade promotion ROI analysis by SKU, which cannot be derived from the header-level accrued_amount alone.

products.name: tier_history
