attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account for a subledger (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, or Asset Accounting). Reconciliation accounts cannot receive direct manual postings; they are updated automatically from subledger transactions. Critical for AP/AR balance integrity and SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP FI – Reconciliation Account (MITKZ); GAAP ASC 210; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_tax_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is subject to tax reporting obligations. True for accounts involving taxable sales, purchases, or excise duties (e.g., fuel center, alcohol, tobacco). Supports tax compliance reporting and FTC regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Configuration; IRS Regulations; FTC Compliance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this GL account record in the source system. Supports change tracking, SOX audit trail requirements, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 – Change Management; SAP FI Change Document (CDHDR/CDPOS); GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items are stored and displayable for this GL account in SAP FI. When True, auditors and finance analysts can drill down to individual posting details. Required for SOX audit trails and GAAP disclosure support. Corresponds to SAP FI XKRES field.
attributes.references: SAP FI SKA1 – XKRES; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is activated for this GL account. When True, individual line items remain open until cleared by a matching offsetting entry (e.g., GR/IR clearing accounts, bank clearing accounts). Essential for AP/AR reconciliation and month-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI SKA1 – XOPVW; GAAP Internal Controls; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: parent_account_code
attributes.description: The account code of the parent/summary account in the GL hierarchy. Enables hierarchical rollup of financial balances for management reporting, financial consolidation, and EBITDA calculation. Null for top-level accounts.
attributes.references: SAP FI Financial Statement Version; GAAP ASC 205 Financial Statement Presentation

attributes.name: planning_account_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is used in SAP CO budgeting and planning processes. Planning accounts are included in annual budget cycles, labor budget planning (Kronos integration), and Blue Yonder demand planning financial inputs. Supports comp sales and same-store sales budget vs. actual analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO-OM Planning; Blue Yonder Demand Planning Integration; GAAP ASC 275

attributes.name: profit_loss_statement_account_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profit and Loss (P&L) Statement Account Type
attributes.description: Classifies P&L accounts into their income statement reporting category for EBITDA calculation, comp sales analysis, and same-store sales reporting. 'cogs' accounts feed COGS tracking; 'ebitda_component' accounts are used in EBITDA reporting. Not applicable for balance sheet accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_revenue|cogs|gross_profit|operating_expense|ebitda_component|interest|tax|not_applicable — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 220; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302; SAP FI Financial Statement Version

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Specifies the subledger type this reconciliation account is linked to. Applicable only when is_reconciliation_account is True. Drives AP/AR aging reports, vendor payment reconciliation, and fixed asset depreciation schedules.
attributes.references: SAP FI – MITKZ Reconciliation Account Type; GAAP ASC 210/360

attributes.name: shrink_account_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is designated for recording shrink (inventory loss from theft, spoilage, or damage). Shrink accounts are critical for fresh produce and perishable inventory financial impact tracking, GMROI analysis, and loss prevention reporting across store banners.
attributes.references: Grocery Internal Shrink Policy; GAAP ASC 330 Inventory; USDA Perishable Goods Standards

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: SAP FI sort key (ZUAWA) that determines the assignment field populated in line items posted to this account. Controls how line items are sorted and displayed in account statements. Common values: '001' (posting date), '003' (document number), '031' (vendor invoice number). Supports efficient account reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI SKA1 – ZUAWA; SAP FI Sort Key Configuration

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this GL account was sourced. Primarily 'SAP_FI' for the SAP Financial Accounting module. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between source systems, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI – Source System Identification; Databricks Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: sox_relevant_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is in scope for SOX Section 302/404 internal controls testing and audit. SOX-relevant accounts require documented controls, segregation of duties, and periodic reconciliation sign-off. Critical for Grocery's external audit and SEC financial reporting compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 – CEO/CFO Certification; SOX Section 404 – Internal Controls Assessment; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: SAP FI tax category assigned to the GL account, controlling whether tax codes are required, optional, or not allowed during posting. Relevant for sales tax on grocery transactions, fuel excise tax, and pharmacy prescription tax exemptions. Corresponds to SAP FI MWSKZ field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: input_tax_required|output_tax_required|tax_optional|no_tax|exempt — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI – Tax Category (MWSKZ); IRS Tax Code; FTC Pricing Regulations

products.name: cost_center
products.description: SAP CO cost center master representing organizational units responsible for cost accumulation — stores, distribution centers, pharmacy departments, fuel centers, and corporate functions. Tracks cost center hierarchy, responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, and budget period validity. Enables departmental P&L, shrink financial impact allocation, and labor cost attribution.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cost_center

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: cost_center should link to GL account master for proper account hierarchy; gl_account_id replaces gl_account_code.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: cost_center carries company_code (STRING) as a denormalized SAP company identifier. Replacing with legal_entity_id FK to legal_entity normalizes the company reference, supports legal-entity-level cost

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: cost_center carries profit_center_code (STRING) as a denormalized reference to the profit center it belongs to. In SAP CO, cost centers are assigned to profit centers for internal profitability report

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type code associated with this cost center, representing the primary type of work or service output produced (e.g., 'LABOR_HRS', 'MACHINE_HRS', 'DELIVERY_UNITS'). Used for activity-based costing, internal order settlements, and COGS allocation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Activity Type Master (KL01); GAAP — Activity-Based Costing

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost center for the current budget period, expressed in the cost center's operating currency. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis, EBITDA reporting, and financial planning. Sourced from SAP CO cost center planning (KP06).
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Planning (KP06); GAAP — Budget Reporting; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls

attributes.name: budget_period
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the current budget plan is active for this cost center (e.g., '2025'). Used to scope budget vs. actual variance analysis, EBITDA reporting, and departmental P&L reviews.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Planning (KP06); GAAP — Annual Budget Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI business area assigned to this cost center, representing a distinct area of operations for internal balance sheet and P&L reporting (e.g., Grocery Retail, Pharmacy, Fuel). Supports segment-level financial disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP FI Business Area (OX03); GAAP ASC 280 — Segment Reporting

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: SAP FI chart of accounts code applicable to this cost center's company code. Defines the set of GL accounts available for cost postings. Ensures consistency in financial reporting across Grocery's legal entities.
attributes.references: SAP FI Chart of Accounts (OB13); GAAP — Uniform Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area to which this cost center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. All cost centers within a controlling area share the same chart of accounts and fiscal year variant.
attributes.references: SAP CO Controlling Area Configuration (OKKP); GAAP — Entity-Level Financial Reporting

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center category code (single or two-character) that controls which activity types and statistical key figures can be posted to this cost center. Common values include 'A' (General), 'B' (Administration), 'F' (Production), 'H' (Auxiliary). Governs posting rules and planning behavior in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Category (KS01 field: KOSAR); SAP CO Configuration Guide

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the cost center in SAP CO, used across financial reporting, budgeting, and interoperability with ERP systems. Serves as the business-facing identifier (e.g., 'CC-STORE-0042', 'CC-DC-WEST-01').
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master (KS01/KS02); SOX Section 302/404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the cost center as maintained in SAP CO (e.g., 'Store 042 - Produce Department', 'Distribution Center West - Receiving', 'Pharmacy - Store 101'). Used in financial reports, P&L statements, and budget dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master (KS01/KS02); GAAP — Segment Reporting (ASC 280)

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. 'active' — open for cost postings and budget planning; 'inactive' — temporarily suspended; 'locked' — blocked for new postings (SAP CO lock indicator); 'pending_activation' — created but not yet effective; 'closed' — permanently decommissioned after validity end date.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master (Lock Indicator: SPERL); SOX Section 404 — Change Management Controls

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the cost center indicating the type of organizational unit it represents within Grocery's operations. Drives departmental P&L segmentation, shrink financial impact allocation, and labor cost attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: store|distribution_center|pharmacy|fuel_center|corporate|administrative|manufacturing|logistics — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Category (Field: KOSAR); GAAP ASC 280 — Segment Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master record was first created in the source system (SAP CO). Used for audit trail, SOX compliance documentation, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Audit Log; SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements; GAAP — Record Retention

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost center's operating currency (e.g., 'USD'). Defines the currency in which budget, actual costs, and variances are recorded and reported for this cost center.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP CO Cost Center Master (Field: WAERS); GAAP — Foreign Currency Translation (ASC 830)

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Internal department code associated with this cost center, used for departmental P&L reporting and labor cost attribution. Aligns with Grocery's organizational structure (e.g., Produce, Bakery, Deli, Pharmacy, Fuel, Receiving, Corporate Finance).
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Department Classification

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Organizational division code to which this cost center belongs (e.g., 'GROCERY_RETAIL', 'PHARMACY', 'FUEL_OPERATIONS', 'ECOMMERCE'). Supports divisional P&L reporting, EBITDA segmentation, and same-store sales analysis by business division.
attributes.references: SAP Retail Division Master; GAAP ASC 280 — Segment Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP FI fiscal year variant code that defines the fiscal year structure (number of periods, start/end months) applicable to this cost center. Grocery typically uses a 52/53-week fiscal year. Drives period-based budget and actual cost comparisons.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant (OB29); GAAP — Fiscal Year Reporting

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO functional area classification used to differentiate cost by business function (e.g., Cost of Goods Sold, Selling, General & Administrative, Research & Development). Enables COGS vs. SG&A split in income statement reporting per GAAP.
attributes.references: SAP CO Functional Area (OKBD); GAAP — Income Statement Classification (ASC 225)

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Center Hierarchy Area (Standard Hierarchy Node)
attributes.description: The node within the SAP CO standard cost center hierarchy to which this cost center is assigned. Enables roll-up reporting across organizational levels (e.g., region, division, banner). Used for enterprise-wide P&L consolidation, EBITDA reporting, and comp sales analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Standard Hierarchy (OKEON); GAAP ASC 280 — Segment Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_locked_for_actual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Locked for Actual Postings Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is locked for actual cost postings (True). When locked, no actual costs can be posted to this cost center in SAP CO. Used during period-end close, audit periods, or when a cost center is being decommissioned.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Lock Indicator (Field: SPERL); SOX Section 404 — Posting Controls

attributes.name: is_locked_for_plan
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Locked for Plan Postings Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is locked for plan (budget) postings (True). When locked, no budget updates can be made to this cost center in SAP CO. Used to freeze budgets after approval for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Lock Indicator (Field: SPERP); SOX Section 404 — Budget Freeze Controls

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is a statistical cost center (True) used only for informational/reporting purposes without actual cost postings, or a real cost center (False) that accumulates actual costs. Statistical cost centers are used in SAP CO for parallel reporting structures.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master (Statistical Indicator); SAP CO Configuration Guide

attributes.name: labor_budget_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the annual budget specifically allocated to labor costs (wages, salaries, benefits) for this cost center. Enables labor cost attribution analysis, workforce planning integration with Kronos/Workday HCM, and COGS labor component reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Planning (KP06); Kronos Workforce Central — Labor Analytics; GAAP — Labor Cost Classification

attributes.name: last_changed_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this cost center master record. Required for SOX compliance audit trails to establish accountability for master data changes. Corresponds to SAP CO change document user field.
attributes.references: SAP CO Change Documents; SOX Section 302/404 — Management Accountability; GAAP — Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost center master record in SAP CO. Used for change tracking, SOX audit trails, and incremental data load processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Change Log (KS03); SOX Section 404 — Change Management Controls

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Physical location type associated with this cost center. Distinguishes between store-level, DC (Distribution Center), MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center), corporate office, fuel center, and pharmacy cost centers for geographic and operational segmentation in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Retail Organizational Structure; GAAP ASC 280 — Segment Reporting

attributes.name: overhead_rate
attributes.description: The overhead allocation rate applied to this cost center, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.1250 = 12.50%). Used in SAP CO overhead costing sheets to allocate indirect costs (e.g., corporate overhead, DC overhead) to store or department cost centers for full-absorption costing and COGS calculation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Overhead Costing Sheet (KZS2); GAAP — Overhead Absorption (ASC 330 — Inventory Costing)

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code to which this cost center belongs (e.g., 'NORTHEAST', 'SOUTHEAST', 'WEST'). Used for regional P&L roll-up, comp sales analysis by region, and regional budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Retail Organizational Hierarchy; GAAP ASC 280 — Geographic Segment Reporting

attributes.name: settlement_rule_code
attributes.description: SAP CO settlement rule code that defines how costs accumulated on this cost center are settled (allocated) to other cost objects (e.g., other cost centers, internal orders, profitability segments). Drives period-end cost allocation and COGS calculation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Settlement Rule (KO02/KS02); GAAP — Cost Allocation Methodology

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name of the cost center used in condensed financial reports, POS system displays, and space-constrained UI contexts. Corresponds to the SAP CO short text field (up to 20 characters).

attributes.name: shrink_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in shrink (inventory loss from theft, spoilage, or damage) financial impact allocation (True). When enabled, shrink costs calculated from inventory management systems are allocated to this cost center for departmental P&L and COGS reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Allocation; GAAP ASC 330 — Inventory; USDA HACCP — Perishable Loss Tracking

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cost center master record was sourced (e.g., 'SAP_CO' for SAP Controlling, 'SAP_FI' for SAP Financial Accounting). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; SOX Section 404 — Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which this cost center is active and valid for cost postings. Corresponds to the SAP CO validity period end date. A value of 9999-12-31 indicates an open-ended (indefinite) validity. Cost postings after this date are blocked.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master (Field: DATBI — Valid To); GAAP — Period-Based Accounting

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center is active and valid for cost postings and budget planning. Corresponds to the SAP CO validity period start date. Cost postings before this date are not permitted.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master (Field: DATAB — Valid From); GAAP — Period-Based Accounting

products.name: profit_center
products.description: SAP CO profit center master representing autonomous business segments for internal profitability reporting — store-level, banner-level, pharmacy, fuel, and private-label divisions. Captures profit center hierarchy, assigned controlling area, segment classification, and validity periods. Supports comp sales, same-store sales, and EBITDA reporting by business unit.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for profit_center

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: profit_center carries company_code (STRING) as a denormalized SAP company identifier. Replacing with legal_entity_id FK to legal_entity normalizes the company reference, supports legal-entity-level pr

attributes.name: banner_code
attributes.description: The retail banner or brand under which this profit center operates (e.g., 'KROGER', 'RALPHS', 'FREDS', 'HARRIS'). Used for banner-level comp sales and same-store sales reporting.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP business area for cross-company-code reporting and internal financial statements by line of business (e.g., grocery retail, pharmacy, fuel).

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date this profit center was permanently closed. Null for active profit centers. Used for historical analysis and asset impairment calculations.

attributes.name: comp_sales_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit center is eligible for comp sales (comparable store sales) reporting. True if the location has been open for at least 12 months and meets comp sales criteria.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The SAP Controlling Area to which this profit center is assigned. Controlling area represents the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The default cost center associated with this profit center for overhead allocation and indirect cost assignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this profit center master record was first created in the SAP CO system. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this profit center's local currency (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Used for multi-currency consolidation and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: department_count
attributes.description: The number of distinct departments or categories within this profit center (e.g., produce, meat, dairy, bakery, pharmacy, fuel). Used for assortment complexity analysis.

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: The district code within a region, representing a cluster of stores managed by a district manager. Used for district-level P&L roll-up.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: The current number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees assigned to this profit center. Used for labor productivity and EBITDA per employee calculations.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant defining the fiscal calendar for this profit center (e.g., K4 for calendar year, V3 for 4-4-5 retail calendar).

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this profit center in the organizational structure (1=top-level, 2=division, 3=region, 4=store, etc.). Used for roll-up reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person who last modified this profit center master record. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent change to this profit center master record. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit center is locked for new postings. True when locked (no new transactions allowed), False when open for posting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: The market or metropolitan area code (e.g., 'NYC', 'LAX', 'CHI'). Used for market-level competitive analysis and same-store sales comparisons.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The date this profit center (store, pharmacy, fuel center) first opened for business. Used to calculate comp sales eligibility and age-based performance metrics.

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_code
attributes.description: The code of the parent profit center in the hierarchy. Null for top-level profit centers. Enables roll-up of comp sales, same-store sales, and EBITDA by region or division.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code identifying the profit center in SAP CO. Used in financial reports, general ledger postings, and management accounting documents.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Extended text description providing additional context about the profit center's purpose, scope, and business model (e.g., 'High-volume urban supermarket with full-service pharmacy and fuel center').
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: The full business name of the profit center (e.g., 'Store 1234 - Downtown Seattle', 'Pharmacy Division - West Region', 'Private Label Bakery').
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center: active (operational and posting transactions), inactive (temporarily suspended), planned (future opening), closed (permanently shut down).
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center by business function: store-level P&L, banner-level aggregation, pharmacy operations, fuel center operations, distribution center, private-label brand division, or corporate overhead. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: store|banner|pharmacy|fuel_center|distribution_center|private_label|corporate — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: The geographic region code for this profit center (e.g., 'WEST', 'MIDWEST', 'SOUTH', 'NORTHEAST'). Used for regional performance analysis and comp sales benchmarking.

attributes.name: remodel_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent major remodel or renovation. Significant remodels may reset comp sales eligibility timers.

attributes.name: same_store_sales_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit center qualifies for same-store sales reporting (revenue comparison for existing locations year-over-year). Typically requires 13+ months of operation without major remodels.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: The business segment classification for external financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP segment reporting requirements (e.g., 'RETAIL', 'PHARM', 'FUEL', 'PRIVLBL').

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name for the profit center used in reports and dashboards where space is limited.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: The total retail square footage of the store or facility. Used to calculate sales per square foot and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) metrics.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this profit center is valid and can accept financial postings. Used for time-dependent master data and historical reporting.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this profit center is valid. Null for open-ended validity. Used to track store closures, division consolidations, and organizational changes.

products.name: legal_entity
products.description: Master record of all legal entities within the Grocery corporate structure — operating subsidiaries, holding companies, and banner-level legal registrations. Captures EIN, state of incorporation, fiscal year variant, functional currency, consolidation group membership, and SOX reporting scope flag. Drives financial consolidation and intercompany elimination workflows.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the legal entity. Primary key for the legal entity master record.

attributes.name: parent_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent legal entity in the corporate hierarchy. Null for the ultimate parent holding company.

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level parent legal entity in the corporate structure. Used for ultimate consolidation and group-level reporting.

attributes.name: audit_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm responsible for auditing this legal entity's financial statements. Required for SOX-scoped and public entities.

attributes.name: consolidation_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the consolidation group or reporting unit to which this legal entity belongs. Used for financial consolidation and intercompany elimination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially dissolved or ceased operations. Null for active entities.

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the legal entity operates. May differ from the legal name for customer-facing operations.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet. Used for credit reporting, vendor registration, and business identity verification.

attributes.name: ein
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number issued by the IRS. Used for all federal tax filings, payroll, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the legal entity. Active entities are operational and filing; inactive or dissolved entities are no longer conducting business.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: The legal structure of the entity (e.g., corporation, LLC, partnership). Determines tax treatment, liability, and governance requirements.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_month
attributes.description: The month (1-12) in which the legal entity's fiscal year ends. Used for annual financial statement preparation and tax filing deadlines.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Code representing the fiscal year calendar used by this legal entity. Determines period structure for financial reporting and consolidation in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the primary currency in which the legal entity conducts business and maintains its books.

attributes.name: gaap_reporting_standard
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Reporting Standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard framework used by this legal entity for financial reporting (US GAAP, IFRS, or local GAAP).

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially incorporated or registered with the state. Used to calculate entity age and anniversary dates.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent external financial audit was completed for this legal entity.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: legal_entity_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the legal entity in financial systems and reporting. Typically used in SAP FI company code configuration.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the entity as registered with the state or jurisdiction of incorporation. Used for all legal documents, contracts, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit code classifying the primary business activity of the legal entity. Used for industry benchmarking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact for the legal entity.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary business contact or registered agent for the legal entity. Used for official communications and legal notices.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary business contact for the legal entity.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 International Phone Number Standard

attributes.name: public_company_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this legal entity is publicly traded on a stock exchange. Determines SEC reporting requirements and audit obligations.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the legal entity's registered address on file with the state. Used for official correspondence and legal service of process.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the registered address (suite, floor, building). Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City of the legal entity's registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the registered address. Supports 5-digit or 9-digit ZIP+4 format.

attributes.name: registered_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the registered address.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code used for consolidated financial reporting. May differ from functional currency for foreign subsidiaries.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code classifying the primary business activity. Legacy classification system still used by SEC and some regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: sox_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this legal entity is within the scope of SOX compliance and internal control testing. True for publicly traded entities and material subsidiaries.

attributes.name: state_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the legal entity is incorporated or registered. Determines governing law and annual filing requirements.

attributes.name: stock_exchange_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary stock exchange where the entity's shares are traded (e.g., NYSE, NASDAQ). Null for private entities.

attributes.name: stock_ticker_symbol
attributes.description: The ticker symbol under which the entity's shares are traded. Null for private entities.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary tax jurisdiction for the legal entity. Determines applicable tax rates and filing requirements.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT or sales tax registration number for entities operating in jurisdictions requiring VAT registration. Null for US-only entities without VAT obligations.

products.name: fiscal_period
products.description: Reference calendar defining Grocery's fiscal year structure — fiscal year, fiscal periods (4-4-5 or 13-period retail calendar), period open/close status, and posting date ranges. Aligned with SAP FI fiscal year variant. Controls period-end close sequencing, budget comparison periods, and comp sales period-over-period calculations.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fiscal period. Primary key.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Fiscal periods belong to a legal entity; linking provides entity‑specific calendar context.

attributes.name: prior_year_period_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding fiscal period in the prior fiscal year. Enables year-over-year comp sales and same-store sales calculations.

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Identifier for the budget version applicable to this fiscal period (e.g., 'Original', 'Revised_Q2', 'Forecast'). Supports budget vs actual variance analysis.

attributes.name: business_day_count
attributes.description: Number of business operating days (excluding weekends and holidays) in this fiscal period. Used for labor budgeting and productivity metrics.

attributes.name: calendar_month
attributes.description: The calendar month number (1-12) in which the fiscal period primarily falls. Supports calendar-based reporting and seasonality analysis.

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The calendar year (Gregorian) in which the majority of this fiscal period falls. Used for calendar-year reporting and external benchmarking.

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date when the fiscal period was closed and locked for posting. Null if period is still open. Critical for SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: close_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the fiscal period close process was completed. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: day_count
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in this fiscal period. Used for daily rate calculations and pro-rata adjustments.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_date
attributes.description: The date used for currency exchange rate determination for this fiscal period. Typically period-end date or average rate date for multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: external_audit_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this fiscal period is subject to external audit review. Typically true for year-end and quarterly periods for publicly traded companies.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_number
attributes.description: Sequential period number within the fiscal year (1-13 for 13-period retail calendar or 1-12 for standard calendar). Used for period-over-period comparisons and comp sales calculations.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter number (1-4) to which this period belongs. Supports quarterly financial reporting and EBITDA analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with Grocery's fiscal calendar and SAP FI fiscal year variant.

attributes.name: gaap_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether financial reporting for this period follows GAAP standards. True for US-based public company reporting.

attributes.name: is_current_period
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current active fiscal period for transaction posting. True if current, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_leap_year
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fiscal year containing this period is a leap year. Affects day count calculations and year-over-year comparisons.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was last updated. Tracks changes to period status, close dates, and other attributes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this fiscal period. May include information about special events, adjustments, calendar anomalies, or close process issues.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the fiscal period. Defines the end of the posting date range for transactions and triggers period-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Period Date Range

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the fiscal period (e.g., 'FY2024-P01', 'January 2024', 'Q1-2024'). Used in financial reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the fiscal period. Defines the beginning of the posting date range for transactions.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Period Date Range

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fiscal period. Controls whether transactions can be posted. Open allows posting, closed prevents new postings, locked is permanently closed, pending_close indicates close process is underway.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fiscal period. Regular periods are standard operating periods, adjustment periods are for accruals and corrections, special periods are for extraordinary events, year_end is the final closing period.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for financial reporting in this period (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency consolidation and GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: sox_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when SOX certification and management attestation were completed for this fiscal period. Required for publicly traded companies.

attributes.name: sox_certification_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this fiscal period requires SOX certification and management attestation. True for publicly traded company reporting periods.

attributes.name: week_count
attributes.description: Number of weeks in this fiscal period. Typically 4 or 5 weeks for 4-4-5 retail calendar. Critical for normalizing comp sales and same-store sales metrics.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core general ledger posting document capturing all financial transactions in the Grocery ledger — standard postings, accruals, reversals, intercompany entries, shrink postings, tax postings (sales tax, fuel excise, pharmacy dispensing tax), and period-end adjustments. Contains both header metadata (document number, document type, posting date, fiscal period, company code, reference, reversal indicator, approval chain, parking status) and line-item detail (line number, debit/credit indicator, GL account, cost center, profit center, WBS element, amount in transaction and local currency, tax code, tax jurisdiction, assignment field, text). The single authoritative audit trail for all financial activity, supporting COGS analysis, EBITDA reporting, SOX compliance, state/local tax remittance reporting, and trial balance generation.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry document. Primary key for the journal entry product.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: AP invoices in SAP FI generate accounting documents (journal entries) upon posting. Adding ap_invoice_id to journal_entry establishes the source document reference from the GL posting back to the orig

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: AR invoices in SAP FI generate accounting documents (journal entries) upon billing. Adding ar_invoice_id to journal_entry establishes the source document reference from the GL posting back to the orig

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Every journal entry is posted within a specific fiscal period. journal_entry carries denormalized fiscal_period (INT) and fiscal_year (INT) scalar columns that are redundant once a FK to fiscal_period

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each journal entry posts to a GL account; linking enables traceability to the account hierarchy.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: journal_entry carries company_code (STRING) which is the SAP identifier for the legal entity. Replacing it with legal_entity_id FK to the legal_entity master normalizes the company reference, supports

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payment_run. Business justification: Payment runs in SAP FI generate journal entries (clearing postings). Adding payment_run_id to journal_entry establishes the source document linkage from the accounting document back to the payment run

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.settlement_batch. Business justification: Daily cash close journal entries: grocery finance posts a journal entry per settlement batch for daily cash clearing. This link provides the audit trail from GL posting back to the originating settlem

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Cash receipt journal entries: grocery finance posts journal entries directly for cash receipts from POS transactions. This link enables cash receipt reconciliation, audit trail from GL entry back to o

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was approved for posting. Null if not yet approved or approval not required. Used for approval workflow tracking and SOX compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: The baseline date used for payment term calculation in accounts payable processing. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date. Used for payment due date calculation and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: The batch input session name if this journal entry was created via batch processing. Null for online entries. Used for batch processing tracking and error resolution.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry was cleared or settled. Null if not yet cleared. Used for aging analysis and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing entry that settled this journal entry. Null if not yet cleared. Used for accounts payable/receivable reconciliation and open item management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for SOX compliance and internal control monitoring.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The transaction currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency reporting and foreign exchange gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the source document (invoice date, receipt date, contract date). May differ from posting date due to processing delays. Used for aging analysis and vendor/customer reconciliation.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned by the financial system (SAP FI document number). This is the business identifier used in audit trails and financial reporting.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry document type. SA=General Ledger Document, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AB=Accounting Document, KG=Vendor Credit Memo, DZ=Payment Document. Determines posting rules and account determination logic.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date when the journal entry was first created or entered into the system by the user. Audit trail timestamp for SOX compliance and internal control monitoring.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert transaction currency amounts to local currency amounts. Null if transaction currency equals local currency. Used for foreign exchange gain/loss calculation and multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text description at the document header level providing context or explanation for the journal entry. Used for audit trail documentation and user communication.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between two company codes within the Grocery enterprise. True if intercompany, False otherwise. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: The ledger or ledger group to which this journal entry is posted. 0L=Leading Ledger (GAAP), 2L=IFRS Ledger, 9Z=Management Reporting Ledger. Supports parallel accounting for multiple accounting standards.
attributes.references: SAP FI New General Ledger Configuration

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: The local (company code) currency in which amounts are also stored for statutory reporting. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Typically USD for US-based grocery operations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was last modified. Null if never modified after creation. Audit trail timestamp for SOX compliance and change tracking.

attributes.name: parking_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was parked. Null if entry was never parked. Used for workflow tracking and aging analysis of parked documents.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating a payment block preventing automatic payment processing. Null if no block exists. Used for payment exception management and vendor dispute resolution.

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the payment method for this journal entry. C=Check, T=Wire Transfer, W=ACH, Z=Other. Used for payment processing and cash management.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount terms for this journal entry. Used for accounts payable aging, cash flow forecasting, and early payment discount analysis.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Null if entry is parked but not yet posted. Used for posting workflow tracking and audit trail analysis.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. This is the principal business event date that determines which fiscal period the transaction affects. Used for period-end close, trial balance, and financial statement generation.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Posted=finalized and affecting GL balances, Parked=saved but not yet posted, Cleared=settled against another document, Reversed=negated by reversal entry, Cancelled=voided before posting.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (vendor invoice number, customer order number, check number, wire transfer reference). Used for reconciliation and audit trail linkage to source documents.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a prior entry. True if this document reverses another document, False otherwise. Used for accrual reversal processing and error correction tracking.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversal. 01=Accrual Reversal, 02=Error Correction, 03=Period-End Adjustment, 04=Reclassification, 05=Duplicate Entry, 06=Other. Used for internal control monitoring and audit trail analysis.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Null if this is not a reversal entry. Used to maintain audit trail linkage between original and reversing entries.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system or module that originated this journal entry. SAP_FI=Financial Accounting, SAP_CO=Controlling, SAP_MM=Materials Management, SAP_SD=Sales and Distribution, POS=Point of Sale, WMS=Warehouse Management System, MANUAL=Manual Entry. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_FI|SAP_CO|SAP_MM|SAP_SD|POS|WMS|MANUAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_reporting_date
attributes.description: The date used for tax reporting purposes. May differ from posting date due to tax jurisdiction rules. Used for sales tax remittance reporting, fuel excise tax reporting, and pharmacy dispensing tax compliance.
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany trading partner if this is an intercompany transaction. Null for non-intercompany entries. Used for intercompany reconciliation and automated elimination entry generation.

products.name: ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable lifecycle record covering the full invoice-to-payment cycle for vendor merchandise, DSD deliveries, slotting fees, and operational expenses. Captures invoice receipt (vendor ID, invoice date, PO reference, payment terms, gross/net/tax amounts, three-way match status, EDI 810 reference, GR/IR clearing), payment block and approval workflow, and disbursement execution (payment method — ACH/check/wire, payment date, bank account, cleared amount, discount taken, payment run ID from SAP automatic payment program). Each record tracks the complete AP document lifecycle from posting through clearing. Supports cash flow forecasting, vendor payment processing, early-pay discount optimization, and 1099 reporting.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts payable invoice record. Primary key for the AP invoice lifecycle from receipt through payment clearing.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the company bank account from which payment was disbursed. Supports multi-bank operations and cash management reporting.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier. Business justification: Freight invoices from carriers are a major AP category in retail-grocery. Direct carrier_id on ap_invoice enables carrier spend analysis, contract compliance auditing, and freight accrual reporting wi

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: The cost center to which this invoice expense is allocated. Used for departmental budgeting, variance analysis, and management accounting. Typically applies to non-merchandise invoices (services, utilities, supplies).

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: AP invoice-to-cost-price matching is a critical retail-grocery process: invoiced supplier cost is validated against the agreed cost price record for cost variance analysis, deal compliance, and allowa

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: ap_invoice carries denormalized fiscal_period (INT) and fiscal_year (INT) scalar columns. Adding fiscal_period_id FK to the fiscal_period master normalizes the period reference, supports period-close

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: ap_invoice needs a proper reference to the GL account master; gl_account_id replaces gl_account_code for normalization.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or store goods receipt document used in three-way match. Confirms physical receipt of merchandise or materials before invoice approval.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: ap_invoice carries company_code (STRING) as a denormalized SAP company identifier. Replacing with legal_entity_id FK to legal_entity normalizes the company reference, supports intercompany AP reconcil

attributes.name: new_item_intro_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.new_item_intro. Business justification: Slotting fees for new item introductions are invoiced by suppliers and processed as AP invoices. Grocery retailers must match slotting fee AP invoices to specific new item intro records for vendor dea

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SAP automatic payment program run (F110) that processed this invoice. Groups invoices paid together in a batch for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order for three-way match validation (PO, goods receipt, invoice). Null for non-PO invoices such as utility bills, rent, or service agreements.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.shipment. Business justification: Freight Invoice Reconciliation: AP Invoice for carrier freight must reference the Shipment it settles, enabling the Freight Cost Reconciliation report.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier who issued this invoice. Links to the vendor master record for merchandise suppliers, DSD (Direct Store Delivery) vendors, service providers, and operational expense vendors.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was approved for payment. Used to measure approval cycle time and identify bottlenecks in the AP workflow.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the invoice in the approval workflow. Tracks manager or finance approval for invoices requiring authorization before payment, supporting SOX internal control requirements.

attributes.name: cleared_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount paid to the vendor after applying any last-minute adjustments, discounts taken, or partial payments. May differ from net_amount if early payment discount was exercised.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was cleared in the GR/IR clearing account, completing the procure-to-pay cycle. Indicates the invoice liability has been settled in the general ledger.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the accounts payable system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Supports multi-currency operations and foreign exchange reporting.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The discount amount available if payment is made within the early payment discount period (e.g., 2% if paid within 10 days). Supports cash flow optimization and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount
attributes.description: The actual early payment discount amount deducted at payment time. Tracks discount capture performance and vendor payment optimization.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor per the agreed payment terms. Calculated from invoice date plus payment term days (e.g., Net 30, Net 60).
attributes.references: SAP FI Baseline Date + Payment Terms

attributes.name: edi_810_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the EDI 810 electronic invoice transaction received from the vendor. Supports automated invoice processing and vendor integration via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange).

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any deductions, including merchandise cost, freight, slotting fees, or service charges. Represents the vendor's billed amount before tax.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor issued the invoice. Used to calculate payment due dates based on payment terms and to determine early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The external invoice number assigned by the vendor. This is the business identifier printed on the vendor's invoice document and referenced in payment correspondence.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current state of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through three-way match, approval, payment scheduling, disbursement, and clearing in the GR/IR (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) account. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|pending_match|matched|approved|payment_blocked|scheduled|paid|cleared|cancelled|disputed — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document. Standard invoices are typical vendor bills; credit memos reduce liability; debit memos increase liability; prepayments cover advance payments; recurring invoices are for subscription services.

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice payment must be reported to the IRS on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC for vendor tax reporting. True for payments to non-corporate vendors exceeding the annual threshold.

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice has been successfully matched against the purchase order and goods receipt. Three-way match validates quantity, price, and terms alignment before payment approval.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was last updated. Tracks changes to invoice status, amounts, or payment details for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final payable amount after applying discounts and adding taxes. This is the amount that will be disbursed to the vendor (gross + tax - discount).

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating a hold on payment processing. Common blocks include pricing disputes, quantity discrepancies, missing documentation, vendor compliance issues, or manual review requirements. Null when no block is active.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the invoice payment is blocked. Provides context for AP analysts and vendor inquiry resolution.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date the payment was executed and funds were disbursed to the vendor. Null for unpaid invoices. Used for cash flow reporting and vendor payment tracking.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement method used or planned for vendor payment. ACH (Automated Clearing House) and EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) are preferred for cost efficiency and speed.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number for the payment transaction (check number, ACH trace number, wire confirmation). Used for bank reconciliation and vendor inquiry resolution.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The code representing the negotiated payment terms with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Drives due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period for financial reporting and GAAP-compliant accrual accounting.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on the invoice, including sales tax, use tax, VAT, or GST depending on jurisdiction. Used for tax reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (state, province, county) where the tax was assessed. Supports multi-jurisdictional tax reporting and compliance with state and local tax regulations.

products.name: ar_invoice
products.description: Accounts receivable lifecycle record covering the full invoice-to-cash cycle for B2B wholesale customers, pharmacy insurance billings (PBM claims), fuel fleet card receivables, and vendor chargebacks/deductions. Captures billing (customer account, invoice date, payment terms, gross/net/tax amounts, billing document type), aging and dunning status, and cash receipt/application (receipt date, payment method, bank deposit reference, lockbox ID, applied invoice amounts, unapplied/on-account cash, clearing document). Supports DSO analysis, receivables aging reports, cash application automation, deduction management, bad debt provisioning, and write-off processing.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable invoice record. Primary key for the AR invoice entity.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: ar_invoice carries denormalized fiscal_period (INT) and fiscal_year (INT) scalar columns. Adding fiscal_period_id FK to fiscal_period normalizes the period reference, supports period-close AR aging an

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AR invoices record revenue against a GL account; linking provides proper financial posting.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order. Business justification: Order‑to‑Invoice Matching: AR Invoice is generated from a Fulfillment Order; linking them supports the Customer Billing & Revenue Recognition process.

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (wholesale account, pharmacy insurance payer, fuel fleet account, or vendor for chargebacks) that is billed on this invoice.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Classification of invoice age based on days past due date. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) analysis and bad debt provisioning. Current = not yet due; other buckets represent days overdue.

attributes.name: bank_deposit_reference
attributes.description: Bank deposit batch or transaction reference number linking the payment to the bank statement. Used for bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this invoice. Used for revenue recognition period matching and accrual accounting.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this invoice. Relevant for subscription-based or periodic billing (e.g., fuel fleet monthly billing, pharmacy monthly claims).

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI clearing document number that records the payment application transaction. Links the invoice to the cash receipt document that closed or partially paid it.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the AR system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_outstanding
attributes.description: Number of days since the invoice date. Used to calculate Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) metrics and identify slow-paying accounts.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days the invoice is overdue beyond the payment due date. Null or zero if invoice is not yet due. Used for dunning level determination.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the invoice, including early payment discounts, volume discounts, promotional allowances, or negotiated rebates.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date the customer formally disputed the invoice. Used to track dispute resolution cycle time.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has disputed this invoice. True if customer has raised a billing dispute, pricing disagreement, or quality claim that blocks payment.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the customer dispute reason (e.g., pricing error, quantity discrepancy, damaged goods, service issue). Populated when dispute_flag is true.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is expected based on the payment terms. Used for aging bucket classification and dunning trigger.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current escalation level in the collections dunning process (0=no dunning, 1=first reminder, 2=second reminder, 3=final notice, 4=legal action). Increments based on days past due and payment history.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and freight charges included in the invoice for delivery of goods to the customer location.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was posted to the general ledger for financial reporting. May differ from invoice date due to period-end cutoffs or batch processing.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any deductions, discounts, or adjustments. Represents the full billed value of goods or services.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was issued to the customer. This is the official billing date used for aging calculations and payment term determination.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique invoice number assigned by the billing system. Used for customer communication and payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts receivable process. Tracks progression from draft through payment or write-off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|partially_paid|paid|overdue|disputed|written_off|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type: wholesale invoice for B2B customers, pharmacy claim for PBM insurance billings, fuel fleet invoice for fleet card receivables, vendor chargeback for supplier deductions, debit memo for additional charges, or credit memo for adjustments.

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent dunning notice or collection reminder was sent to the customer for this invoice.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the invoice record. Tracks changes to status, amounts, or payment application.

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the bank lockbox service used for automated payment processing. Relevant for high-volume check and remittance processing.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice amount due after applying all discounts, taxes, and freight charges. This is the amount the customer is expected to pay (gross + tax + freight - discount).

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice after applying all cash receipts, credit memos, and adjustments. Zero when invoice is fully paid.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount received and applied against this invoice across all payment transactions. Sum of all cash receipts allocated to this invoice.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was received and applied to this invoice. Null if invoice is unpaid. Used for cash flow analysis and DSO calculation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument or mechanism used (or expected) for this invoice: ACH (Automated Clearing House), wire transfer, check, credit card, EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer), lockbox processing, or cash. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ach|wire_transfer|check|credit_card|eft|lockbox|cash — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference provided by the customer (check number, wire confirmation, ACH trace number, or remittance advice reference). Used for cash application matching.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the negotiated payment terms (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Determines due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Customer purchase order number provided for this invoice. Used for customer reconciliation and three-way matching in customer accounts payable systems.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or delivery document that generated this invoice. Links AR invoice back to the order fulfillment transaction.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax, VAT, or other applicable taxes charged on the invoice. Calculated based on customer tax jurisdiction and product taxability.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the invoice written off as uncollectible bad debt. Recorded when collection efforts are exhausted and the receivable is deemed unrecoverable.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice (or portion thereof) was written off as bad debt. Triggers bad debt expense recognition in the general ledger.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code for the write-off: customer bankruptcy, deemed uncollectible after collection efforts, small balance not worth pursuing, dispute settlement, goodwill adjustment, or other.

products.name: budget
products.description: Financial budget master and period-level allocation detail for Grocery, managed in SAP CO. Captures budget header (version — original/revised/forecast, budget type — operating/capital/labor, responsible cost center or profit center, GL account scope, fiscal year, approval status) and period-level line detail (fiscal period, planned amount, revised amount, committed amount, actuals-to-date, available balance). Supports variance analysis (plan vs actual vs forecast), EBITDA target tracking, store-level operating expense budgeting, category-level COGS planning, capital expenditure governance, and real-time budget consumption monitoring with threshold alerts.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Primary key for budget

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for this budget. Cost centers represent organizational units that incur costs (e.g., store, department, distribution center).

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: budget carries denormalized fiscal_period (INT) and fiscal_year (INT) scalar columns. Adding fiscal_period_id FK to fiscal_period normalizes the period reference, enables budget-vs-actual variance ana

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Fulfillment nodes have dedicated operational budgets (labor, supplies, utilities, equipment). Direct node-level budget tracking enables budget vs. actual variance reporting for DC and MFC operations —

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: budget should reference the GL account master; gl_account_id replaces gl_account_code.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
