attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center responsible for this budget. Profit centers represent organizational units that generate revenue and incur costs (e.g., store, region, business unit).

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount spent or incurred to date for this budget line, as recorded in the general ledger. Used for variance analysis (actual vs plan).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget was formally approved by the authorized approver or budget committee.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved this budget (e.g., CFO, Budget Committee Chair, Regional Director).

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this budget record to the audit trail or change log for compliance and SOX reporting. Tracks all modifications to budget amounts and approvals.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The remaining budget balance available for spending, calculated as revised_amount minus (committed_amount plus actual_amount). Used for budget consumption monitoring.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: Hierarchical category or grouping for the budget line (e.g., Store Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, IT Infrastructure). Used for rollup reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the budget, typically formatted as BUD-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is fiscal year and NNNN is sequence number.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget: draft (in preparation), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (authorized), active (in use), frozen (locked for changes), closed (period ended), or rejected (not approved). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|active|frozen|closed|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by functional category: operating expenses, capital expenditures (CapEx), labor costs, marketing spend, administrative overhead, or Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The amount of budget that has been committed through purchase orders, contracts, or other obligations but not yet expensed. Used for encumbrance accounting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget expires or is no longer active. Typically the last day of the fiscal period or fiscal year.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget becomes effective and active for spending authorization and monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this budget, including justification for revisions, special instructions, or context for variance explanations.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role responsible for managing and monitoring this budget (e.g., Store Manager, Regional VP, CFO).

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: The original planned budget amount for the fiscal period, as approved during the annual budgeting process. Represents the baseline target.

attributes.name: revised_amount
attributes.description: The revised budget amount after adjustments, reforecasts, or supplemental allocations. Reflects the current authorized budget target.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line is subject to SOX internal control requirements and audit trails (True = SOX-controlled, False = not SOX-controlled).

attributes.name: threshold_critical_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of budget consumption at which a critical alert is triggered and spending may be blocked (e.g., 95.00 means critical alert when 95% of budget is consumed).

attributes.name: threshold_warning_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of budget consumption at which a warning alert is triggered (e.g., 80.00 means alert when 80% of budget is consumed). Used for proactive budget monitoring.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The variance between planned and actual amounts (actual_amount minus planned_amount). Positive values indicate overspend; negative values indicate underspend.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the planned amount ((actual_amount - planned_amount) / planned_amount * 100). Used for threshold alerts and performance scorecards.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version type of the budget indicating whether it is the original plan, a revised plan, a forecast, reforecast, supplemental allocation, or final approved version.

products.name: internal_order
products.description: SAP CO internal order master used to track costs for specific projects, capital investments, store remodels, marketing campaigns, and temporary cost collection objects. Captures order type, responsible cost center, settlement rule, budget, actual costs, and order status (created, released, technically complete, settled). Supports CAPEX tracking and project-level profitability.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SAP CO internal order. Primary key for the internal order master data.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for managing and approving costs on this internal order. The cost center owner is accountable for budget adherence and project completion.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: internal_order carries a denormalized fiscal_year (INT) scalar column. Adding fiscal_period_id FK to fiscal_period normalizes the period reference, supports period-level internal order cost tracking a

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Capital projects (DC automation, MFC buildouts, refrigeration upgrades) are tracked as internal orders against specific fulfillment nodes. Retail-grocery finance teams require node-level capital spend

attributes.name: new_item_intro_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.new_item_intro. Business justification: New item introductions require capital/expense authorization via internal orders to fund slotting fees, fixture setup, and initial inventory investment. Grocery finance teams track new item intro spen

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center to which costs and revenues from this internal order are allocated. Used for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location if this internal order is store-specific (e.g., store remodel, store opening, store equipment upgrade). Used for store-level CAPEX tracking and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs posted to this internal order to date, in the company code currency. Includes direct costs, allocations, and internal activity charges. Updated in real-time as costs are posted.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the project or activity was completed and the order was set to technically complete status. Triggers settlement eligibility.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when work began on this internal order, typically when the first cost was posted or the order status changed to released.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the internal order budget was approved by the authorized approver. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the internal order budget request. Orders must be approved before they can be released for cost posting. Workflow-driven based on budget thresholds and organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who approved the internal order budget. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: SAP FI asset class code if this internal order will be settled to a fixed asset. Determines depreciation rules, useful life, and GL account assignments for the resulting asset.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: SAP FI fixed asset master number to which this internal order will be settled upon completion. Populated for CAPEX orders that create or enhance fixed assets.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget for this internal order in the company code currency. Used for budget control and variance reporting. Budget may be original, supplemental, or revised.

attributes.name: budget_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount. Typically matches the company code currency but may differ for multi-currency projects.

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether costs on this internal order are capitalized (True) or expensed (False). True for capital investments that will be settled to fixed assets; False for operating expenses settled to cost centers or GL accounts.

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total committed costs (purchase requisitions and purchase orders) against this internal order. Used for funds availability checking and budget consumption reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP FI company code representing the legal entity to which this internal order belongs. Used for financial consolidation and legal reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP CO controlling area code. Represents the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal management reporting. Multiple company codes may share a controlling area.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this internal order master record was first created in SAP CO. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this internal order has been marked for deletion. True indicates the order is logically deleted but retained for audit purposes; False indicates an active or closed order.
attributes.references: SAP CO Master Data Deletion Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the individual who last modified this internal order master record. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this internal order master record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data freshness validation.

attributes.name: order_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the internal order purpose, scope, and business justification. Provides context for financial analysts and auditors reviewing project costs.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the internal order, externally visible and used in financial reporting and project tracking. Typically a 10-12 character alphanumeric code assigned by SAP CO.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the internal order. Controls whether costs can be posted, whether the order can be settled, and whether it appears in active project reports. Status progression: created → released → technically_complete → settled → closed.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the internal order by business purpose. Determines cost collection rules, settlement targets, and reporting hierarchy. Common types include capital investments, store remodels, marketing campaigns, maintenance projects, and IT initiatives.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for the project or activity. Used to determine when the order should be technically complete and ready for settlement.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the project or activity tracked by this internal order. Used for project scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: project_manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the project manager for communication and escalation purposes. Used for automated budget alerts and approval workflows.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual responsible for managing this internal order project. Accountable for budget adherence, timeline, and deliverables.

attributes.name: requesting_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the business department that requested this internal order. Used for chargeback and accountability reporting.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when costs accumulated on this internal order were settled to the final receiver cost object. Marks the financial close of the order.

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific cost object (asset number, cost center code, GL account number) to which costs will be settled. Format varies by receiver type.

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_type
attributes.description: Type of cost object to which this internal order will be settled upon completion. Common receivers include fixed assets (for CAPEX), cost centers (for OPEX), or GL accounts (for period costs).

attributes.name: settlement_rule_profile
attributes.description: Configuration key defining how costs accumulated on this internal order are settled to final cost objects (e.g., asset under construction, cost center, GL account). Determines settlement percentage, receiver type, and settlement period rules.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Calculated variance between budget and actual plus committed costs. Positive values indicate under-budget, negative values indicate over-budget. Used for exception reporting and project controls.

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the WBS element if this internal order is part of a larger project structure. Links the order to a project hierarchy for integrated project and cost management.
attributes.references: SAP PS Project System - WBS Master

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the individual who created this internal order master record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master and full depreciation lifecycle record from SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) covering store equipment, refrigeration units, fuel pumps, POS terminals, MFC automation systems, delivery vehicles, and leasehold improvements. Captures asset master data (asset class, sub-number, serial number, acquisition date/cost, vendor, PO reference, useful life, location/cost center assignment) and periodic depreciation detail (depreciation method/key, depreciation area — book/tax/group, fiscal period amounts, accumulated depreciation, net book value, impairment, disposal proceeds and gain/loss). Supports EBITDA reconciliation (depreciation add-back), CAPEX reporting, tax depreciation vs book variance tracking, asset physical inventory, and SOX fixed asset audit.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key for the fixed asset entity.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Record

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: fixed_asset carries denormalized fiscal_period (INT) and fiscal_year (INT) scalar columns representing the depreciation period. Adding fiscal_period_id FK to fiscal_period normalizes the period refere

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Fixed assets (conveyor systems, racking, refrigeration units, sorters) are physically installed at fulfillment nodes. Proper FK replaces denormalized location_code. Enables node-level asset register,

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: fixed_asset needs a foreign key to GL account for asset accounting; gl_account_id replaces gl_account_code.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: In SAP FI/CO, capital investment internal orders (capitalization_flag=true) are the source documents for fixed asset acquisitions. A fixed asset is often created as the settlement result of a capital

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Vendor Master

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.vehicle. Business justification: Delivery vehicles are capitalized fixed assets tracked for acquisition cost, depreciation, and disposal. Linking fixed_asset to vehicle enables fleet asset lifecycle management, depreciation schedulin

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date since acquisition. This is the cumulative contra-asset amount reducing the net book value.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or capitalized cost of the asset in USD. This is the gross base amount for depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Valuation

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was acquired or placed in service. This is the principal business event timestamp for the asset lifecycle and determines when depreciation begins.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Acquisition

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of the asset type (e.g., store equipment, refrigeration units, fuel pumps, POS terminals, MFC automation systems, delivery vehicles, leasehold improvements). Determines depreciation rules and account assignments.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Class Configuration

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fixed asset, including make, model, and specific characteristics.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The main asset number assigned in SAP FI Asset Accounting. This is the externally-known unique identifier for the asset across the enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Active assets are in service and depreciating; under construction assets are capitalized but not yet depreciating; retired/disposed assets are no longer in use.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Status Management

attributes.name: asset_sub_number
attributes.description: Sub-number for assets that are part of a larger asset group or complex asset. Used when a main asset has multiple components tracked separately for depreciation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical tag or barcode identifier affixed to the asset for inventory tracking and physical verification during SOX audits.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was capitalized in the general ledger. For assets under construction, this may differ from the acquisition date.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Capitalization

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fixed asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the acquisition cost and all monetary amounts (typically USD for US operations).

attributes.name: current_period_depreciation
attributes.description: Depreciation expense recognized in the current fiscal period (month or quarter). Used for EBITDA reconciliation and P&L reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: The valuation view for depreciation calculation: book (GAAP financial reporting), tax (IRS tax depreciation), group (consolidated reporting), or IFRS (international standards).
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Depreciation Areas; GAAP ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: SAP-specific depreciation key that defines the calculation rules, useful life, and period control for depreciation posting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Depreciation Key Configuration

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense (e.g., straight-line, declining balance). Aligns with GAAP and tax regulations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was retired, sold, or otherwise disposed of, marking the end of its service life.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Retirement

attributes.name: disposal_gain_loss
attributes.description: Gain or loss recognized on disposal, calculated as disposal proceeds minus net book value at disposal date. Positive values indicate gain; negative values indicate loss.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: Total impairment loss recognized when the asset's recoverable amount falls below its net book value, per GAAP impairment testing requirements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360-10 - Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets

attributes.name: impairment_date
attributes.description: The date on which an impairment loss was recognized for the asset.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360-10 - Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets

attributes.name: is_leased_asset
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset is leased rather than owned. Leased assets follow ASC 842 lease accounting rules.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the asset record. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fixed asset record was last updated. Critical for change tracking and SOX audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent physical inventory verification of the asset, required for SOX compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: lease_contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the lease agreement contract number if the asset is leased. Links to lease liability and right-of-use asset records.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the remaining capitalized value on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order used to acquire the asset, linking to procurement records.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Materials Management Purchase Order

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number or unique equipment identifier for physical tracking and warranty management.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: tax_accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation recognized for tax purposes to date. Used to track book-tax differences for deferred tax calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 - How to Depreciate Property; GAAP ASC 740 - Income Taxes

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: The IRS-approved depreciation method used for tax reporting, which may differ from book depreciation (e.g., MACRS, Section 179 expensing, bonus depreciation).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 - How to Depreciate Property; IRC Section 168 (MACRS); IRC Section 179

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years, used to calculate depreciation rates. Determined by asset class and IRS guidelines.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 - How to Depreciate Property

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manufacturer or vendor warranty expires, used for maintenance planning and cost forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Bank account master and electronic bank statement record for all Grocery operating, payroll, concentration, and zero-balance accounts across legal entities. Captures account master data (bank name, masked account number, routing number, account type, currency, SAP house bank ID, signatory authorities) and full statement lifecycle (MT940/BAI2 imports, statement date/sequence, opening/closing balances, individual transaction lines — deposits/withdrawals/fees/lockbox items, bank transaction codes, value date, clearing status against open AR/AP items). Supports cash management, AP payment run bank selection, AR lockbox processing, daily cash position reporting, bank reconciliation, and SOX treasury controls.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: concentration_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the master concentration account if this is a zero-balance account. Null for non-ZBA accounts.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: bank_account carries gl_account_code (STRING) as a denormalized reference to the GL reconciliation account for the bank. In SAP FI, every bank account is mapped to a GL house bank account. Adding gl_a

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Grocery legal entity that owns this bank account. Links to legal entity master for consolidation and intercompany reconciliation.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Must match legal entity name for corporate accounts.

attributes.name: account_number

attributes.name: account_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose of the account: operating (AP/AR), payroll (employee payments), tax (remittances), investment (short-term cash), debt_service (loan payments), escrow (restricted funds).

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the bank account. Active: normal operations. Inactive: temporarily not in use. Closed: permanently closed. Frozen: blocked by bank or legal order. Restricted: limited transaction types allowed.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account by operational purpose: checking (operating accounts), savings (reserve accounts), money_market (short-term investment), zero_balance (subsidiary accounts swept daily), concentration (master cash pooling), payroll (dedicated payroll disbursement), lockbox (AR collection). attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Most recent closing balance from the last processed bank statement. Used for daily cash position reporting.

attributes.name: house_bank_code
attributes.description: SAP-assigned identifier for the house bank configuration. Links to SAP FI bank master (T012).

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number for SEPA and cross-border payments in Europe and other IBAN-participating countries.

attributes.name: interest_rate

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date

attributes.name: last_statement_date

attributes.name: masked_account_number

attributes.name: opening_date

attributes.name: overdraft_limit

attributes.name: routing_number

attributes.name: signatory_authority_2

attributes.name: signatory_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount that can be authorized by a single signatory. Amounts above this require dual approval.

attributes.name: statement_format

attributes.name: statement_frequency

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for international wire transfers. 8 or 11 character ISO 9362 code.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was last modified.

attributes.name: zero_balance_indicator
attributes.description: True if this is a zero-balance account that is automatically swept to/from a concentration account daily. False otherwise.

domains.name: fulfillment
domains.description: Physical execution of order fulfillment across DCs, MFCs, and store backrooms. Manages pick-pack-ship workflows, wave planning, WMS task management, putaway and slotting logic, carrier selection and assignment, last-mile delivery dispatch, and SLA compliance. Tracks fill rates and cold chain integrity during shipment.
domains.references: GS1 Logistics Label Standards, ARTS Fulfillment Standards

products.name: wave
products.description: Wave planning record representing a batch of pick tasks grouped for coordinated execution within a DC, MFC, or store backroom. Captures wave number, planned start/end times, wave type (replenishment, e-commerce, DSD), facility zone, total units, total orders, wave status (planned, released, in-progress, completed, cancelled), priority tier, and WMS wave identifier. Waves are the primary unit of work orchestration in fulfillment — all picking activity flows through wave release.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wave planning record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier assigned to ship orders from this wave. Used for carrier coordination and last-mile delivery dispatch.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility (DC, MFC, or store backroom) where this wave is executed.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_calendar. Business justification: Wave scheduling uses the promotional calendar to align wave start/end dates with campaign calendars.

attributes.name: sla_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.sla_policy. Business justification: Associating a wave with its SLA policy provides clear policy enforcement per wave and introduces needed inbound relationship for sla_policy.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier_site. Business justification: Grocery DC inbound receiving waves are organized around scheduled supplier site deliveries. Linking wave to supplier_site enables inbound wave planning tied to supplier delivery appointments, receivin

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the delivery route assigned to this wave. Used for route optimization and last-mile delivery planning.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when wave picking was completed. Used for cycle time analysis and SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when wave picking began. Used for performance analysis and variance tracking against planned start time.

attributes.name: cancelled_line_count
attributes.description: Number of order lines cancelled during wave execution due to inventory issues, quality problems, or customer cancellations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wave record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and wave planning analysis.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Primary material handling equipment type used for this wave: pallet jack, forklift, order picker, reach truck, cart, or automated system (AS/RS, AMR).

attributes.name: facility_zone
attributes.description: Physical zone or area within the facility where this wave is executed (e.g., ambient zone, refrigerated zone, freezer zone, backroom section).

attributes.name: fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of order lines successfully picked and fulfilled in this wave. Calculated as (lines picked / total lines) × 100. Key metric for inventory availability and fulfillment performance.

attributes.name: is_cold_chain_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this wave maintained required temperature controls throughout execution per HACCP standards. True if compliant, False if temperature excursions occurred.

attributes.name: is_rush_wave
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is an expedited rush wave requiring immediate processing outside of normal wave planning cycles. True for rush waves, False for standard waves.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wave record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments about this wave execution, including special handling instructions, issues encountered, or process deviations.

attributes.name: pick_method
attributes.description: Picking methodology used for this wave: discrete (single order at a time), batch (multiple orders picked together), zone (pickers assigned to zones), wave (coordinated multi-zone), or cluster (cart-based multi-order).

attributes.name: picker_count
attributes.description: Number of warehouse pickers assigned to execute this wave. Used for labor productivity analysis and staffing optimization.

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when wave picking is planned to be completed. Used for SLA tracking and downstream process coordination.

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when wave picking is planned to begin. Used for labor scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this wave for resource allocation and sequencing. Urgent waves are processed first, followed by high, normal, and low priority waves.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wave was released to the warehouse floor for execution. Marks the transition from planned to active status.

attributes.name: short_pick_count
attributes.description: Number of order lines that could not be fully picked due to insufficient inventory (out-of-stock or OOS). Used for inventory accuracy and replenishment analysis.

attributes.name: sla_cutoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Service level agreement deadline by which this wave must be completed to meet customer delivery commitments. Used for on-time performance tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for this wave: ambient (room temperature), refrigerated (cold chain 0-4°C), frozen (below 0°C), or multi-temp (mixed temperature requirements). Critical for cold chain integrity tracking.

attributes.name: total_lines
attributes.description: Total number of order lines (SKU-level picks) across all orders in this wave. Used for pick task generation and labor allocation.

attributes.name: total_orders
attributes.description: Total number of distinct orders included in this wave. Used for batch size optimization and order fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (eaches) to be picked in this wave across all orders and SKUs. Used for workload estimation and productivity tracking.

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume in cubic meters of all items to be picked in this wave. Used for container and vehicle capacity planning.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 (Quantities and Units - Space and Time)

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of all items to be picked in this wave. Used for equipment planning (forklifts, pallet jacks) and carrier capacity allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 (Quantities and Units - Space and Time)

attributes.name: wave_number
attributes.description: Business-facing wave identifier used for operational tracking and communication. Externally-known unique code for this wave.

attributes.name: wave_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wave: planned (created but not released), released (active for picking), in-progress (picking underway), completed (all tasks finished), cancelled (aborted), or on-hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: wave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wave based on fulfillment purpose: replenishment (store restocking), ecommerce (online order fulfillment), DSD (Direct Store Delivery), store transfer, bulk pick, or cross-dock operations.

attributes.name: wms_wave_identifier
attributes.description: Native wave identifier from the source WMS system (Manhattan Associates, SAP WM, or other). Used for system integration and cross-reference.

products.name: wms_task
products.description: Unified warehouse management system task representing any directed work assignment within a DC, MFC, or store backroom — including picking, putaway, replenishment, and cycle count tasks. For pick tasks: tracks task type (single, batch, cluster, zone), assigned associate, pick location (aisle, bay, level, bin), target quantity, actual quantity picked, pick method (voice, RF, paper), start and completion timestamps, exception reason (OOS, damaged, substituted), and WMS task ID. For putaway tasks: tracks task type (directed, random, cross-dock), source location (dock door, staging area), target slot location, SKU/UPC, quantity, lot number, expiration date, putaway method (FIFO, LIFO, FEFO), assigned associate, and exception code (location full, damaged goods, wrong item). All task types share common attributes: task status, priority, wave reference, facility zone, and completion metrics.

While the path wms_task → fulfillment_order_line → fulfillment_order exists, a direct FK to fulfillment_order enables efficient order-leve

This fundamental WMS rec

attributes.name: slot_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.slot_location. Business justification: Linking each WMS task to its exact slot location enables precise location tracking and removes redundant location attributes from wms_task.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Pick task must reference the exact stock position to locate items for picking, required for the 'Pick Execution' process and inventory accuracy reports.

attributes.name: transfer_order_id

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_pick_timestamp

attributes.name: width_inches

attributes.name: zone_code

attributes.name: zone_type

products.name: sla_policy
products.description: Unified SLA management product encompassing policy definitions and breach event tracking for all fulfillment time commitments. Policy side: SLA name, fulfillment channel (delivery, pickup, ship-to-store), order type (standard, express, same-day, next-day), customer tier, pick/pack/dispatch SLA minutes, total fulfillment SLA hours, effective date range, and active flag. Breach side: individual breach event records where fulfillment orders, tasks, or deliveries failed to meet committed service levels — capturing breach ID, breach type (pick SLA, pack SLA, dispatch SLA, delivery SLA), breach timestamp, minutes overdue, root cause category (OOS, staffing, carrier delay, system outage, weather), impacted order count, customer notification sent flag, escalation level, resolution timestamp, and corrective action. Enables SLA compliance reporting, real-time breach alerting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: operational_region_code
attributes.description: Code representing the primary geographic region where the vehicle operates.

attributes.name: payload_weight_limit_kg
attributes.description: Maximum payload weight the vehicle is rated to carry.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date the vehicle was acquired by Grocery.

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle's registration expires.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration identifier assigned by the motor vehicle authority.

attributes.name: registration_state
attributes.description: State or province that issued the vehicle registration.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the vehicle record.

attributes.name: vehicle_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name or designation of the vehicle.

attributes.name: vehicle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vehicle.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Category of vehicle used for fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: Manufacturer‑assigned unique vehicle identifier.

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: Year the vehicle was manufactured.

domains.name: pricing
domains.description: Price management across all channels including SRP, competitive pricing, zone pricing, markdown strategies, and dynamic fuel pricing. Manages price changes, promotional pricing linkages, ASP analytics, and price optimization algorithms. Supports competitive intelligence integration and ensures FTC pricing compliance.

products.name: retail_price
products.description: Authoritative master record of the current shelf price (SRP) for every SKU within a specific price zone and channel. Captures base retail price, effective and expiration dates, price zone assignment, unit of measure, price tier, and price-ending convention. Serves as the single source of truth for item-level retail pricing and the foundation for all price change, markdown, TPR, and promotional pricing workflows.

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retail price record. Primary key for the retail price entity.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Category‑Level Price Optimization report requires linking each retail_price to its category for margin analysis and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: retail_price.cost_basis_amount is a denormalized copy of the vendor invoice cost used for margin calculation. cost_price is the authoritative COGS record per SKU. Adding cost_price_id FK allows retail

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Retail prices are associated with revenue GL accounts for sales financial reporting and margin analysis. In retail-grocery, each price point maps to a revenue account (grocery, produce, pharmacy) enab

attributes.name: new_item_intro_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.new_item_intro. Business justification: New item introductions require initial retail price setup — the suggested_retail_price on new_item_intro drives the first retail_price record created. Pricing teams reference the new item intro record

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_rule. Business justification: retail_price has rounding_rule_code and price_ending_convention which are pricing rule attributes defined on price_rule. Adding price_rule_id FK links the SRP record to the governing business rule tha

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the geographic or market-based price zone where this retail price is effective. Supports zone-based pricing strategies.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the SKU to which this retail price applies. Links to the product master.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Business process: Supplier Suggested Retail Price (SRP) is used as a baseline in retail_price; linking SRP to supplier supports price‑setting and supplier performance analysis.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this retail price was approved for activation. Part of the pricing workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: competitor_price_reference
attributes.description: The most recent competitive price benchmark for this SKU from competitive intelligence sources. Used for price positioning and competitive response strategies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this retail price record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for price lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the retail price amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this retail price becomes active and available for sale transactions. Part of the price lifecycle management.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this retail price is no longer valid and must be replaced. Nullable for open-ended pricing. Supports automated price change workflows.

attributes.name: external_price_code
attributes.description: The unique price identifier from the source system of record (e.g., Oracle Retail price ID, SAP condition record number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and EDI integration.

attributes.name: last_price_change_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent price change for this SKU in this zone and channel. Used for price volatility analysis and change frequency tracking.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this retail price record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_price
attributes.description: The special retail price available exclusively to loyalty program members. Nullable if no loyalty pricing exists. Supports customer loyalty and personalized pricing strategies.

attributes.name: margin_percentage
attributes.description: The gross margin percentage calculated as (SRP - Cost) / SRP * 100. Confidential metric used for category management and pricing optimization.

attributes.name: minimum_advertised_price
attributes.description: The minimum price at which this SKU can be advertised, as stipulated by the vendor or manufacturer. Nullable if no MAP restriction exists. Ensures vendor compliance.

attributes.name: multi_buy_price
attributes.description: The total price for the multi-buy quantity (e.g., $5.00 for 3-for-$5). Nullable if not a multi-buy price. Used in POS promotional pricing calculations.

attributes.name: multi_buy_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity threshold for multi-buy pricing (e.g., 2 for Buy One Get One, 3 for 3-for-$5 deals). Nullable if not a multi-buy price. Supports promotional pricing logic.

attributes.name: price_change_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of price changes for this SKU in this zone and channel since initial pricing. Supports price stability metrics.

attributes.name: price_change_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason code for the most recent price change. Supports audit trails and price change analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cost_increase|competitive_response|markdown|promotion_end|seasonal_adjustment|new_item|clearance|vendor_funded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: price_display_text
attributes.description: The formatted text string for displaying the price on shelf tags, digital signage, and e-commerce (e.g., '$3.99 ea', '2 for $5', '$1.99/lb'). Supports omnichannel price presentation consistency.

attributes.name: price_lock_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the price lock expires and normal pricing governance resumes. Nullable if no lock is in place.

attributes.name: price_lock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price is locked and cannot be changed without executive approval. Used for contract pricing, vendor agreements, and strategic items.

attributes.name: price_optimization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price was set by an automated price optimization algorithm (true) or manually by a pricing analyst (false). Supports AI/ML pricing governance.

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the retail price record. Active prices are used in POS transactions; pending prices await activation; expired prices are historical.

attributes.name: price_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy tier for this SKU (e.g., standard, premium, value, promotional, clearance, everyday low price). Supports price positioning and markdown analytics.

attributes.name: price_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the price type distinguishing base prices from temporary price reductions (TPR), promotional prices, clearance prices, and dynamic prices. Critical for price hierarchy and promotional linkage.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is eligible for purchase using SNAP/EBT benefits. Required for government assistance program compliance and POS transaction processing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The operational system or process that originated this retail price record (e.g., Oracle Retail Price Management, SAP Retail, manual entry, price optimization engine). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: srp_amount
attributes.description: The base shelf price for the SKU in this zone and channel, excluding any promotional or temporary price reductions. This is the single source of truth for item-level retail pricing.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for which the retail price is defined (e.g., each, pound, kilogram). Critical for produce and bulk items sold by weight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|case|pack|dozen — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Required for government assistance program compliance and POS transaction processing.

products.name: price_zone
products.description: Defines geographic or competitive pricing zones used to differentiate retail prices across store clusters. Each zone groups stores with similar competitive environments, cost structures, or market demographics. Supports zone-based pricing strategies where the same SKU carries different shelf prices in different zones. Referenced by retail_price, price_change, and competitive_price records as the geographic pricing boundary.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Primary key for price_zone

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Price zones in retail-grocery align with profit centers for financial performance reporting by market/region. Zone-level pricing strategy decisions are evaluated against profit center P&L results, req

attributes.name: competitive_intensity
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive pressure within this zone based on number and strength of competitors. Drives pricing aggressiveness.

attributes.name: competitive_price_match_policy
attributes.description: Policy for matching competitor prices in this zone: none (no matching), manual (case-by-case approval), automated (system-driven matching), or selective (specific categories only).

attributes.name: cost_index
attributes.description: Relative cost index for this zone compared to a baseline (e.g., 1.00 = baseline, 1.15 = 15% higher costs). Reflects distribution, labor, and occupancy cost differences.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price zone record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this price zone ceases to be active. Null for open-ended zones.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this price zone becomes active and begins to govern pricing for assigned stores.

attributes.name: fuel_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price zone applies to fuel center pricing. True if zone governs fuel prices; false if zone is retail-only.

attributes.name: income_profile
attributes.description: Predominant household income level within the zone, used to calibrate price sensitivity and product mix.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this price zone configuration was last reviewed and validated by pricing management. Used to ensure zones remain aligned with market conditions.

attributes.name: markdown_strategy
attributes.description: Approach to markdown and clearance pricing within this zone: aggressive (deep discounts), moderate (standard clearance), conservative (minimal markdowns), or none (no markdowns allowed).

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Geographic market segment classification for the zone, used to align pricing with local market characteristics.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the pricing analyst or system that last modified this price zone record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price zone record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this price zone. Ensures periodic reassessment of zone boundaries and strategies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or context about this price zone. Used by pricing analysts for documentation.

attributes.name: pharmacy_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price zone applies to pharmacy prescription pricing. True if zone governs pharmacy prices; false if zone is retail-only.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base prices to derive zone-specific retail prices. For example, 1.0500 means 5% uplift over base.

attributes.name: price_change_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether price changes in this zone require managerial approval before execution. True if approval workflow is enforced; false if automated.

attributes.name: price_optimization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether algorithmic price optimization is active for this zone. True if AI/ML pricing algorithms are used; false if manual pricing rules apply.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The overarching pricing strategy applied to this zone: everyday_low (EDLP), high_low (frequent promotions), premium (higher margin), discount (low margin high volume), market_match (competitive parity), or penetration (aggressive entry pricing).

attributes.name: private_label_strategy
attributes.description: Pricing approach for private-label (store-owned brand) products in this zone: standard (parity with national brands), premium (higher margin), value (aggressive discount), or mixed (varies by category).

attributes.name: promotional_frequency
attributes.description: Typical cadence of promotional pricing events in this zone, aligned with ad circular schedules and competitive response.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Code representing the broader geographic region or division that this price zone belongs to, for hierarchical rollup and reporting.

attributes.name: snap_ebt_volume_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) / EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) Volume Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transaction volume in this zone paid via SNAP/EBT benefits. Influences pricing sensitivity and product mix decisions.

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Number of stores currently assigned to this price zone. Updated as stores are added or removed.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the price zone, used in pricing systems and reports. Typically alphanumeric and unique across the enterprise.

attributes.name: zone_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the price zone, including the rationale for grouping stores (e.g., competitive environment, demographics, cost structure).

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the price zone, such as 'Metro East', 'Rural Southwest', or 'High Competition Urban'.

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price zone. Active zones are in use for pricing; inactive zones are temporarily disabled; pending zones are under review; archived zones are historical.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price zone strategy: competitive (based on competitor density), geographic (regional boundaries), demographic (customer income/profile), cost_based (distribution cost), hybrid (multiple factors), or promotional (special event-driven).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the pricing analyst or system that created this price zone record.

products.name: price_change
products.description: Transactional record of every approved retail price change event for a SKU in a given price zone. Captures old price, new price, effective date, expiration date, change reason code (cost increase, competitive response, seasonal, vendor-funded), initiating buyer, approval status, and batch reference. Supports FTC pricing compliance audit trails, comp-sales impact analysis, and price change velocity reporting.

attributes.name: price_change_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price change event. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Price Change Impact Dashboard aggregates changes by category to assess competitive response and margin effect.

attributes.name: competitive_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.competitive_price. Business justification: price_change has competitive_price_reference (DECIMAL) and competitor_name (STRING) — denormalized competitive intelligence data. Many price changes are triggered by competitive observations. Adding c

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Price changes often depend on the underlying cost basis; linking to cost_price captures the cost record driving the price change and provides a direct relationship.

attributes.name: new_item_intro_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.new_item_intro. Business justification: New item introductions generate the first price change record for a SKU — the initial price activation is a price_change event tied to the new_item_intro approval. Grocery pricing teams track new item

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.planogram. Business justification: Planogram resets are a primary trigger for price changes in grocery — new planogram activations prompt competitive repricing and shelf-tag updates. Price change records need to reference the planogram

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_rule. Business justification: price_change records approved price change events. Each price change should be traceable to the governing price_rule that authorized or triggered it (e.g., cost-driven rule, competitive rule, margin r

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geographic or competitive price zone where this price change applies.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this price change to a promotional campaign if the change is promotion-driven. Nullable for non-promotional changes.

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.retail_price. Business justification: price_change is a transactional record of an approved price change event that modifies the SRP for a SKU in a price zone. retail_price is the master SRP record being changed. price_change is a child o

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU for which the price is being changed.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific store location if this price change applies to a single store rather than a zone. Nullable for zone-level changes.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier associated with this price change, particularly for vendor-funded price reductions or cost-driven increases.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change was activated and became effective in Point of Sale (POS) systems.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between new price and old price (new_price minus old_price). Positive for increases, negative for decreases.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the price change request.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change was approved by the pricing authority.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the price change event, often used in approval workflows and audit trails.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the business reason for the price change: cost increase, competitive response, seasonal adjustment, vendor-funded promotion, markdown, or clearance.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price change: regular price adjustment, promotional pricing, temporary price reduction (TPR), permanent price change, or markdown.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The sales channel to which this price change applies: in-store, online eCommerce, mobile app, curbside pickup, or home delivery.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor whose pricing influenced this change, used for competitive response tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting compliance considerations, regulatory review outcomes, or audit trail details for FTC pricing compliance.

attributes.name: compliance_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price change required Federal Trade Commission (FTC) pricing compliance review due to regulatory sensitivity (True) or was routine (False).

attributes.name: cost_change_amount
attributes.description: The change in product cost from the vendor that triggered this retail price change. Used for margin analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the new price becomes active and is applied at Point of Sale (POS).

attributes.name: elasticity_coefficient
attributes.description: The price elasticity of demand coefficient used in the pricing decision, representing the expected percentage change in quantity demanded for a 1% price change.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this price change expires and reverts or transitions to another price. Nullable for permanent changes.

attributes.name: forecasted_revenue_impact
attributes.description: The projected change in revenue resulting from this price change, calculated from volume and price elasticity models.

attributes.name: forecasted_volume_impact
attributes.description: The projected change in sales volume (units) resulting from this price change, based on demand forecasting models.

attributes.name: margin_impact_percent
attributes.description: The projected impact on Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) resulting from this price change, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: new_price
attributes.description: The new retail price effective after this change event.

attributes.name: old_price
attributes.description: The previous retail price before this change event.

attributes.name: percent
attributes.description: The percentage change in price calculated as ((new_price - old_price) / old_price) * 100.

attributes.name: price_optimization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price change was generated by an automated price optimization algorithm (True) or manually initiated (False).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system that originated this price change record (e.g., Oracle Retail Price Management, SAP Retail SD).

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change request was submitted into the pricing system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer.

products.name: markdown
products.description: Records planned and executed markdown events for clearance, seasonal rotation, or perishable shrink reduction. Captures markdown type (permanent, temporary, clearance), markdown percentage or absolute amount, start and end dates, triggering condition (e.g., days-on-shelf threshold, sell-through rate), and store or zone scope. Distinct from TPR promotional pricing — markdowns are inventory-driven price reductions managed by category managers.

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the markdown event. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Markdown Planning process uses category to set markdown thresholds and evaluate sell‑through per category.

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: markdown records planned and executed markdown events with estimated and actual margin impact fields. To accurately calculate margin impact, markdown needs the authoritative COGS basis from cost_price

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Markdown accruals and actual margin impacts are reported by fiscal period for financial close in retail-grocery. Period-end markdown reserve calculations and variance reporting require linking markdow

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Markdowns generate markdown expense postings to specific GL accounts (shrink, markdown reserve, clearance expense). Retail-grocery finance teams require GL account assignment on markdowns for P&L impa

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.planogram. Business justification: Planogram resets trigger markdown clearance events in grocery — discontinued items identified during planogram changes require markdown execution. Markdown managers need to link clearance activity to

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the automated markdown rule that triggered this event. Null if manually created.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: The pricing zone to which this markdown applies. Null if markdown is store-specific or enterprise-wide.

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.retail_price. Business justification: markdown records a planned or executed markdown event that reduces the price of a SKU. retail_price is the master SRP record being marked down. markdown is a child of retail_price — it operates on a s

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: The SKU subject to this markdown event.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: The store where this markdown is applied. Null if markdown applies to a zone or all stores.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Business process: Supplier‑funded markdowns (allowances) are tracked per markdown record; linking to supplier captures funding source for margin and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: trade_allowance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_allowance. Business justification: Vendor-funded markdowns (clearance support, seasonal markdown allowances) must be traceable to the specific trade_allowance funding them. This supports vendor markdown accrual accounting and settlemen

attributes.name: actual_margin_impact
attributes.description: The actual gross margin impact realized from this markdown event, calculated after completion.

attributes.name: actual_revenue_impact
attributes.description: The actual revenue impact realized from this markdown event, calculated after completion by comparing markdown revenue to baseline revenue projection.

attributes.name: actual_units_sold
attributes.description: The actual number of units sold during the markdown period. Populated after markdown completion for performance analysis.

attributes.name: ad_circular_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this markdown is featured in the weekly ad circular or promotional flyer (True) or is an in-store-only markdown (False).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The absolute dollar amount by which the price is reduced. Null if markdown is expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this markdown was approved by the pricing team.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason this markdown was cancelled before activation (e.g., 'inventory sold out', 'pricing error', 'vendor credit received', 'competitive intelligence changed'). Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this markdown record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_on_shelf_threshold
attributes.description: The number of days an item has been on the shelf that triggered this markdown (e.g., 30 days for slow movers). Null if not applicable to this markdown type.

attributes.name: days_to_expiration_threshold
attributes.description: The number of days remaining until product expiration that triggered this markdown for perishables. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the markdown expires and pricing reverts to the original or a new price. Null for permanent markdowns.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the markdown becomes active and the reduced price takes effect.

attributes.name: estimated_margin_impact
attributes.description: The estimated gross margin impact (in dollars) from this markdown, calculated at planning time using COGS and markdown price.

attributes.name: estimated_revenue_impact
attributes.description: The estimated revenue loss or gain from this markdown event, calculated at planning time. Negative values indicate revenue reduction; positive values indicate incremental revenue from volume lift.

attributes.name: ftc_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any FTC pricing compliance considerations for this markdown, such as comparative pricing claims, former price disclosures, or advertising restrictions.

attributes.name: inventory_units_threshold
attributes.description: The inventory unit count threshold that triggered this markdown due to overstock. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this markdown was triggered automatically by a system rule (True) or manually created by a category manager (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this markdown record was last updated.

attributes.name: markdown_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the markdown event, used in reporting and communication with category managers.

attributes.name: markdown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the markdown event: planned (proposed by category manager), approved (authorized by pricing team), active (currently in effect), completed (end date reached), cancelled (revoked before activation).

attributes.name: markdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the markdown: permanent (ongoing price reduction), temporary (time-bound markdown), clearance (end-of-life inventory liquidation), seasonal (seasonal rotation), or perishable (shrink reduction for fresh items nearing expiration).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the category manager or pricing analyst providing additional context, rationale, or instructions for this markdown event.

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The regular retail price (SRP) before the markdown is applied, in local currency.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the original price (e.g., 25.00 for 25% off). Null if markdown is expressed as an absolute amount.

attributes.name: planned_units_to_clear
attributes.description: The target number of inventory units the category manager intends to sell through with this markdown. Used for clearance and overstock scenarios.

attributes.name: pos_signage_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Signage Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-store signage or shelf tags must be updated to reflect the markdown price (True) or if the price change is system-only (False).

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: The final retail price after the markdown is applied, in local currency.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: The business reason triggering the markdown: slow_mover (low sell-through rate), overstock (excess inventory), damage (product quality issue), expiration (approaching best-by date), seasonal_rotation (end of season), discontinued (product phase-out).

attributes.name: sell_through_rate_threshold
attributes.description: The sell-through rate percentage threshold that triggered this markdown (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: triggering_condition
attributes.description: The business rule or threshold that triggered this markdown event (e.g., 'days on shelf > 30', 'sell-through rate < 20%', 'inventory units > 500', 'days to expiration < 7'). Free-text field capturing the logic used by the category manager or automated system.

products.name: tpr
products.description: Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) record linking a SKU to a short-term shelf price reduction that is NOT tied to a formal promotion campaign. Captures the TPR price, regular price, discount amount, start and end dates, store or zone scope, and vendor funding flag (indicating whether a CPG vendor is subsidizing the reduction via a trade deal). Distinct from markdown (clearance) and from promotion-driven pricing.

attributes.name: tpr_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the temporary price reduction record.

attributes.name: category_id
