products.name: planogram
products.description: Visual merchandise display plan defining the exact placement, facings, and shelf positions of SKUs within a store fixture or gondola section. Captures planogram version, effective dates, fixture type, total shelf capacity, and compliance status. Includes position-level detail: individual SKU slots with shelf number, bay number, facing count, capacity, and display orientation for each product placement. Source of truth for space planning and shelf execution. Derived from Oracle Retail and space planning tools (e.g., Blue Yonder, JDA).

attributes.name: fixture_type

attributes.name: layout_orientation

Brand blocking groups products by manufacturer, price point arranges by cost tiers, size progression orders by package size, color blocking groups by visual appeal, cross merchandising combines complementary categories.

products.name: space_allocation

Captures allocated linear feet, number of shelves, gondola sections, endcap position assignments (featured SKU/category, assignment dates, promotional tie-in), fixture type, seasonal space adjustments, vendor-funded indicators, and effective date ranges. Drives planogram development, category space productivity (GMROI per linear foot) analysis, and high-visibility promotional display management including endcap rotation scheduling.

Serves as the physical anchor for planogram placement and space allocation records. Referenced by planogram and space_allocation to connect logical merchandise plans to physical store infrastructure.

domains.name: payment
domains.description: Payment processing for all transaction types including credit/debit cards, EBT, SNAP, WIC, mobile wallets, gift cards, and fuel rewards. Manages payment authorization, settlement, chargebacks, refunds, and PCI DSS compliance. Integrates with NCR POS systems, payment gateways, and digital commerce checkout.

products.name: tender_type
products.description: Reference master defining all accepted payment tender types at Grocery including credit card, debit card, EBT/SNAP, WIC, mobile wallet (Apple Pay, Google Pay), gift card, fuel rewards redemption, check, and cash. Captures tender code, tender name, tender category, accepted channels (POS, eCommerce, mobile app), processing network, requires_pin flag, supports_partial_tender flag, is_contactless flag, regulatory_program_code (e.g., SNAP, WIC), and active status. Used by NCR POS and Salesforce Commerce Cloud checkout to validate and route payment instruments.

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tender type. Primary key for the tender type reference master.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tender-to-GL mapping: each tender type (cash, credit card, EBT, gift card) maps to a distinct GL account for cash management and reconciliation. Grocery finance uses this mapping to automatically rout

attributes.name: accepted_ecommerce_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type is accepted for online orders through Salesforce Commerce Cloud. True for credit/debit cards and digital wallets; false for cash and check.

attributes.name: accepted_fuel_center_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type is accepted at fuel center pay-at-pump terminals. True for credit/debit cards and fleet cards; false for government benefits and gift cards.
attributes.references: Internal Payment Standards, Fuel Center Operations Standards

attributes.name: accepted_mobile_app_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type is accepted for orders placed through the Grocery mobile application. True for digital payment methods; false for cash and check.

attributes.name: accepted_pharmacy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type is accepted for pharmacy prescription transactions. True for most tender types; may have restrictions for certain government benefit programs.
attributes.references: HIPAA, State Pharmacy Regulations, Internal Payment Standards

attributes.name: accepted_pos_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accepted at POS (Point of Sale) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type is accepted at in-store NCR POS terminals. True for most tender types; false for online-only payment methods.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type is currently active and available for use across all channels. False indicates the tender type has been discontinued or temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: chargeback_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions using this tender type are subject to chargeback disputes initiated by cardholders. True for credit/debit cards; false for cash, check, and gift cards.
attributes.references: PCI DSS, Payment Network Chargeback Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tender type record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this tender type. Typically USD for US operations. Supports multi-currency scenarios for international expansion.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of tender types in POS and eCommerce checkout interfaces. Lower numbers appear first. Used to prioritize preferred payment methods.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this tender type was or will be discontinued. Null for currently active tender types with no planned end date. Supports sunset of deprecated payment methods.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this tender type became or will become available for use. Supports future-dated activation of new payment methods.

attributes.name: eligible_item_restriction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying product eligibility restrictions for this tender type. Used for government benefit programs (SNAP/WIC) that restrict purchases to approved product categories. Null for unrestricted tender types.

attributes.name: is_contactless_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type supports contactless payment via NFC (Near Field Communication) or RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology. True for Apple Pay, Google Pay, and contactless cards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tender type record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Updated whenever any attribute value changes.

attributes.name: maximum_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount allowed for this tender type per transaction. Null if no maximum applies. Used for gift cards, fuel rewards, and certain government benefit programs.
attributes.references: Internal Payment Standards, USDA SNAP Regulations

attributes.name: minimum_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount required to use this tender type. Null if no minimum applies. Used for certain credit card merchant agreements or promotional tender types.
attributes.references: Payment Network Standards, Internal Payment Standards

attributes.name: processing_network
attributes.description: Payment processing network or gateway used to authorize and settle transactions for this tender type. Examples: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, NYCE, STAR, Pulse, FIS, First Data, EBT Network.

attributes.name: refund_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether refunds can be issued back to this tender type. True for most tender types; false for certain government benefit programs with regulatory restrictions.
attributes.references: Internal Payment Standards, USDA SNAP Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the government regulatory program associated with this tender type. Examples: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women Infants and Children), EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer). Null for non-government tender types.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Regulations, State WIC Program Standards

attributes.name: requires_pin_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type requires PIN entry for authorization. True for debit cards, EBT, and some gift cards. False for credit cards and contactless wallets.

attributes.name: requires_signature_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type requires customer signature for authorization above certain transaction thresholds. True for credit cards above signature threshold; false for PIN-based and contactless payments.

attributes.name: settlement_batch_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions using this tender type are included in end-of-day settlement batch processing. True for electronic payment methods; false for cash and check which are reconciled separately.

attributes.name: signature_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Transaction amount threshold above which signature is required for this tender type. Null if signature is never required or always required regardless of amount.
attributes.references: Payment Network Standards, Internal Payment Standards

attributes.name: supports_partial_tender_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type can be used for partial payment of a transaction total, allowing split tender scenarios. True for most tender types; false for some government benefit programs with restrictions.

attributes.name: tender_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping similar tender types for reporting and analytics. Categories: card (credit/debit), electronic_wallet (mobile wallets), government_benefit (EBT/SNAP/WIC), gift_card, fuel_reward, cash, check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: card|electronic_wallet|government_benefit|gift_card|fuel_reward|cash|check — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tender_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tender type across all systems. Used by NCR POS and Salesforce Commerce Cloud for payment routing. Examples: CC, DC, EBT, SNAP, WIC, GPAY, APAY, GC, FUEL, CHK, CASH.

attributes.name: tender_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the tender type including usage guidelines, restrictions, and business rules. Provides context for associates and system integrators.

attributes.name: tender_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the tender type displayed to customers and associates. Examples: Credit Card, Debit Card, EBT/SNAP, WIC, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Gift Card, Fuel Rewards, Check, Cash.

attributes.name: tokenization_supported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tender type supports payment tokenization for secure storage and recurring transactions. True for credit/debit cards and digital wallets; false for cash and check.

products.name: method
products.description: Master record of a shopper's stored payment instrument on file with Grocery, representing a tokenized payment credential registered for use across POS, eCommerce, and mobile channels. Distinct from tender_type (which defines accepted payment categories), this entity represents a specific customer's saved card, wallet, or benefit credential. Captures payment_method_token (PCI DSS tokenized PAN), tender_type_id reference, card_brand (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), last_four_digits, expiration_month, expiration_year, billing_zip, wallet_provider (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay), gift_card_balance, EBT_card_number_token, is_default flag, is_expired flag, tokenization_provider, and vault_reference_id. Owned by the payment domain as the SSOT for stored payment credentials; shopper identity is linked via FK to customer domain.

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stored payment method. Primary key for the payment_method entity.

attributes.name: gateway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_gateway. Business justification: A payment_method is processed through a specific payment gateway; linking via payment_gateway_id enforces consistency and removes the free‑text gateway column.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.gift_card. Business justification: The method table represents stored payment instruments including gift cards (evidenced by gift_card_balance column). When a method represents a gift card instrument, it should link to the gift_card ma

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper who owns this stored payment credential. Links to the customer domain shopper entity.

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tender type category (credit card, debit card, EBT, gift card, mobile wallet) that this payment method belongs to.

attributes.name: avs_result_code
attributes.description: The most recent AVS result code returned during payment method verification. Used to assess fraud risk and address match quality.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address line associated with the payment method for billing and Address Verification Service (AVS) checks.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: The secondary street address line (apartment, suite, unit) associated with the payment method for billing purposes. Optional field.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: The city associated with the billing address for this payment method. Used for AVS verification.

attributes.name: billing_country
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code for the billing address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Used for international payment processing and compliance.

attributes.name: billing_state
attributes.description: The state or province code associated with the billing address. Used for AVS verification and tax calculation.

attributes.name: billing_zip
attributes.description: The postal code associated with the billing address. Critical for Address Verification Service (AVS) fraud prevention checks.

attributes.name: bin_number
attributes.description: The first six digits of the payment card number, identifying the issuing bank and card type. Used for routing and fraud detection. Not considered PII per PCI DSS.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: The payment card network brand for credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club). Null for non-card payment methods.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: The functional type of payment card: Credit (revolving credit), Debit (linked to bank account), Prepaid (preloaded funds), Charge (full payment required), Unknown (type not determined). Null for non-card payment methods.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: The name embossed on the payment card as provided by the cardholder. Used for verification and display purposes.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which this payment method was originally registered: POS (Point of Sale), eCommerce, Mobile App, Call Center, or Kiosk. Distinct from tender_type.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment method record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: cvv_verification_status
attributes.description: The result of the most recent CVV verification check: Verified (match), Failed (no match), Not Checked (skipped), Not Applicable (non-card payment method).

attributes.name: deleted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment method was soft-deleted by the customer or system. Null for active records. Supports GDPR right to erasure compliance.

attributes.name: ebt_card_number_token
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Card Number Token
attributes.description: Tokenized EBT card number for SNAP or WIC benefit programs. Complies with federal privacy requirements for benefit program data.

attributes.name: ebt_program_type
attributes.description: The government assistance program type for EBT cards: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women Infants and Children), TANF (Temporary Assistance for Needy Families). Null for non-EBT payment methods.

attributes.name: expiration_month
attributes.description: The month (1-12) when the payment card expires. Used to validate card validity at transaction time. Null for non-expiring payment methods.

attributes.name: expiration_year
attributes.description: The four-digit year when the payment card expires. Used to validate card validity at transaction time. Null for non-expiring payment methods.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Risk score (0-100) assigned by fraud detection systems based on payment method characteristics, usage patterns, and verification results. Higher scores indicate higher fraud risk.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the shoppers default payment method for transactions. Only one payment method per shopper should be marked as default.

attributes.name: is_expired
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment method has passed its expiration date and is no longer valid for transactions. Calculated based on expiration_month and expiration_year.

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment method has been successfully verified through AVS, CVV check, or micro-deposit validation.

attributes.name: issuing_bank
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution that issued the payment card. Derived from the Bank Identification Number (BIN) during tokenization.

attributes.name: last_four_digits
attributes.description: The last four digits of the payment account number, used for customer identification and display purposes without exposing the full PAN.

attributes.name: last_used_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment method was last successfully used for a transaction. Used to identify dormant payment methods for cleanup.

attributes.name: method_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment method: Active (available for use), Inactive (customer disabled), Suspended (fraud hold), Expired (past expiration date), Pending Verification (awaiting validation), Blocked (permanently disabled).

attributes.name: nickname
attributes.description: Optional customer-provided friendly name for this payment method (e.g., My Visa Card, Work Amex) to help identify it in the wallet UI.

attributes.name: payment_method_token
attributes.description: PCI DSS compliant tokenized representation of the payment account number (PAN). This token is used in place of the actual card number for secure storage and processing.

attributes.name: tokenization_provider
attributes.description: The third-party tokenization service provider that generated the payment_method_token (e.g., Fiserv, Worldpay, Stripe, internal vault). Critical for token lifecycle management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment method record was last modified. Updated on any field change for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: vault_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier in the external payment vault or tokenization system. Used to retrieve or update the tokenized credential from the vault provider.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when this payment method was last successfully verified. Used to determine if re-verification is required per security policies.

attributes.name: wallet_provider
attributes.description: The digital wallet provider if this payment method is a mobile or digital wallet credential (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal, Venmo). Null or None for traditional payment methods.

attributes.name: wallet_token
attributes.description: The tokenized credential provided by the digital wallet provider for secure transaction processing. Distinct from payment_method_token.

products.name: gateway
products.description: Reference master of external payment gateway and processor configurations used by Grocery to route authorization and settlement requests. Captures gateway_code, gateway_name, processor_name (e.g., First Data, Worldpay, Stripe), supported_tender_types, gateway_endpoint_url, timeout_ms, retry_policy, settlement_currency, acquirer_bank, merchant_id, terminal_id_prefix, pci_dss_compliance_level, certification_expiry_date, and is_active flag. Supports multi-gateway routing logic for POS, eCommerce, and fuel center payment lanes.

attributes.name: gateway_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment gateway configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: acquirer_bank
attributes.description: Name of the acquiring bank or financial institution that sponsors the merchant account and settles funds (e.g., JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo Merchant Services).
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 12.8 - Service Provider Management

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Version of the gateway API currently in use (e.g., v2.1, 2023-10). Critical for integration compatibility and upgrade planning.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gateway contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term. True = auto-renews, False = requires manual renewal.

attributes.name: average_response_time_ms
attributes.description: Rolling average response time in milliseconds for authorization requests to this gateway over the last 24 hours. Performance metric for gateway selection and monitoring.

attributes.name: batch_settlement_time
attributes.description: Time of day (HH:MM format, 24-hour) when batch settlement is submitted to this gateway. Determines when daily transaction batches are closed and funds are transferred.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the gateway provider's PCI DSS certification or compliance attestation expires. Requires renewal to maintain operational status.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 12.9 - Annual Compliance Validation

attributes.name: chargeback_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by the processor per chargeback dispute in settlement currency. Confidential pricing information.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract with the gateway provider expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null for open-ended contracts.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract with the gateway provider became effective. Marks the beginning of the service agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gateway configuration record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: endpoint_url
attributes.description: The HTTPS endpoint URL for authorization and settlement API calls. Confidential operational configuration.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 2.2 - Secure System Configuration

attributes.name: gateway_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the gateway configuration (e.g., FIRSTDATA_POS, STRIPE_ECOM, WORLDPAY_FUEL). Used for routing logic and system integration references.

attributes.name: gateway_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the payment gateway configuration (e.g., First Data POS Gateway, Stripe eCommerce Gateway).

attributes.name: gateway_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the gateway configuration. Active gateways are available for transaction routing; inactive/suspended gateways are excluded from routing logic.

attributes.name: gateway_type
attributes.description: Classification of the gateway by channel or use case. Determines which business systems route transactions through this gateway.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this gateway is currently active and available for transaction routing. True = active, False = inactive.

attributes.name: last_health_check_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful health check or connectivity test to the gateway endpoint. Used for monitoring and alerting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gateway configuration record was last updated. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: merchant_account_number
attributes.description: The unique merchant identifier assigned by the processor or acquirer. Used in authorization and settlement messages. Confidential business identifier.
attributes.references: ISO 8583 Field 42 - Card Acceptor Identification Code

attributes.name: monthly_gateway_fee
attributes.description: Fixed monthly fee charged by the gateway provider for access and maintenance in settlement currency. Confidential pricing information.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, configuration details, or special instructions related to this gateway configuration.

attributes.name: pci_dss_compliance_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Compliance Level
attributes.description: The PCI DSS compliance level of the gateway provider based on annual transaction volume. Level 1 is highest (6M+ transactions/year), Level 4 is lowest (under 1M transactions/year). Determines audit and validation requirements.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank for multi-gateway routing logic. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. When multiple gateways support the same tender type, the system routes to the highest priority (lowest rank number) available gateway.

attributes.name: processor_name
attributes.description: Name of the underlying payment processor or acquirer (e.g., First Data, Worldpay, Stripe, Chase Paymentech, Elavon). The entity that processes authorization and settlement requests.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 12.8 - Service Provider Management

attributes.name: retry_policy
attributes.description: Defines the retry behavior when a gateway request fails or times out. Options: none (no retry), once (single retry), twice (two retries), exponential_backoff (progressive delay retries).

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this gateway settles funds (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Determines currency conversion and reconciliation logic.

attributes.name: settlement_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of business days between batch settlement submission and funds availability in the merchant bank account. Typical values: 1-3 days.

attributes.name: support_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the primary technical support contact at the gateway provider. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: support_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary technical support contact at the gateway provider for incident escalation and operational issues.

attributes.name: support_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the primary technical support contact at the gateway provider. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: supported_tender_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of tender types this gateway can process (e.g., credit_card, debit_card, ebt, snap, wic, gift_card, mobile_wallet, contactless, fuel_rewards). Drives tender routing logic at Point of Sale (POS) and digital checkout.

attributes.name: supports_3ds
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gateway supports 3D Secure authentication protocol for card-not-present transactions (e.g., eCommerce). True = 3DS supported, False = not supported.

attributes.name: supports_recurring_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gateway supports recurring billing or subscription payment processing. True = recurring billing supported, False = not supported.

attributes.name: supports_tokenization
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gateway supports payment tokenization for secure storage and reuse of payment credentials. True = tokenization supported, False = not supported.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3.2 - Tokenization as Alternative to Storage

attributes.name: terminal_id_prefix
attributes.description: Prefix used to construct terminal identifiers for Point of Sale (POS) devices routing through this gateway. Enables terminal-level transaction tracking and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 8583 Field 41 - Card Acceptor Terminal Identification

attributes.name: timeout_ms
attributes.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a response from the gateway before timing out the authorization request. Critical for customer experience at Point of Sale (POS).

attributes.name: transaction_fee_fixed
attributes.description: Fixed per-transaction fee charged by the processor in settlement currency (e.g., 0.1000 = $0.10 per transaction). Confidential pricing information.

attributes.name: transaction_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage-based transaction fee charged by the processor per authorization (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Confidential pricing information used for cost allocation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: uptime_percentage
attributes.description: Gateway uptime percentage over the last 30 days (e.g., 99.95). Service level agreement (SLA) performance metric.

products.name: authorization
products.description: Transactional record of each payment authorization request and response processed through Grocery's payment gateways. Captures authorization_code, authorization_status (approved, declined, referred, timeout), tender_type, card_brand, masked_pan, authorization_amount, currency_code, response_code, avs_result_code, cvv_result_code, gateway_reference_id, acquirer_reference_number (ARN), pos_terminal_id, store_id, channel (POS, eCommerce, mobile), requested_at_timestamp, responded_at_timestamp, response_time_ms, partial_approval_flag, partial_approved_amount, and is_void flag. Core transactional entity for real-time payment decisioning sourced from NCR POS and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment authorization transaction. Primary key for the authorization data product.

attributes.name: gateway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.gateway. Business justification: Each authorization request is routed through a specific payment gateway. The authorization table has gateway_reference_code (STRING) and processor_name (STRING) as denormalized captures, but lacks a p

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.method. Business justification: An authorization is performed against a specific stored payment instrument (method). Linking authorization to method enables fraud analysis, tokenization tracking, and stored-instrument lifecycle mana

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the settlement batch to which this authorization will be or has been submitted. Used for reconciliation between authorizations and settlements.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer associated with this authorization. Links payment authorization to customer loyalty and transaction history.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the authorization was initiated. Null for digital commerce channels.

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.tender_type. Business justification: Each authorization is for a specific tender type (credit, debit, EBT, etc.). The authorization table currently stores tender_type as a STRING, which is a denormalized copy of the tender_type master. A

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent transaction or order that initiated this authorization request. Links authorization to the originating business transaction.

attributes.name: acquirer_reference_number
attributes.description: 23-character unique reference number assigned by the acquiring bank for card transactions. Critical for chargeback and dispute tracking across the payment network.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total amount requested for authorization in the transaction currency. Represents the full payment amount submitted to the payment gateway.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Approval code returned by the payment gateway or card issuer upon successful authorization. Used for settlement reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current status of the authorization request indicating whether the payment was approved, declined, referred for manual review, timed out, encountered an error, or partially approved.

attributes.name: avs_result_code
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating the result of address verification check comparing billing address to issuer records. Used for fraud prevention (e.g., Y=Match, N=No Match, U=Unavailable).
attributes.references: PCI DSS Fraud Prevention Best Practices

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Brand or network of the payment card used (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, etc.). Null for non-card tender types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visa|mastercard|amex|discover|jcb|diners|maestro|unionpay|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cardholder_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the cardholder identity during the transaction (PIN entry, signature, no verification required, biometric, device authentication for mobile wallets).

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the authorization was initiated (in-store POS, eCommerce website, mobile app, phone order, self-service kiosk, fuel pump).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the authorization amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: cvv_result_code
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating the result of CVV/CVC verification check. Used for fraud prevention (e.g., M=Match, N=No Match, P=Not Processed).

attributes.name: ebt_balance_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining balance on the EBT card after this authorization. Returned by the EBT processor for SNAP and WIC transactions to inform the customer of available benefits.

attributes.name: entry_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the payment card data was captured (chip/EMV, magnetic stripe swipe, contactless/NFC, manual key entry, eCommerce, mobile wallet, tokenized). Impacts interchange rates and fraud liability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chip|swipe|contactless|manual|ecommerce|mobile_wallet|token — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fuel_rewards_redeemed_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of fuel rewards redeemed and applied to this authorization. Specific to fuel center transactions where loyalty fuel rewards are used as partial payment.

attributes.name: gateway_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway. Used for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and gateway-specific transaction tracking.

attributes.name: is_void
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization has been voided before settlement. Voided authorizations release the hold on customer funds and are not submitted for settlement.

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Customer loyalty card number presented during the transaction. Used to link payment authorization to loyalty program benefits and fuel rewards redemption.

attributes.name: masked_pan
attributes.description: Masked version of the payment card number showing only the first 4 and last 4 digits (e.g., 4532********1234). Used for customer service and reconciliation while maintaining PCI DSS compliance.

attributes.name: merchant_category_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code classifying the type of business for the merchant (e.g., 5411=Grocery Stores, 5542=Automated Fuel Dispensers). Used for interchange rate determination and card program restrictions.

attributes.name: network_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the card network (Visa, Mastercard, etc.). Used for end-to-end transaction tracking across the payment ecosystem.

attributes.name: partial_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the authorization was partially approved for an amount less than the requested amount. Common for prepaid cards and EBT transactions with insufficient balance.

attributes.name: partial_approved_amount
attributes.description: Amount actually approved when partial_approval_flag is true. Null when full amount is approved or authorization is declined.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical POS terminal or register that initiated the authorization. Null for digital commerce channels.

attributes.name: processor_name
attributes.description: Name of the payment processor or gateway that handled this authorization (e.g., First Data, Worldpay, Chase Paymentech). Used for multi-processor routing analysis and reconciliation.

attributes.name: requested_at_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the authorization request was submitted to the payment gateway. Represents the start of the authorization lifecycle.

attributes.name: responded_at_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the authorization response was received from the payment gateway. Used to calculate response time and monitor gateway performance.

attributes.name: response_code
attributes.description: Standardized response code returned by the payment gateway or card issuer indicating the reason for approval or decline (e.g., 00=Approved, 05=Do Not Honor, 51=Insufficient Funds).

attributes.name: response_time_ms
attributes.description: Time elapsed in milliseconds between authorization request and response. Key performance indicator for payment gateway and network performance monitoring.

attributes.name: retrieval_reference_number
attributes.description: 12-character reference number used to identify and retrieve transaction details from the card network. Critical for dispute resolution and chargeback processing.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by the payment gateway or fraud detection system. Higher scores indicate higher fraud risk. Used for real-time fraud prevention and manual review decisioning.

attributes.name: three_d_secure_eci
attributes.description: Two-digit code indicating the level of 3D Secure authentication completed. Determines liability shift for fraudulent transactions in card-not-present scenarios.

attributes.name: three_d_secure_status
attributes.description: Status of 3D Secure authentication for eCommerce and card-not-present transactions. Indicates whether cardholder authentication was successful, attempted, or not available.

attributes.name: token_reference
attributes.description: Tokenized representation of the payment card used for recurring transactions and stored payment methods. Replaces actual card number for PCI DSS compliance.

attributes.name: voided_at_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the authorization was voided. Null if authorization has not been voided.

SSOT for all payment transactions across NCR POS and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp

attributes.name: card_type

attributes.name: chargeback_date

attributes.name: chargeback_flag

attributes.name: chargeback_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code provided by card network indicating the reason for chargeback. Examples include fraud, authorization issue, processing error, customer dispute.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this payment transaction record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. Typically USD for US-based grocery operations, but supports multi-currency for international expansion.

attributes.name: decline_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or message provided by card issuer or payment processor when transaction is declined. Examples include insufficient funds, expired card, invalid CVV, suspected fraud.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the transaction from promotions, coupons, loyalty rewards, or markdown pricing. Reduces the subtotal before tax calculation.

attributes.name: fuel_reward_discount_applied
attributes.description: Dollar amount of fuel rewards discount applied to this transaction. Common in grocery retail loyalty programs that offer cents-per-gallon discounts at affiliated fuel centers.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the customer for this transaction. Based on purchase amount and promotional multipliers.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the customer to reduce transaction amount or receive discounts.

attributes.name: payment_token
attributes.description: Tokenized representation of payment card or account number. Used for recurring payments and stored payment methods while maintaining PCI DSS compliance.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the POS (Point of Sale) terminal or checkout lane where transaction was processed. Used for terminal reconciliation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: processor_name
attributes.description: Name of the payment gateway or processor that handled the transaction authorization and settlement. Examples include First Data, Worldpay, Chase Paymentech.

attributes.name: processor_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor. Used for transaction lookup, dispute resolution, and reconciliation with processor settlement files.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Customer-facing receipt identifier printed on transaction receipt. Used for returns, exchanges, and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: register_number
attributes.description: Human-readable register or lane number within the store. Used by store operations for shift reconciliation and cashier assignment.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment transaction was settled and funds were transferred from the card issuer to the merchant account. Typically T+1 or T+2 business days after authorization.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Portion of transaction amount that qualifies for SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits payment. Only food items meeting USDA eligibility criteria are included.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Base merchandise or service amount before taxes, tips, fees, and adjustments. Used for financial reporting and tax calculation reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged on the transaction. Includes state, county, and municipal taxes as applicable to the store location and product categories.

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Gratuity amount added by customer for delivery or service. Applicable primarily to delivery orders and curbside pickup with assisted service.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique transaction number assigned by the payment system. Used for customer receipts, reconciliation, and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Completed indicates successful settlement, failed indicates unsuccessful attempt, voided indicates cancelled before settlement, reversed indicates post-settlement cancellation, pending indicates awaiting authorization response, declined indicates rejected by issuer.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment transaction was initiated at the point of sale or digital commerce checkout. Represents the business event time, not the system record creation time.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of payment transaction: sale (standard purchase), refund (return of funds), void (cancellation before settlement), reversal (post-settlement cancellation), force (offline authorization), preauth (authorization hold), capture (completion of preauth). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sale|refund|void|reversal|force|preauth|capture — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this payment transaction record was last modified. Updated when transaction status changes or corrections are applied.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_amount

attributes.description: Portion of transaction amount that qualifies for WIC (Women Infants and Children) program benefits payment. Only approved WIC items per state program guidelines are included.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location where this tender was processed. Supports location-based payment method analysis, regional tender preference trends, and store-level financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: avs_response_code

attributes.name: card_entry_method
attributes.description: Method by which card data was captured at point of sale. attributes.name: change_due_amount

attributes.name: ebt_voucher_number

attributes.references: WIC Program Guidelines, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: fraud_score

attributes.name: fuel_reward_discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of fuel rewards discount applied to this transaction. Calculated from fuel_reward_points_redeemed based on program conversion rates. Used for financial reconciliation and loyalty program liability tracking.

attributes.name: fuel_reward_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty fuel reward points applied as tender toward this transaction. Common in grocery retail where fuel center partnerships allow customers to redeem accumulated points for discounts on groceries or fuel. Null if no fuel rewards were applied.

attributes.name: gateway_response_code
attributes.description: Response code returned by payment gateway indicating approval, decline, or error condition. Standardized codes enable automated exception handling, decline analysis, and customer service troubleshooting. Mapped to internal status values for reporting.

attributes.name: gateway_response_message
attributes.description: Human-readable message from payment gateway describing the transaction outcome. Provides additional context for declines, errors, or special conditions. Used for customer service inquiries and operational troubleshooting.

attributes.name: mobile_wallet_type

attributes.name: pin_verified_flag

attributes.references: PCI PIN Security Requirements, EBT Regulations

attributes.name: processor_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor or gateway. Used for reconciliation with processor settlement files, chargeback investigation, and dispute resolution. Links internal transaction records to external processor systems.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorized reason for tender refund or reversal. Enables analysis of refund patterns, identification of operational issues, and fraud detection. Populated only when tender_status indicates refund or reversal.

attributes.name: register_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific POS register or terminal where this tender was processed. Enables device-level performance analysis, hardware issue identification, and audit trail for cash drawer reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_date

attributes.name: signature_captured_flag

attributes.name: tender_amount

attributes.name: tender_currency_code

attributes.name: tender_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this tender line item. Tracks progression from initial authorization through settlement, and captures post-transaction events such as voids, refunds, and reversals. Critical for financial reconciliation and exception handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved|declined|pending|voided|refunded|partially_refunded|reversed|settled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tip_amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this tender record was last modified. Captures updates due to status changes (voids, refunds), settlement processing, or data corrections. Used for audit trail and change data capture processing.

products.name: settlement_batch

Each batch contains line-level settlement details: authorization_code, card_brand, masked_pan, transaction_amount, interchange_fee_amount, assessment_fee_amount, net_settlement_amount, settlement_status (included, excluded, disputed), and exception_reason_code. Supports daily cash reconciliation, interchange fee analysis, exception management, and financial close processes aligned with SAP FI.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Grocery department P&L and shrink reporting require refunds attributed to the originating department (pharmacy prescription reversals, deli, produce). refund already has prescription_reversal_flag and

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Refund period-end accrual: refunds must be recorded in the correct fiscal period for accurate revenue and liability reporting. Grocery finance requires this for period-end close, refund liability accr

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order_line. Business justification: Supports line‑level refund tracking, tying each refund to the exact order line for inventory and financial adjustments.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Ensures refund amounts are recorded against the appropriate GL account, needed for net revenue reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: loyalty_redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_redemption. Business justification: When a grocery transaction is refunded, loyalty points redeemed in that transaction must be reversed. The refund record must reference the originating loyalty_redemption to trigger the points reversal

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.method. Business justification: When a refund is returned to the original payment instrument (return_to_original_tender_flag = true), linking refund to the method master record enables tracking of which stored instrument received th

attributes.name: original_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.authorization. Business justification: A refund is typically tied to the original authorization for the purchase being refunded. The refund table has authorization_code (STRING) as a denormalized reference. Adding original_authorization_id

attributes.name: rx_fill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.rx_fill. Business justification: Prescription copay reversals generate refunds requiring direct traceability to the original rx_fill for insurance reversal processing, DEA audit trails, and copay reconciliation. The refund table alre

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the payment processor settlement batch that included this refund transaction. Used for reconciliation with payment gateway and bank settlement reports.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper receiving the refund. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: shrink_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.shrink_record. Business justification: Return-to-shrink workflow: when a customer refund results in unsaleable product (damaged, expired, food safety risk), a shrink_record is created. Loss prevention and P&L reconciliation reports require

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the refund was initiated for in-store returns. Null for eCommerce refunds.

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment tender type used for issuing the refund (credit card, debit card, Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT), store credit, cash, gift card). Links to tender_type reference table.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment transaction that is being refunded. Links to the source payment record in the payment transaction system.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount being refunded to the customer in the transaction currency, including product cost and applicable taxes. Does not include fees retained by the business.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was approved by authorized personnel. Null for auto-approved refunds. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: chargeback_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund was issued in response to or in anticipation of a payment chargeback dispute. True if chargeback-related, False for standard customer-initiated returns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was first created in the data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the refund transaction. Typically USD for United States operations, CAD for Canada, MXN for Mexico.

attributes.name: ebt_snap_reversal_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Reversal Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund involves reversal of a Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) payment. True for SNAP EBT refunds which require special handling per USDA regulations, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fuel_rewards_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of fuel rewards points or discounts that were reversed or adjusted as part of this refund. Null if no fuel rewards impact. Used when refunded purchase had earned fuel center loyalty discounts.

attributes.name: gift_card_reissue_number
attributes.description: Gift card number issued to the customer as the refund method when original payment was gift card or when customer opted for gift card refund. Null if refund not issued as gift card.

attributes.name: initiated_by_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the refund was initiated. Point of Sale (POS) for in-store returns, ecommerce for online order cancellations, mobile_app for app-based returns, customer_service for call center initiated refunds, pharmacy for prescription reversals.

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund request was first created in the system, before approval or processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was last updated in the data system. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: payment_gateway_transaction_reference
attributes.description: External transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor for this refund. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution with payment networks.

attributes.name: prescription_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund represents a pharmacy prescription transaction reversal. True for pharmacy prescription refunds, False for retail merchandise refunds. Pharmacy refunds have additional Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by payment processor or card network for processing the refund transaction. Represents cost to the business, not charged to customer. Null if no processing fee.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the business reason for the refund. DEFECTIVE indicates product quality issue, WRONG_ITEM indicates fulfillment error, NOT_AS_DESCRIBED indicates product mismatch with listing, CUSTOMER_REMORSE indicates buyer changed mind, DUPLICATE_ORDER indicates accidental repeat purchase, PRICING_ERROR indicates incorrect charge.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text detailed explanation of the refund reason provided by the associate or customer. Supplements the refund_reason_code with specific context.

attributes.name: refund_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique refund transaction number displayed on customer receipts and used for customer service inquiries. Format: RFN followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refund transaction. Pending indicates awaiting approval, approved indicates authorized but not yet processed, processed indicates funds returned to customer, failed indicates processing error, cancelled indicates refund voided before processing, reversed indicates refund was clawed back.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund transaction was processed and funds were released back to the customer. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of refund scope. Full indicates complete order/transaction refund, partial indicates refund of selected items or amount, exchange indicates refund paired with replacement purchase.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee deducted from the refund amount charged to the customer for restocking returned merchandise. Null if no restocking fee applied. Used for certain product categories per return policy.

attributes.name: return_to_original_tender_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund was issued back to the original payment method used in the source transaction. True if refunded to original tender, False if refunded via alternative method such as store credit.

attributes.name: store_credit_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of store credit issued to the customer as part of this refund. Null if no store credit issued. Used when customer opts for store credit instead of original tender refund or when original payment method is unavailable.

attributes.name: store_credit_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether store credit was issued as part of this refund transaction instead of or in addition to monetary refund. True if store credit issued, False otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount representing sales tax being returned to the customer. Subset of refund_amount.

attributes.name: wic_reversal_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Reversal Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund involves reversal of a Women Infants and Children (WIC) program payment. True for WIC refunds which require special handling per USDA regulations, False otherwise.

products.name: gift_card
products.description: Master record for Grocery-issued gift cards and store credit instruments. Captures gift_card_number_token, gift_card_type (physical, digital, e-gift), initial_load_amount, current_balance, currency_code, issue_date, expiration_date, is_expired flag, is_active flag, is_reloadable flag, purchase_channel, activation_status, activation_timestamp, last_transaction_timestamp, and program_name (e.g., Grocery Gift Card, Holiday Gift Card). Supports gift card issuance, activation, balance inquiry, and redemption workflows across POS and eCommerce channels.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gift card record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Gift card deferred revenue accounting: unredeemed gift card balances represent a liability posted to a specific GL account. Grocery finance tracks gift card breakage, escheatment liability, and deferr

attributes.name: primary_gift_shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who purchased the gift card. Nullable for anonymous purchases or third-party bulk orders.

attributes.name: replacement_for_gift_card_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original gift card that this card replaces, in cases of lost, stolen, or damaged cards. Nullable for original issuances.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the gift card was issued or purchased. Nullable for online or bulk purchases.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Grocery stores sell third-party gift cards (Blackhawk Network, InComm) sourced from specific suppliers. Linking gift_card to supplier enables procurement tracking, settlement reconciliation, and compl

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.tender_type. Business justification: A gift card is a specific payment instrument that corresponds to a tender type in the tender_type master (e.g., 'Gift Card' tender category). Linking gift_card to tender_type enables JOIN to tender ru

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Third-party gift card programs in grocery (e.g., Blackhawk, InComm) are governed by supplier trade agreements specifying fees, settlement terms, and program rules. Linking gift_card to trade_agreement

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current activation lifecycle status of the gift card: pending (issued but not yet activated), activated (ready for use), suspended (temporarily blocked), or closed (permanently deactivated).

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the gift card was activated and became available for redemption. Nullable for cards that have not yet been activated.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode or UPC (Universal Product Code) printed on physical gift cards for POS scanning. Nullable for digital cards.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for physical gift cards, used for inventory tracking and recall management. Nullable for digital cards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the gift card record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the gift card monetary value (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current available balance on the gift card after all redemptions, reloads, and adjustments. Updated in real-time with each transaction.

attributes.name: escheatment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the gift card balance was escheated to state authorities due to dormancy. Nullable for non-escheated cards.

attributes.name: escheatment_status
attributes.description: Status of the gift card balance with respect to state escheatment (unclaimed property) laws. Not_applicable for active cards, pending for dormant cards approaching escheatment, escheated for balances transferred to state authorities.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the gift card expires and can no longer be used for purchases. Nullable for non-expiring cards. Subject to state and federal gift card regulations.
attributes.references: Credit CARD Act of 2009, State Gift Card Laws

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity. True if fraud is suspected, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fraud_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason the gift card was flagged for fraud (e.g., stolen card, unauthorized use, suspicious transaction pattern). Nullable if no fraud flag is set.

attributes.name: gift_card_type
attributes.description: Type of gift card instrument: physical (plastic card issued in-store or mailed), digital (mobile wallet or app-based), or e-gift (email delivery).

attributes.name: initial_load_amount
attributes.description: The original monetary value loaded onto the gift card at the time of issuance or first activation. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card is currently active and available for use. False if the card has been deactivated, suspended, or closed.

attributes.name: is_expired
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card has passed its expiration date and is no longer valid for redemption. True if expired, False if still valid.

attributes.name: is_reloadable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card supports reloading of additional funds after initial issuance. True for reloadable cards, False for single-load cards.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date the gift card was issued or created in the system. Distinct from activation date.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the gift card record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent transaction (redemption, reload, or balance inquiry) on this gift card. Used for dormancy tracking and fraud detection.

attributes.name: number_token
attributes.description: Tokenized gift card number for PCI DSS compliance. The actual card number is stored securely in the payment gateway; this token is used for transaction processing and balance inquiries.

attributes.name: personalized_message
attributes.description: Custom message from the purchaser to the recipient, displayed on e-gift cards or included with physical card delivery. Limited to 250 characters.

attributes.name: pin_hash
attributes.description: One-way cryptographic hash of the gift card PIN for secure validation. The actual PIN is never stored in plaintext.

attributes.name: pin_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PIN is required for gift card transactions. True for cards requiring PIN entry at POS or online checkout, False for swipe-only cards.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Name of the gift card program or campaign (e.g., Grocery Gift Card, Holiday Gift Card, Employee Appreciation Card). Used for marketing segmentation and program performance tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the gift card was originally purchased: POS (in-store point of sale), ecommerce (online storefront), mobile_app (mobile application), customer_service (phone or chat), bulk_order (corporate or wholesale), or third_party (external retailer or marketplace).

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: Email address of the gift card recipient for e-gift delivery and balance notifications. Required for digital and e-gift card types.

attributes.name: recipient_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the gift card recipient for SMS delivery and balance inquiry notifications. Optional field for digital card delivery.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `grocery_ecm`.`_metrics`.`assortment_item`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic KPIs over the assortment item catalogue, covering SKU portfolio composition, private-label penetration, space productivity, and rationalization risk. Used by Category Managers and Merchandising VPs to govern range width, shelf efficiency, and brand mix."
  source: "`grocery_ecm`.`assortment`.`assortment_item`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "assortment_tier"
      expr: assortment_tier
      comment: "Tier classification of the assortment item (e.g., core, secondary, tail) — used to segment KPIs by strategic importance."
    - name: "merchandising_role"
      expr: merchandising_role
      comment: "Merchandising role assigned to the item (e.g., traffic driver, profit generator, image builder) — key dimension for range strategy analysis."
    - name: "inclusion_status"
      expr: inclusion_status
      comment: "Current inclusion status of the item in the assortment (e.g., active, pending, discontinued) — used to filter live vs. inactive range."
    - name: "private_label_flag"
      expr: private_label_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the item is a private-label (own-brand) product — critical dimension for own-brand penetration analysis."
    - name: "seasonal_flag"
      expr: seasonal_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the item is seasonal — used to separate evergreen from seasonal range KPIs."
    - name: "new_item_flag"
      expr: new_item_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the item is a new introduction — used to track new-item contribution to range growth."
    - name: "rationalization_candidate_flag"
      expr: rationalization_candidate_flag
      comment: "Flags items identified as candidates for range rationalization — key dimension for delisting decision dashboards."
    - name: "season_code"
      expr: season_code
      comment: "Season code associated with the item (e.g., SUMMER, HOLIDAY) — used for seasonal range planning analysis."
    - name: "localization_source"
      expr: localization_source
      comment: "Source driving localization of this item (e.g., cluster, banner, store) — used to measure localization depth."
    - name: "override_flag"
      expr: override_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the item's assortment decision was manually overridden — used to audit governance compliance."
    - name: "effective_start_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_start_date)
      comment: "Month the item became effective in the assortment — used for cohort and trend analysis of range introductions."
    - name: "introduction_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', introduction_date)
      comment: "Month the item was introduced — used to track new-item introduction velocity over time."
  measures:
    - name: "total_active_skus"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inclusion_status = 'active' THEN assortment_item_id END)
      comment: "Total number of distinct active SKUs in the assortment. Core range-width KPI used by Category Managers to govern assortment breadth against plan targets."
    - name: "private_label_sku_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN private_label_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END)
      comment: "Number of distinct private-label SKUs in the assortment. Tracks own-brand range depth, a key strategic lever for margin improvement."
    - name: "private_label_sku_penetration_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN private_label_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT assortment_item_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of total SKUs that are private-label. Executive KPI for own-brand strategy — directly tied to gross margin improvement targets."
    - name: "rationalization_candidate_sku_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rationalization_candidate_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END)
      comment: "Number of SKUs flagged as rationalization candidates. Drives delisting decisions and range simplification initiatives to reduce complexity costs."
    - name: "rationalization_candidate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rationalization_candidate_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT assortment_item_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of the active range flagged for rationalization. High values signal over-assortment risk and prompt category review."
    - name: "total_space_allocation_linear_feet"
      expr: SUM(CAST(space_allocation_linear_feet AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total linear feet of shelf space allocated across all assortment items. Foundational space productivity input used alongside sales data to compute sales-per-linear-foot."
    - name: "avg_space_allocation_linear_feet_per_sku"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(space_allocation_linear_feet AS DOUBLE)), 4)
      comment: "Average linear feet allocated per SKU. Used to identify over- or under-spaced items relative to category norms and planogram standards."
    - name: "new_item_sku_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_item_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END)
      comment: "Number of new-item SKUs currently in the assortment. Tracks innovation pipeline contribution to range and supports new-item review cadences."
    - name: "new_item_penetration_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_item_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT assortment_item_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of the assortment that consists of new items. Measures innovation velocity and freshness of the range — a key supplier and category KPI."
    - name: "override_sku_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN override_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END)
      comment: "Number of SKUs where the assortment decision was manually overridden. High counts indicate governance gaps or buyer discretion outside algorithmic recommendations."
    - name: "override_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN override_flag = TRUE THEN assortment_item_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT assortment_item_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of SKUs with a manual override. Governance KPI — elevated override rates may indicate process compliance issues or model trust deficits."
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic KPIs over the assortment item catalogue, covering SKU portfolio composition, private-label penetration, space productivity, and rationalization risk. Used by Category Managers and Merchandising VPs to govern range width, shelf efficiency, and brand mix.
